evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-update-check

Startup update check for DeepSeek Harness: one check per launch, one card, one click per update.

[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-0f172a)](LICENSE)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-0.2.1-2f6fed)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A community plugin for DeepSeek Harness. It reads versions and asks for the install — it never upgrades anything on its own, never mutates a profile beyond the package you clicked, and exposes nothing but version numbers over its route.

## What it checks

| Target | Source |
| --- | --- |
| DeepSeek Harness itself | The running build from `resources/app.asar/dsh/package.json`, compared against the official `nightly.yml` feed |
| Every profile bundle | `dependencies` in the running profile's `package.json`, each resolved against the npm registry |
| The `rea-agents` CLI | The global install under `%APPDATA%\npm\node_modules\rea-agents` |

npm lookups fall back from `registry.npmjs.org` to `registry.npmmirror.com` when the first one fails, so a blocked registry degrades one target instead of the whole check.

## What you see

A card in the bottom-right corner, only when something is behind:

- `package  1.2.3 → 1.2.4` per outdated target, with the four newest shown and the rest counted
- **Update** per row for profile plugins, **Update all (N)** at the bottom
- `manual` for the three targets that cannot be updated from inside the running composition (see [Limits](#limits))
- **Check again** and **×**, because the card is a notice, not a nag

Nothing renders when everything is current.

## How it works

1. The Host half registers `GET /dsh-update-check/api/status` and starts one check when the bundle activates.
2. That check runs with six-way concurrency: one feed read, one npm read per bundle, one local version read for the CLI.
3. The Client half polls the route, then renders into the `shell.overlay` slot — a frame-wide layer above every column, so the card does not belong to a session or a panel.
4. A click on **Update** posts `{ "name": "..." }` to `/dsh-update-check/api/install`. The route accepts only names that the current check marked outdated and installable, so it cannot be used as a generic install proxy.
5. The install itself is two steps — `installBundle`, and if the manager answers `already-installed` (DSH 0.2.1 treats `add` on an existing dependency that way, issue #896), `removeBundle` followed by `installBundle` again. That is the same shape the official Plugins page uses, because this manager has no in-place update.
6. When the install settles, the check runs once more and the card reflects the new versions.

## Limits

- **`dshmarket` and other markets cannot update themselves.** Removing the bundle unloads the code that would run the reinstall (issue #900), so those rows stay `manual` with the command to run.
- **DeepSeek Harness itself** is a 289 MB desktop build behind the nightly feed; the card reports the newer version and leaves the download to you.
- **`rea-agents`** is a global npm install, not a profile dependency: `npm i -g rea-agents@latest`.
- A version is only compared, never assumed: a target with no readable current version, or a registry that answers nothing, is reported `unknown` instead of being called up to date.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:1731988818/dsh-update-check
```

`pnpm` caches git dependencies by commit hash, so re-run the same command after a push to pick up new code.

Inside a running session the same install is one tool call:

```
plugin_manager install_bundle github:1731988818/dsh-update-check
```

## Route

| Method | Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/dsh-update-check/api/status` | Snapshot of the last check. `?refresh=1` forces a new one. |
| `POST` | `/dsh-update-check/api/install` | Body `{ "name": "package-name" }`. Only accepts an outdated, installable plugin from the current check. |

The route returns version numbers and package names only. It reads no files from the request and installs nothing that the card did not offer.

## Uninstall

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-update-check
```

Nothing is left behind: the plugin writes no files, keeps no state between launches, and its route disappears with the bundle.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

evidence.readmeExcerpt: # dsh-workbuddy WorkBuddy 模型接入插件（DeepSeek Harness / DSH），同时支持两个部署： | Provider 路由 | 部署 | 登录 `platform` | | ---------------- | ------------------------- | --------------- | | `workbuddy-intl` | https://www.workbuddy.ai | `workbuddy-ai` | | `workbuddy-cn` | https://www.workbuddy.cn | `workbuddy` | > 接口、字段、错误码、指纹规则与实测记录都整理在 [`docs/workbuddy-protocol.md`](docs/workbuddy-protocol.md)，排障或二次开发先看那份。 > 要改这个仓库（人或 agent）先读 [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md)。 > **非官方项目。** 本项目与腾讯 / WorkBuddy 官方无任何关联，不使用其商标授权，也不分发其代码； > 它只是一个第三方客户端插件，按公开可观测的接口工作。请自行确认使用方式符合你所在地区的法律 > 与 WorkBuddy 的服务条款。仓库里不含任何真实账号数据——示例与截图一律是假数据。 ## 安装 ```sh # 从 npm 安装到某个 profile（会同时把 bundle 挂进该 profile） dsh plugin --profile add @huai_xin/dsh-workbuddy # 直接从 GitHub 安装（npm 版本还没跟上改动时用它） dsh plugin --profile add github:2424830124/dsh-workbuddy # 本地目录（开发时） dsh plugin --profile add /path/to/dsh-workbuddy ``` npm 页面： 也可以在 Web UI 的插件管理里安装（效果相同，都是往 profile 的依赖里加一条并应用 patch）。 安装后需要重启 DSH（替换已加载的 JS 模块需要新的 generation），随后 `/workbuddy` 命令即可使用。 ## 使用 ### 设置页 界面长什么样、每块显示什么，见下面的 [设置面板](#设置面板) 一节（含截图）。 面板通过宿主路由 `/workbuddy/{state,login,logout,refresh,models,checkin,availability,credits,busy,enabled,import}` 读写状态，这些路由走与宿主一致的连接信任栅栏，只对本机已被 GUI 接纳的来源开放。 积分与签到： - 软件启动约 15 秒后自动签到一次；此后每天**本地 0 点**再签到一次 - 签到是幂等的：服务端今天已领过会返回 `code 10001`，所以重启不会重复发积分 - 登录成功后也会立刻补一次签到 - 海外版后端没有签到接口，只显示积分、不显示领取按钮 ### 命令 ``` /workbuddy login cn # 打开大陆版授权页面 /workbuddy login intl # 海外版 /workbuddy login all # 两个都登录 /workbuddy status # 查看账号与到期时间 /workbuddy models cn # 查看该账号当前可用的实时模型目录 /workbuddy refresh cn # 强制续期 /workbuddy logout cn # 清除凭据 ``` 登录完成后，在常规的模型选择器里选择 WorkBuddy 的模型即可。 ## 工作原理 插件实现了 WorkBuddy 官方客户端的插件登录协议，并把两个部署各注册成一条 llm provider 路由： - `POST /v2/plugin/auth/state?platform=…` → `{ state, authUrl }` - `GET /v2/plugin/auth/token?state=…` → access/refresh token - `GET /v2/plugin/login/account?state=…` → 账号信息 - `POST /v2/plugin/auth/token/refresh` → 令牌轮换（启动后 + 每 6 小时，且距过期不足 24 小时时） - `GET /console/enterprises/personal/models` → 实时模型目录（首选） - `GET /v3/config` → 实时模型目录（scoped 不可用时的回退：大陆版对插件令牌返回 `code 12403`，海外版 scoped 自 2026-10-21 起返回 500） - `POST /v2/chat/completions` → OpenAI 兼容 SSE 对话 - 海外版：`https://www.workbuddy.ai` - 大陆版：`https://copilot.tencent.com`（CodeBuddy 中国网关；`www.workbuddy.cn` 会对 harness 流量回 `Illegal API invocation from an unapproved channel`，所以聊天走这条，`X-Product-Code` 仍为 `workbuddy`；主通道异常时自动回退 `www.workbuddy.cn`） - `POST /v2/billing/meter/get-user-resource` → 积分包（签到发的包带 `grantSource: daily_checkin`） - `POST /v2/billing/meter/checkin-status` → 签到活动状态（`active` / `today_checked_in` / `streak_days` / `week_progress`） - `POST /v2/billing/meter/daily-checkin` → 领取当日积分（今天已领 → `code 10001`） ### 系统提示词改写（两个部署统一） 国内网关会把**以这句开头**的 system 消息判成"未获批渠道"（`code 11128`）： ``` You are an AI agent powered by DeepSeek Harness. ``` 规则是**行首锚定、大小写不敏感、句末句点可选**的品牌指纹：单独出现 `DeepSeek Harness`、前面加一个词、或换成 `You are a coding agent powered by …` 都不拦。适配器把这一句改成 `You are an AI agent.`，其余内容原样保留；海外版网关本来不拦，但也走同一条改写路径，避免两套提示词形态。 凭据以普通 credential reference 存储： | Reference | 内容 | | ------------------------ | --------------------------------------- | | `WORKBUDDY_INTL_TOKEN` | 裸 access token（直接作为 Bearer 发出） | | `WORKBUDDY_INTL_ACCOUNT` | JSON：refresh token、到期时间、账号信息 | | `WORKBUDDY_CN_TOKEN` | 同上（大陆版） | | `WORKBUDDY_CN_ACCOUNT` | 同上（大陆版） | ## 目录结构 ``` dsh-workbuddy/ ├── package.json # bundle 声明（dsh.bundle.patch / dsh.client） ├── cordis.patch.yml # 只插入一行 Host 插件 ├── icon.webp # 插件图标（不透明标记，走 /workbuddy/icon） ├── icon-mask.png # 同一形状的 alpha 剪影，面板用 CSS mask 上色（跟随主题） ├── locale/{en,zh}.json # 插件清单标题与描述 ├── AGENTS.md # 贡献/二次开发须知（不变量、流程、坑） ├── LICENSE # MIT ├── src/ # Host 半边 │ ├── index.js # apply()：provider 路由、/workbuddy 命令、定时器 │ ├── regions.js # 部署定义、聊天路由顺序、区域选择、打开浏览器 │ ├── http.js # 传输与信封工具、JWT/日期工具 │ ├── auth.js # 登录/续期协议、凭据读写、账号状态 │ ├── catalog.js # 实时目录（scoped + /v3/config 并行合并）+ 准入策略 │ ├── catalog-cache.js # 目录落盘缓存（追加、缺字段不覆盖、倍率不缓存） │ ├── availability.js # 可用性台账（最小请求探测、11102 判死、12 小时有效期） │ ├── credits.js # 积分、签到、启动/午夜自动领取 │ ├── adapter.js # llm 适配器（序列化、SSE、路由回退、提示词改写） │ └── api.js # 设置页用的宿主 HTTP 路由 /workbuddy/* ├── client/ │ └── index.js # 设置页 UI（settings.section 槽位） ├── docs/ │ ├── workbuddy-protocol.md # 上游接口/字段/错误码/指纹与实测记录（排查前先看） │ └── ui-preview.png # 设置面板外观预览（由 test/live/ui-preview.mjs 生成） └── test/ ├── unit/ # 离线单测（npm test） └── live/ # 需要真实账号的在线探针 ``` ## 设置面板 ![设置面板](docs/ui-preview.png) 两张卡片，各管一件事： **账户卡片** —— 表格是**转置**的：部署是列、字段是行，两个账号并排对比。 | | ● 大陆版 `[今日已签到]` | ● 海外版 | | --- | --- | --- | | 账号 | 示例账号 | 900000001 | | 到期 | 2027/01/16 09:00:00 | 2027/04/21 12:00:00 | | 积分 | **1280.00** ⟳ | **360.00** ⟳ | | 操作 | `[更换账号] [退出登录]` | `[更换账号] [退出登录]` | （列顺序就是宿主的显示顺序：大陆版在前，默认打开也是它。整张卡片右上角有**一个**「续期」，两个部署一起续，未登录的跳过。） - 部署名旁的圆点是登录状态（绿=已登录 / 黄=等待授权 / 红=已过期 / 灰=未登录），悬停显示 `provider · endpoint`。 - 积分右侧的 **⟳** 只刷新这一行（走 `GET /workbuddy/credits?region=…`），不动其它数据。 - 同一行最右边还有 **「套餐」**：在浏览器打开该部署的官方套餐/用量页（大陆版 → `workbuddy.cn/profile/plans-usage`，海外版 → `workbuddy.ai/profile/plans-usage`）。地址由宿主从**页面白名单**解析，面板只传一个页面名，所以这个入口无法被用来打开任意网址。 - 每列的**值贴左边缘**（与账号、到期对齐），**⟳ 与「套餐」贴右边缘**，中间留白，窄面板下也不会挤出横向滚动条。 - **未登录的部署整列只显示一个居中的「登录」按钮**，不再是四行「未知」加一堆禁用按钮。 - 签到按钮（只有大陆版有）跟在部署名右边，悬停显示上次自动领取的结果。 **模型卡片** —— 顶部标签切换要查看哪个部署（只切换查看，不影响登录状态）： - 按**能不能用**分两组：`可用模型` / `不可用模型`（探测判定 + 真实调用的自学习）。不可用分组默认折叠。 - 每行：左侧圆点是台账颜色（绿=可用、黄=排队、红=不可用/无权限、灰=未检测），中间是模型名，右侧依次是**可用性标签 · 促销标签 · 繁忙程度 · 实时倍率**，最后是该模型的**启停开关**（停用的行会变淡）。 - 点任意一行展开详情：描述、标识、上下文、最大输出、模态、思考档位、倍率、繁忙程度、促销类型/时限/详情。所有标签共用一种样式，颜色只表示语义。 - **思考恒为开启**：上游只声明"可否关闭思考"，却从不给出能兑现它的请求参数（实测见[协议文档 §4.3.1](docs/workbuddy-protocol.md)），所以详情里不放这一项 —— 能调的只有**档位**（低/中/高/超高/极致）。 - 倍率取不到就显示「未知」（**不猜、不用旧值兜底**），`0` 显示「免费」标签。 - 繁忙程度**只有大陆版有**（`POST /v2/chat/busy`；海外版 404，那一列整个不显示）：空闲 / 繁忙 / 拥堵 / 未知四档，用词与官方前端一致（官方把 `normal` 与 `idle` 并成「空闲」），悬停给出官方的完整说法（轻微拥堵 / 极度拥堵）。 - 工具栏：搜索框、「全部启用 / 全部停用」（**只作用于可用分组**，不可用分组自己手动调）、「⟳ 刷新列表」、「检测可用性」（手动，立即执行）。这两个按钮宽度固定，「检测中…」不会把 ⟳ 挤走。 - 打开面板时会自动检测一次（国内零消耗、可频繁；海外版每次探测一 token，每天最多一次）。 - 开关**立即生效**：翻转后插件会通知 harness「模型集变了」，模型选择器随即重读目录（它的目录是缓存的，不通知就会一直显示已关掉的模型）。可用性探测结果与真实调用中学到的判定也会即时反映到默认开关上。 > 该预览由 `node test/live/ui-preview.mjs` 用真实样式表生成到 `%TEMP%/wb-ui-preview.html`，改版后可以直接截图对比。 分层方向单向：`regions/http` ← `auth/catalog` ← `credits/adapter` ← `api/index`；`client/index.js` 只通过宿主路由与后端通信，不 import 任何宿主模块。 适配器刻意不 import `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`，而是按契约鸭子类型实现（`providerInfo` / `listModels` / `resolveModel` / `prepareCall → { model, stream }` / `imageRequestTarget` / `imageRequestPricing`），因此这个包可以独立用 npm 安装，也不会因为仓库里存在两份 dsh-llm 而出现 `instanceof` 失效。 ## 测试 > **改了 `src/**` 之后请退出并重启 DSH Desktop。** Backend [hunyuan-stream] is not supported`。 实测结果（2026-10-21 18:2x）：国内 34 → **30**（官方 19 + 有倍率的非官方 11），国际 28 → **24**（全为官方名单成员）。 ### 可用性台账（目录说是，网关不一定给） 有倍率 ≠ 能调用：国内那 11 个"有倍率的非官方"里，**8 个一调就 `11102 | **先解析模型，后校验参数** | **先校验请求形状**（空/首条非 system → `11128 first message is not system`） | | 探测请求体 | `{"model":M,"messages":[],"stream":true}` | `{"model":M,"messages":[{system:""}],"stream":true,"max_tokens":1}` | | 判定 | 活 → `11133`/`11151`；已下架 → `11102` | 可用 → `11151`/`11133`/`200`；**账号无权限 → `11158`**；已下架 → `11102` | | 代价（各 8 次实测） | `glm-5.3`(0.69x) → **积分 0 变化** | `kimi-k3`(1.62x) → **积分 0 变化**；`hy3` → 200 但 6 秒内零内容，同样 0 变化 | 海外版那一格的关键是**空的 system 内容**：它满足了"首条必须是 system"的形状要求，又让大多数模型在生成前就回 `11151 a message has empty content`（校验层错误，不派发给模型）。带内容的写法（`system "."`）才会真的走到 `200`。 - 回答"空 system 算不算 token"：**若请求真的发给模型，角色本身要算**——聊天模板会加 `<|im_start|>system\n…<|im_end|>\n` 这种固定开销（约 3–6 token），空内容只是不加正文 token。但探测请求到不了那一步：`11151`/`11133` 都是校验层拒绝，**没有 token 被计费**（计费接口最小刻度是 1 积分，实测整数余额不动）。 - 试探过但**无效**的写法（都实测过）：`reasoning_effort:"测试"`、`thinking:{type:"测试"}`、孤儿 `tool_calls`、`messages:[]`（海外版）、`max_tokens:0/-1`、`stop` 类型错误 —— 要么被两个网关直接忽略（照样生成），要么在模型校验之前就被拒（`11101 Unmarshal chat params failed`），拿不到任何模型信息。 - **`11158`（无权限）**：`model [x] is not allowed for user type [personal_free_user]`。海外版免费账号调 GPT 系列就是它；`/v3/config` 的 `modelTiers[].modelIds` 列出的正是这批（12 个，实测与 `11158` 集合完全一致，文案「模型仅面向 Pro 用户开放」），可以用来提前解释，但真正的判定仍以探测/真实调用为准。 - 判定表（`classifyProbe`）：`ok`(200·11133·11151·其它 4xx) / `dead`(11102) / **`denied`(11158)** / `busy`(429·6020) / `blocked`(11128) / `auth`(401·403) / `down`(5xx) / `error`。面板上只呈现三种结论： - **`不可用`（红）**：仅 `11102`，即模型 id 在网关注册表里不存在； - **`无权限`（橙）**：`11158`（账号档位不够）+ `11128`（被判定为未获批渠道，即"被拦截"）； - **`未知`（灰）**：其余无法下结论的报错（5xx、凭据、请求形状被拒），原始报文留在悬停提示里。 `ok` 与未检测都不显示标签。**分组只看结论**：`不可用模型` = 前两种，其余（含未知、排队中）留在 `可用模型` 组——没被证伪的就不当成不能用。 - 台账落盘：`$DSH_HOME/cache/dsh-workbuddy/availability-.json`，按 id 记 `{state, detail, at}`，新结果覆盖旧结果、其它条目保留；不可用判定的**有效期 12 小时**，过期后该模型按可用对待（并在下次检测时复验）。同一文件还记 `lastSweepAt`，用于"多久才能自动再扫一次"。 - **自学习**：真实对话里若某个模型回 `11102` 或 `11158`，适配器直接把这条写进台账并失效目录缓存——不需要等下一次检测，也不额外花任何请求。 - **触发方式**： - 打开设置面板即触发一次**自动**检测（按部署节流：国内 10 分钟、国际 24 小时）； - 「检测可用性」按钮 = **手动**，立即执行、不看节流； - `/workbuddy check [intl|cn|all]` = 手动，全量； - `GET /workbuddy/availability?region=cn&refresh=1[&manual=1]`。 - 结果（2026-10-21 21:2x，国内全量 30 个，零消耗）：`ok` 22 / `dead` 8（`glm-5.0`、`hy4-preview-x`、`glm-4.7`、`glm-4.6`、`glm-4.6v`、`minimax-m2.5`、`kimi-k2-thinking`、`hunyuan-2.0-thinking`）。海外版全量 24 个：`ok` 12 / `denied` 12（GPT 系列 + `grok-4.7` + `gemini-3.x-flash`）。 ### 每个模型的开关（`$DSH_HOME/cache/dsh-workbuddy/enabled-.json`） 面板里每行右侧有一个开关，决定该模型**是否出现在模型选择器里**（面板本身始终保留它，随时可以开回来）： - **默认跟随检测结果**：`dead` / `denied` 默认**关**，其余默认**开**——不用手工维护就能得到一份合理的列表。 - **手动作业永远优先**：把不可用的模型打开正是"不信邪想试试"的路径；把能用的关掉可以让选择器短一些。 - 只落盘**手工决定**（`on`/`off` 两个 id 集合），所以明天上游新增的模型会按自己的检测结果决定默认值，不会莫名其妙消失或出现。 - 一键操作：工具栏「一键启停」（整个列表翻转）、分组标题旁的「全部启用 / 全部停用」（就那一组）。 - 接口：`POST /workbuddy/enabled {region, id|ids, enabled}`，`reset:true` 表示"忘掉手工决定、回到检测默认"。 ### 本地缓存（`$DSH_HOME/cache/dsh-workbuddy/catalog-.json`） 上游偶尔取不到时不再"忽有忽无"：最后一次成功读取会落盘，两个实时源都失败时启用，面板标「本地缓存 (时间)」。 - **追加**语义：每次实时读取按模型 id 并入缓存，新 id 加入、老 id 刷新字段，**这次没提到的模型保留**（上游某次答得少不会把列表缩短）。 - **缺字段不覆盖**：新数据没带的字段（描述、上下文窗口、档位、能力位等）保留旧值；`efforts` 与 `input` 取并集。 - **倍率不进缓存**：`credits` 是实时值（还有促销浮动），缓存里不存、读的时候也丢弃；取不到时面板显示「未知」。 - **准入策略在读取时同样生效**：缓存是追加的，后改的规则必须能作用于旧快照。因为倍率不落盘，缓存命中的列表实际收敛为"白名单那部分"（官方名单不依赖实时倍率）。 - 写入是原子的（临时文件 + rename），旧快照留一份 `catalog-.prev.json` 供排查/回滚。 > 海外版**没有第三条可用源**：它的 Web 应用同样调上面两个端点；控制台侧的 `…/personal/config`、`…/personal/models/list`、`/console/as/users/private-configs/query` 都需要 Web cookie，插件令牌访问一律 403。 ## 已知差异 - 大陆版 `/v3/config` 对插件令牌曾返回 `code 12403`（"check ua, get coding copilot version error"），2026-10-21 傍晚起已可正常访问（62 条模型，含已下线条目）。 - 海外版 `/console/enterprises/personal/models` 自 2026-10-21 起返回 500（APISIX，无令牌时报 400 `Client not found.`、假令牌也 500），目录自动走 `/v3/config`。 - 目录里的部分 id 并非具体模型而是路由预设（`auto` / `default` / `default-model` / `fast-model` / `balanced-model` / `primary-model` / `deep-model`），面板把它们单独列为"预设"。 - **思考档位只认服务端声明的 `reasoning.supportedEfforts`**（两个源合并后国内 15/34、国际 21/28）；只声明了默认档的模型不给档位列表 —— 与网页端行为一致。合并后仍无档位的，请求里不带 `reasoning_effort`，由服务端取默认。 - 实时**繁忙程度**只有大陆版有（`POST /v2/chat/busy`，海外版 404，`regions.js` 的 `hasBusy` 决定那一列是否显示）。它**不是可用性信号**：只对白名单内的活跃模型返回 `idle/normal/busy/congested`，其余一律 `unknown`（面板显示「未知」，不当成故障）。插件侧 50 秒缓存，与官方前端一致。 - 两版**条目数会变**：2026-10-22 实测大陆版 30 个（`ok` 22 / `dead` 8）、海外版 25 个（`ok` 13 / `denied` 12）。`gpt-5.3-codex` 只在账号名单里，两个 `/v3/config` 都没有它，倍率因此是「未知」。 ## 上游行为与错误映射 ### 重试归属 退避重试**全部由 harness 负责**（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-retry`，`agent/request-error` 瀑布，默认 5 次、500ms 起指数退避 + 抖动、上限 10s）。适配器只做两件**即时**补救，都不是退避重试： 1. `Illegal API invocation from an unapproved channel` → 换会话标识重发一次，仍失败则切备用聊天路由； 2. `401/403` → 先续期令牌再发一次。 因此适配器**不转发上游的 `retry_after`**：节拍只由一套策略掌握，避免两套退避互相干扰。 - **模型排队**：繁忙时腾讯网关回 `HTTP 429` + 业务码 `6020` + 未翻译的 i18n key `queue.waiting.title`，并带 `data.queue_position`。适配器把它转成可读的「模型排队中（队列第 N 位），将自动重试」，错误码 `RATE_LIMIT`，交给 harness 退避重试。 - **未获批渠道**：见上文「系统提示词改写」。 - **模型不可用**：`code 11102 model [...] service info not found`（例如目录里列了但 CLI 渠道不服务的 `glm-4.6` 等）→ `INVALID_REQUEST`，不重试。 - **额度/限流**：其他 429 → `RATE_LIMIT`；401/403 → 先续期再重试一次；5xx → `SERVER`。 ### 流式回答怎么算"正常结束"（2026-10-22 起） 判据是机械的：**只有带 `finish_reason`（且流走到 `data: [DONE]`）或交付了工具调用，才算正常结束**；其余一律视为异常，并按下表处理。这样处理的起因是一次真实故障排查：模型"话说一半就停"看起来像正常结束，实际可能是连接被掐断，而旧实现把它当成了 `stop` → 既不报错也不重试。 | 上游怎么结束 | 插件上报 | harness 会做什么 | 日志里能看到 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 没有 `finish_reason`、也没有 `[DONE]`（连接被掐断） | `TRANSPORT` 错误 | **自动退避重试**（默认策略含 `TRANSPORT`） | `… 的响应在 finish_reason/[DONE] 之前中断（收到 … kB，用时 …s，最后一段数据在 …s 前，中断时正在输出思考；可重试的传输错误）` | | 同样的断流，但断在工具调用参数中间 | `TRANSPORT` 错误 | 自动重试 | `… 的工具调用参数在传输中被截断（…）` | | `[DONE]` 但全程没有 `finish_reason` | `stop`（+ 记一笔） | 正常结束 | `… 的响应以 [DONE] 收尾但没有 finish_reason，按 stop 处理（输出 N tokens）` | | 输出打满预算 / 工具参数被输出上限截断 | `max-tokens` | 由 harness 决定续跑 | `… 的输出达到上限，本步被截断（输出 N tokens）` | | 正常 `stop` / `tool_calls` | 原样 | 正常 | 无 | 重试本身由 harness 执行，插件只是把它记进日志： ``` [workbuddy] intl: 第 2/5 次重试（TRANSPORT） — 上游没有给出结束原因就断开了响应…；2.1s 后重试 ``` 另外每个 finish 帧都带一个 `response` 诊断块（`provider` / `model` / `responseId` / `stopReason` / `outputTokens` / `blocks`），会话数据诊断里会原样显示，方便一眼看出"这一步是谁答的、上游叫它什么 id"。它不是 harness 的契约字段，harness 不会据此改变行为。 排查用探针： ```powershell node test/live/stream-cut-probe.mjs cn --selftest # 离线验证"断流"分类 node test/live/stream-cut-probe.mjs intl 10 --long # 真实压测断流率（免费模型零消耗） node test/live/find-message.mjs "关键词" <会话前缀> # 按文本定位某一步，并打出前后事件 node test/live/dump-stream.mjs <会话前缀> # 打印那一步存下来的原始流帧 ``` ## 许可 MIT，见 [`LICENSE`](LICENSE)。再次说明：本项目为第三方非官方插件，与腾讯 / WorkBuddy 无关联。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-plugin-bongo-cat

把 **Steam 上那只原版邦哥猫**（Bongo Cat，app 1337970）请进 **DeepSeek Harness** 的 Web 界面：你打字，它敲爪；你点鼠标，它也跟着敲——每次只拍一只爪，左右交替，和游戏里一模一样。

画面用的就是游戏本体的原始美术资源——插件从你**本机已安装的游戏**里提取精灵、按游戏自己的图层原位合成，逐帧播放，不是重画的仿制品。资源不随插件分发，也不离开你的电脑。

插件参考了社区壁纸插件（`JerryPhoenixCKY/dsh-plugin-wallpaper`）的双端 bundle 架构，完全遵循 DSH 官方客户端插件协议；v0.2.0 起的工程体系（设置单一真源、两级守卫、产物纪律）借鉴了 `elysia395/dsh-wallpaper-engine`。

## 功能

- **原版美术**：从本机 Steam 安装的 Bongo Cat 中提取原始精灵（身体 / 右爪 / 左右手鼓），按游戏图层与画布坐标合成 idle、左击、右击三帧，画面与原版一致
- **敲击互动**：键盘敲击与鼠标点击共用一条左右交替序列，每次只拍一只爪（游戏只有 `CatHitLeft` / `CatHitRight` 两个动作）；键盘灯随敲击亮起
- **Steam 皮肤选择器**：把游戏里全部 243 套皮肤做成图标网格，点一下就换装（提取自你本机安装，含节日/联动皮肤）
- **Steam 皮肤导入**：扫描本机 Bongo Cat 安装目录与创意工坊（app 1337970），把图片导入为自定义皮肤
- **自定义精灵图皮肤**：导入横向精灵图 PNG（帧数 2–12 可调）
- **合成音效**：内置 WebAudio 合成的"tok"敲击声，零音频文件；也可导入自己的 `.wav`
- **敲击计数器**：实时计数，总数在 host 侧持久化（重启不丢）
- **心情预置**：专注 / 禅域 / 派对 / 夜猫 四个一键快照，整套配置单个请求原子落盘
- **省电暂停**：页面隐藏时冻结全部动画并挂起音频，切回即恢复
- **悬浮桌宠**：默认停在右下角，按住可拖到任意位置，双击循环切换四个角；大小、速度、边距均可调
- **设置单一真源**：host 与 browser 的设置 schema 从同一份契约派生，杜绝"改了不生效"
- **桌面组件**：时钟 / 敲击统计 / 专注计时三种小组件，与猫咪互相独立、可任意搭配、拖动摆放
- **点一下猫就能进设置**：单击打开「设置 → 邦哥猫」，带悬停提示与按压反馈；拖动与双击换角落互不干扰
- **装扮系统**：装扮池直接来自你本机 Steam 版 Bongo Cat 的物品库——514 件原版物品（帽子 156 / 表情 18 / 翅膀 18 / 配饰 322）加 10 档毛色，每 1000 次敲击自动掉落一件，点格子即穿即脱
- **两级守卫 + CI**：构建新鲜度、契约对账、CSS 模块键名核对、清单/模块表核对、双端 157 项断言，push/PR 自动跑

## 桌面组件

除了那只猫，插件还能挂一组**独立的小组件**。组件与猫完全解耦——关掉猫，组件照样在；反过来也一样。

| 组件 | 能做什么 | 可调项 |
|---|---|---|
| **时钟** | 本地时间与日期 | 12/24 小时制、是否显示秒、是否显示日期 |
| **敲击统计** | 累计敲击数（读宿主持久化值）或本次会话 | 数据来源 |
| **专注计时** | 1–120 分钟倒计时，开始/暂停/重置，到点响两声 | 时长、结束提示音 |

**怎么组合**：同一类型可以放好几个（`clock`、`clock-2`…），最多 12 个；每个组件有自己的位置、尺寸（小/中）和不透明度；绘制层级等于列表顺序。在设置里点「+ 时钟」这类按钮添加，按住卡片标题栏拖动摆放，窗口变小时会自动收回可视区。

**怎么配置**：设置 → 邦哥猫 → 桌面组件，每个实例都有独立开关与配置；布局与配置存进同一份设置文档，重启后原样恢复。

**边界**：组件的写入类接口沿用 loopback 白名单（跨机页面只能读）；组件类型在版本间可能退役，host 读取设置时会丢弃本版本不认识的实例，不会留下渲染不出内容的空卡片。

## 装扮

猫可以穿的东西直接来自游戏本身：`tools/extract-native.py` 读取本机 Steam 版 Bongo Cat 内置的物品定义（990 条物品名）与精灵图集，导出 514 件可穿戴装扮的叠加 PNG 与图标到 `native/cosmetics/`。每件都带着它在原版帧画布里的 `rect`，浏览器按百分比定位、拉伸到舞台框，与猫咪美术精确对齐——因为叠加图与原版帧是同一把裁切框。槽位分类按物品名关键词启发式判断（本机构建不带库存元数据）；翅膀 / 斗篷 / 镰刀 / 背包归入 `back` 层、画在透明 PNG 底下，只露出轮廓外的部分。

| 页签 | 内容 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| **帽子** | 156 件 | 游戏里的全部帽类，格子显示真实物品名、图标与稀有度星标 |
| **表情** | 18 件 | 眼镜、腮红一类 |
| **翅膀** | 18 件 | 翅膀 / 斗篷等 `back` 层物品，画在猫咪身后 |
| **配饰** | 322 件 | 围巾、铃铛、背包等 |
| **毛色** | 原色、奶油、橘、可可、灰、夜、玫瑰、天蓝、薄荷、丁香 | CSS 滤镜作用在美术上，不影响装扮和计数徽章 |

**怎么获得**：全自动。host 在 `stats/bump` 里结算——敲击余额每满 1000 自动发放一件并从余额里扣掉 1000，页面关着也生效（启动时还会把挂着没结算的余额补结一次）；未拥有的物品优先，集齐后才开始出重复，单次结算上限 10 件。稀有度加权（★:8 / ★★:4 / ★★★:1），掉落按序号播种，重放同一份敲击历史结果一致。获得装扮时猫咪弹出带物品图标的气泡提示；面板工具条上方有进度条，显示「距下一件 N 次」。

**怎么穿**：设置 → 邦哥猫 → 装扮。点格子穿上，再点一次脱下；同一槽位只能穿一件，但多类可以叠起来。工具条是 **筛选**（全部 / 已拥有 / 已装备）、**随机搭配**（只从已拥有的里挑）、**全部卸下**；上方进度条下的状态行显示「已收集 N/总数 · 距下一件 N 次」。

**一致性**：面板的所有改动都通过同一个串行写回队列改 `wardrobe`（整字段写入），所以"点格子装备"和同时落地的自动掉落不会互相覆盖；`stats/bump` 的返回（扣款后的余额、lifetimeTaps、新物品）会直接合并进页面镜像，不用等整份文档重载。

**校验**：`wardrobe` 是嵌套对象，host 校验**结构**（非对象直接 `bad-request`），内容**前向兼容**（未知道具 id 丢弃、没拥有的不能穿、未知毛色回原色、未知筛选回全部、数量 clamp 到 999）；重新提取资源后 host 会把衣柜**对账**（reconcile）到当前目录，消失的 id 自动清掉。

**从旧版升级**：0.9.x 的 26 件手绘贴纸按关键词映射到最接近的真实物品（帽子找帽子、翅膀找翅膀，没有同名物品时按原槽位兜底），进度不丢；映射后装备栏先清空，重新穿即可。同时新增 `lifetimeTaps`（累计敲击、永不扣除），旧 profile 首次读取时用 `counter` 补种；设置页「敲击总数」与计数器小组件改读它，猫咪徽章与装扮进度条继续显示可花费余额——所以攒满时能亲眼看到 1000 被扣走。

## 安装

需要 **DeepSeek Harness 的 web profile**（Node.js ≥ 22）。实测通过的内核：`0.2.0-rc.2`（主目标）与 `0.1.1-rc.2`（同样能正常挂载）；`0.1.0` 线与 `0.2.1-rc` 未验证，`0.3.x` 尚未发布。

从 GitHub 安装（仓库自带 `lib/` 构建产物，装完即用，无需构建）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:36541a/dsh-plugin-bongo-cat
```

这条命令做三件事，**都不需要你手工配置**：

1. 把包装进 profile 的 `dependencies`；
2. 因为包里声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch`，`dsh` 会自动把 `dsh-plugin-bongo-cat` 追加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`（也就是“插件层”，无需自己改 `cordis.patch.yml`）；
3. 因为 `package.json` 声明了 `dsh.client`，重启后浏览器端会自动进入 0.2.0 的模块引导图，不需要往任何清单里加路径。

本地开发（link 模式，改完代码重新 build 再重启即可）：

```sh
cd dsh-plugin-bongo-cat
pnpm install
pnpm build
dsh plugin --profile web add link:./dsh-plugin-bongo-cat
```

安装后重启 `dsh web`（插件在启动时加载），刷新页面，打开 **Settings（设置）→ 邦哥猫**。

### 装完怎么确认它真的活了

`dsh web` 启动时会打印一个带 token 的地址，直接拿它跑仓库里的自检脚本：

```sh
dsh web --no-open                  # 复制打印出来的 http://127.0.0.1:<port>/?token=…
node tools/verify-install.mjs "http://127.0.0.1:9000/?token=…"
```

全绿（12 项）说明这样几件事：

```
ok  token exchange accepted — HTTP 303
ok  dsh-plugin-bongo-cat is rostered in the client graph   ← 浏览器端进了 0.2.0 引导图
ok  row belongs to an initial-load batch — application
ok  combo bundle served — HTTP 200, 10459199 bytes          ← 组合脚本带上了浏览器半
ok  /bongo-cat/config/get returns resolved settings         ← host 端 RPC 通道可用
ok  /plugins/bongo-cat/skin route is mounted — HTTP 404     ← 路由已挂载（未导入皮肤时 404 正常）
```

然后在浏览器里应当看到：右下角出现提示块「请先在设置里导入原版资源」（还没导入 Steam 资源时的正常形态），打开设置能在左侧导航里看到**邦哥猫**，里面有启用开关、皮肤选择、心情预置、大小/速度/边距、敲击总数与音效。随便敲几下键盘，徽章数字会增长。

> **为什么不用跑安装脚本**：`lib/index.js` 与 `lib/client.js` 随仓库一起发布，`github:` 直装不执行任何 install 脚本，因此 pnpm 10+ 的 `allowBuilds` 闸不会拦你。开发时改完源码记得 `pnpm build` 再提交（`pnpm verify` 会检查产物是否比源码新）。

卸载：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-bongo-cat
```

> 卸载时 `dsh` 会把它从 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里一并摘掉；`$DSH_HOME/storages/bongo-cat/` 里的设置与已提取素材会保留，想彻底清干净手动删掉这个目录即可。

## 使用

1. Settings → 邦哥猫，勾选**启用邦哥猫**
2. 在皮肤画廊里挑一只猫；想用 Steam 里的猫？点**扫描本机 Bongo Cat**，在扫描结果里点任意图片即可导入
3. 赶稿/派对/深夜不想一项项调？点顶部的**心情预置**一键切换
4. 拖动滑块调整大小、动画速度、音效量和边距；点四个角按钮切换停靠位置
5. 回到工作区尽情打字——听，猫在敲键盘

> 导入皮肤 / 音效只能在本机页面（localhost）操作，这是 DSH 的写入通道安全限制。

## 原版资源（Steam）

原版模式依赖本机安装的 Bongo Cat（Steam 免费游戏，app 1337970）：

1. Settings → 邦哥猫 → **猫咪来源** 选「自动（优先原版）」
2. 点 **从 Steam 导入原版资源**
3. 首次会自动准备运行环境：在 `storages/bongo-cat/pyenv` 建一个插件私有 venv 并安装 UnityPy（约 50 MB，需要联网，1 分钟左右），不会动你系统里的 Python
4. 完成后立即生效：`$DSH_HOME/storages/bongo-cat/native/` 下生成 `idle.png` / `tap-left.png` / `tap-right.png`（1020×750）

提取器做的事：定位 Steam 库 → 读取 `BongoCat_Data/sharedassets0.assets` → 取出 `<Skin>Left / Right / LeftPunch / RightPunch` → 按精灵 `textureRect` 与原版图层坐标合成 → 输出三帧。**默认只画猫（不含手鼓）**，右爪从身体下缘露出；想要原版"双鼓"构图可加 `--with-drums`。换皮肤：`python tools/extract-native.py --list` 可列出全部 244 个皮肤，`--skin Black` 这类参数可提取指定皮肤。

**版权说明**：美术资源版权归 Bongo Cat 作者所有。插件仓库、npm 包与 zip **都不包含任何游戏图像**；提取只在你的机器上运行，产物只写入本机 DSH 数据目录，用于个人显示。

## 目录结构

```

├── src/
│   ├── index.ts                  # host 端：settings 命名空间 + RPC 通道 + 资产路由
│   ├── shared/
│   │   └── settings-contract.ts  # ★ 设置单一真源：两端派生

│       ├── BongoCatSection.module.css
```

## 开发者

完整架构、RPC 协议、皮肤规范与扩展指南见 [docs/DEVELOPMENT.md](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md)；对参考项目 `elysia395/dsh-wallpaper-engine` 的架构分析与借鉴取舍见 [docs/ANALYSIS-dsh-wallpaper-engine.md](docs/ANALYSIS-dsh-wallpaper-engine.md)。

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm typecheck   # 需要 DSH 仓库的 @deepseek-ai/* 依赖（见文档）
pnpm build       # esbuild → lib/index.js + lib/client.js
pnpm verify      # 硬档守卫：新鲜度 + 契约 + CSS 键名 + manifest 20 项 + host 74 项 + browser 63 项断言
pnpm verify:soft # 软档守卫：发布面 / i18n / CHANGELOG（不挡人）
pnpm lint        # plain-JS 工具面（scripts/ 与 .verify/）
```

## 隐私与安全

- 仅在**本机（loopback）**接受皮肤 / 音效导入，导入的文件会先经过路径与类型校验
- 扫描 Bongo Cat 目录是**只读**的，永远不会改动游戏安装或创意工坊文件
- 不采集、不上传任何会话或用户数据；敲击计数只存在本机 `$DSH_HOME`

## 许可

# dsh-plugin-doctor

> Release stamp: `0.4.6` (2026-10-04).

> **Package name.** This project publishes to npm as **`@perrylink/dsh-plugin-doctor`**. The bare npm name `dsh-plugin-doctor` belongs to a different, unrelated project — never run `npx dsh-plugin-doctor`; installing it does not install this plugin.

[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache%202.0-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/%40perrylink%2Fdsh-plugin-doctor)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@perrylink/dsh-plugin-doctor)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/%40perrylink%2Fdsh-plugin-doctor)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@perrylink/dsh-plugin-doctor)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%5E22.19%20%7C%7C%20%3E%3D24-brightgreen.svg)](#)
[![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-doctor/ci.yml?branch=main&label=CI)](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-doctor/actions)
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-doctor?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-doctor?ref=badge)
[![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-doctor/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-doctor)

[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README-zh.md) · [Español](README-es.md) · [Português](README-pt.md) · [हिन्दी](README-hi.md)

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add @perrylink/dsh-plugin-doctor
```


An all-in-one "integrity + runtime health" checker for dsh plugins. Zero dependencies (it uses
only what Node ≥22 ships), and one run covers four layers at once:
**static package-structure checks (R) → Cordis contract scan (K) → dynamic sandbox smoke (D) → ecosystem directory-listing validation (CC)**.
Every criterion traces back to three first-hand research tracks dated 2026-09-07: the deepseek-harness
docs and source, the cordiverse/cordis source contracts, and an inventory of every distribution
channel in the workspace (full text in `SURVEY.md`).

**📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/).

<!-- star-cta -->
## Installation (DSH bundle)

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:PerryLink/dsh-plugin-doctor
```

`dsh-plugin-doctor` declares `dsh.bundle.patch` → `cordis.patch.yml` in package.json, so it can also be installed as a DeepSeek Harness bundle:

```powershell
# git channel (latest main)
dsh plugin --profile web add github:PerryLink/dsh-plugin-doctor

# npm channel (released version; always use the scoped full name -- the bare name dsh-plugin-doctor is a different project)
dsh plugin --profile web add @perrylink/dsh-plugin-doctor
```

The inserted line loads this package under the standard Cordis plugin contract: the host half is a plain ESM module exporting `apply(ctx)` (declaring `inject` for the services it needs). The package ships no browser UI, so there is no `dsh.client` declaration.

```js
// bundle entry (host half) -- the export contract the patch line loads
export function apply(ctx) {
  // registers the /doctor command and the plugin_doctor read-only check tool
}
```

Uninstall: `dsh plugin --profile web remove @perrylink/dsh-plugin-doctor` (or delete that line from the profile patch). The CLI usage below is unaffected.

## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你

这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（95 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。

*English:* part of a 95 plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it.


## What is dsh-plugin-doctor?

An all-in-one "integrity + runtime health" checker for dsh plugins. Zero dependencies (it uses only what Node ≥22 ships), and one run covers four layers at once:

![Workflow diagram for dsh-plugin-doctor: request → policy / review → verdict.](docs/assets/dsh-plugin-doctor-flow.svg)

*Workflow overview: request → policy / review → verdict. The examples below use the real command surface.*



## Comparison

![Measured comparison chart for dsh-plugin-doctor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-doctor/main/docs/assets/dsh-plugin-doctor-evidence.png)

60 candidates → 20 qualifying plugins · scan dated 2026-09-10 (data/rk-scans.json)

## Compatibility

| Surface | Status |
|---|---|
| Harness | DeepSeek Harness `dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.1` (zero-dependency and host-agnostic by design: `package.json` declares no `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` dependency and no peer range at all, so this repository's `R5`/`R8` skip deliberately instead of passing — see `SELF-CHECK.md`; the line is recorded in `CHANGELOG.md` §0.4.6, "host pins move to `0.2.1-alpha.1`", and the D-group sandbox smoke takes its host from `--dsh`, default the peer floor `0.1.2-rc.1`) |
| Node | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` |

## Usage

```powershell
node doctor.mjs --repo <插件仓路径>            # 全量（含动态冒烟，需网络 + pnpm）
node doctor.mjs --repo <路径> --no-smoke       # 仅静态 + 清单
node doctor.mjs --repo <路径> --dsh 0.1.7-alpha.1 # 冒烟宿主版本（默认 npm latest 已发布线）
node doctor.mjs --repo <路径> --only R,K       # 只跑静态两层（推荐用 ASCII 别名）
node doctor.mjs --repo <路径> --json report.json
node doctor.mjs --repo <路径> --json -         # JSON 写 stdout（此时抑制人类可读报告）
node doctor.mjs --repo <路径> --format check --json -   # 生态三值契约视图（PASS/WARN/FAIL + 0/1/2）
node doctor.mjs --repo <路径> --workspace <工作区根>   # 指定兄弟仓所在工作区（CC 组核对用）
node doctor.mjs --repo <路径> --allow-degraded # 显式接受「整组未真跑」（默认 exit 6）
node doctor.mjs --purge <隔离目录>              # 清理本工具产生的隔离目录（仅 doctor-quarantine-*）
```

### Host half: `plugin_doctor` / `/doctor` (new in 0.7.1)

Installed as a bundle, the plugin registers the same R/K/X checks as a read-only
tool and a command. Two things differ from the CLI, and both are stated in the
reply because **the host half has no exit code** — the returned report is the
whole message:

| Parameter | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `repo` (required) | — | plugin repository path (needs `package.json`) |
| `smoke` | `false` | also run the D-group sandbox smoke (needs network + pnpm) |
| `host` | `true` | run the X group (host-contract checks); degrades when no dsh install is readable |
| `workspace` | auto | family workspace holding the sibling `dsh-*` repos, for CC1–CC5 and K14 |

- **Degraded runs say so.** When a requested group never really ran, the reply
  carries the same `[降级] …不可当作通过` line the CLI prints, naming the groups.
  Before 0.7.1 the renderer dropped that fact, so a degraded reply was
  indistinguishable from a run with nothing to do.
- **`workspace` is resolved from the repository, not from the install.** The
  tool walks up from the repository under check to the nearest directory holding
  two or more DSH plugin repos (`DSH_WORKSPACE` and the explicit parameter win
  over it). Resolving it as `import.meta.dirname/..` — as 0.7.0 did — yields
  `<profile>/node_modules` (or `…/@perrylink`) once the package is installed as a
  bundle, which is not a workspace at all: CC1–CC4 then report "not present
  locally" for registries that do exist, and K14 never finds a sibling. When no
  workspace can be located the reply says so explicitly, instead of letting
  those skips read as absent registries.

### Target shapes and coverage (new in 0.2.0)

`--repo` may be a **source tree** or an **installed package directory / unpacked tarball artifact** (the latter is common at `node_modules/<pkg>`). The criteria change with the shape:

| Shape | K group (Cordis contract) | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Source tree with `src/` | scans `src/**` plus root-level JS (`mode: src`) | complete |
| **No `src/`, `main` points at `lib/`** | **fallback scan of `lib/**` (`mode: lib-fallback`)** | fixed in 0.2.0: the old implementation keyed on "no build script", but published packages **keep** their build script → the fallback never fired, all nine K checks were skipped, and it still exited 0 (false green) |
| Neither `src/` nor `lib/` | all nine skipped (`mode: none`) | **the whole group never really ran → exit code 6**, no more false green |

Coverage is written to `coverage.K` in the JSON (`{filesInspected, mode}`) and summarised in `groups.K`.

### `--only` groups and ASCII aliases

| Alias | Full group name | Contents |
|---|---|---|
| `R` | static · package structure | R0–R8 |
| `K` | static · Cordis contract scan | K1–K9 |
| `D` | dynamic · sandbox smoke | D0–D3, D9 |
| `CC` | ecosystem · directory listings | CC1–CC5 |

Aliases are case-insensitive, and the Chinese full names still work. **Use the aliases in workflows**: if an editor or script round-trips a Chinese group name through the wrong encoding, `--only` matches no group at all.

### Exit-code contract

| Code | Meaning | Introduced |
|---|---|---|
| `0` | no fail/error (warn/skip allowed), and every requested group really ran | 0.1.x |
| `1` | fail/error present (a plugin defect) | 0.1.x |
| `2` | usage error, unknown group, **unknown option** | 0.1.x |
| `3` | infrastructure error (missing npm/pnpm and the like) | **0.2.0** |
| `4` | unsupported host version (the host itself failed to install; **not** a plugin verdict) | **0.2.0** |
| `5` | unstable result (a step timed out or was killed by a signal) | **0.2.0** |
| `6` | **degraded**: a requested group never really ran (e.g. no source files to scan) | **0.2.0** |

**Guarding against silent passes** (two layers):

1. If even one group name in `--only` fails to match → immediately `2`. Versions 0.1.4 and earlier would "check nothing + exit 0" when a group name was mangled, which once turned the CI gates of 35 repos into false green (measured 2026-09-09: `checks_run=0`, `exit=0`).
2. From 0.2.0: **a requested group whose checks all skipped → `6`**. The old implementation only covered "not a single check ran", not "it ran but everything skipped" — the latter let "K group with zero coverage" count as a pass. To accept that explicitly, use `--allow-degraded` (exit code drops to 0, but `degraded` stays non-empty in the JSON).

> ⚠️ The existing gates in 41 family repos **do not read the exit code** (their workflows use `set +e` / `out="$(…)"` / `set -e`) and only parse the `R0 ` / `K1 ` prefixes on stdout and `results[].name` in the JSON. So 0.2.0's new exit codes **change nothing for those pipelines**; they serve interactive use and future integrators.

- The smoke run keeps its temporary `DSH_HOME`/`DSH_AGENTS_HOME` inside a self-made `%TEMP%` sandbox (prefix `doctor-`, which **does not overlap** the host-protected `%TEMP%\dsh-*` template) and never touches the real `~/.dsh` (red line 3).
- `dsh plugin add` is always passed `--ignore-scripts`: the tested package's install/prepare scripts never execute on the host. A pnpm ignored-builds block is classified as `environment` (it counts neither as a pass nor as a plugin defect).
- Every step's subprocess stdout/stderr is written to `%TEMP%\doctor-run-*\logs\`; at the end the run **quarantines instead of deleting** (renames to `%TEMP%\doctor-quarantine-*`), prints that path in the report tail, and leaves removal to `--purge` after a human confirms (red line 4, the three-stage rule).
- Absolute paths seen at runtime are placeholder-ised to `<path>` before they reach the JSON or the rendered text, so a report can be committed into someone else's repo without tripping its path-leak gate.

## Name collisions (important)

This repository is **`@perrylink/dsh-plugin-doctor`**, and it is **not the same project** as other same-named tools in the ecosystem:

- The bare npm name `dsh-plugin-doctor` belongs to **Xrainsmile/DSH-Plugin-Doctor** (a different project, 0.1.1). So **never run `npx dsh-plugin-doctor`** — that executes someone else's package; always use the scoped full name `@perrylink/dsh-plugin-doctor@<exact version>`.
- Ten GitHub repos carry `dsh-plugin-doctor` in their name (eight of them **exactly** that name), including `zoahdev/dsh-plugin-doctor` (GitHub-only, never published to npm).
- `dsh-testkit`'s README links `dsh-plugin-doctor` to the zoahdev repo; that has nothing to do with this one.

In one line: **zero-dependency, offline-capable (`--only R,K`), and it turns the Cordis v4 contracts (K1–K9) and five ecosystem directory listings (CC1–CC5) into a CI gate whose verdict is readable from the exit code.** (No "the only" style claim — merely that nothing comparable appeared within the set of tools actually surveyed.)

**Inline one-liner.** `--format check` emits the ecosystem's three-value contract
(`PASS`/`WARN`/`FAIL`, exit `0`/`1`/`2`, flat `checks[]`) instead of this
project's enriched envelope, so another checker or Action can consume the result
directly. It is a *view*: it never changes whether a project passes, and a `skip`
is never rendered as `PASS` (it becomes `WARN` with `skipped: true`). The full
semantics stay in a `doctor` side field. See `SPEC.md` §1.1 — those three
properties are normative and `tests/compat.mjs` asserts them.

## Check catalog

| Group | Checks | What the criteria cover |
|---|---|---|
| static · package structure | R0–R8 | base fields; **the activation gate `dsh.bundle.patch` (critical)**; `npm pack --dry-run` tarball contains the entry and the patch; cordis.patch.yml structure; entry `name`/`apply` exports; rescoped dependency policy (bare `cordis` forbidden); engines aligned to `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0`; prebuild + files allowlist; leftover old-rc peers (the 2026-09-05 dual-baseline lesson) |
| static · Cordis contract | K1–K9 | service access vs `inject` declaration; the ctx live-data serialization red line; timers/listeners not wrapped in `ctx.effect`; Schema containing a function; `apply` return shape (the v4 Effect contract); `inject` service-name seam; **v3 legacy APIs (the 3.x→4.x removal list)**; Config must be a Standard Schema; the `name==='apply'` special case |
| dynamic · sandbox smoke | D0–D3, D9 | `npm pack` → `dsh plugin --profile headless add <tarball>` → assert `dsh.profile.bundles` contains the package name → `--dump-config` layer marker → keyless headless run expected to **exit 1 + `dsh: MISSING_CREDENTIAL`** (= the composition booted as far as a model request; NO_ADAPTER/ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND/SyntaxError/TypeError are excluded) → sandbox cleanup |
| ecosystem · directory listings | CC1–CC5 | the certification registry spec v1 five-dimension evidence; adp-list yml fields/enums/descriptions; dsh-catalog entry constraints (install commands forbidden, truncation heuristics); the omdsh `dshWorkshop` activation five values; the dsh-plugin-kit three gates (license / five-language README / the three seam roles, preferring the kit's official CLI) |

## Verified 徽章

There are **two badge paths**, and they make different claims. Pick the one whose
claim you can actually back. **[`FOR-ADOPTERS.md`](FOR-ADOPTERS.md) is the
step-by-step version of this section** — the exact file to copy, the exact badge
markdown, what each verdict means, and what this check does *not* prove.

### Path A — self-serve gate badge (no permission needed, no author involvement)

This badge makes **one narrow, checkable claim**: *the repository runs
dsh-plugin-doctor's static R+K gate in its own CI, and that workflow is green on
the repository's default branch.* It is rendered by shields.io directly from your
own workflow's status, so it needs no registry entry, no pull request, no token
from anyone, and it cannot be broken by this project's infrastructure:

```markdown
[![dsh-doctor R+K](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/<owner>/<repo>/plugin-doctor.yml?branch=main&label=dsh-doctor%20R%2BK)](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-doctor/blob/main/SPEC.md)
```

Replace `<owner>/<repo>` (and `branch=` if your default branch is not `main`).
The link target is `SPEC.md` — the criteria you are claiming to meet, and an
explicit statement of who authored them.

**Use Path A.** It is the whole standard, self-serve, and it is what this
specification is designed for. It requires nothing of this project.

Two honest caveats about Path A: the badge reflects *your* workflow, so it is
only as trustworthy as your CI configuration — it is not verified by anyone
else; and it is served by shields.io, which learns your repository name.

### Path B — author-issued audited badge

Wearing this badge means exactly one auditable thing: **the repo runs dsh-plugin-doctor's static R+K gate (16 checks: R0/R1/R3/R5/R6/R7/R8 + K1–K9) in its own CI, and that gate is green on the current HEAD of the default branch**, *as re-checked by this project's auditor*. It is **not** a certification badge: no Scorecard, no provenance, no install smoke. R2 (tarball integrity) and R4 (entry contract) read the built `lib/`, and building most family repos needs `HARNESS_COMMIT` + `gen-aliases` to pass — those two are covered by each repo's own `ci.yml` (build-drift gate + pack smoke) and are deliberately outside this gate.

```markdown
[![dsh-doctor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-doctor/main/badges/PerryLink__dsh-github.svg)](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-doctor#verified-徽章)
[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
```

**Path B is a centralized, single-operator service and should be treated as
such.** It needs a fine-grained PAT with cross-repository read access, stored as
the `DOCTOR_AUDIT_TOKEN` repository secret. The workflow-scoped `GITHUB_TOKEN`
**cannot** substitute for it: it carries no cross-repository read permission, so
GitHub treats it as an anonymous caller limited to 60 requests/hour, while a full
audit of the declared repos needs 200+. Without the PAT, every badge renders grey
`NO DATA` — the failure looks like a broken badge program rather than a missing
secret. This has happened (once as `401`, then as `403 rate limit exceeded`), and
it is the reason Path A exists and is recommended. `scripts/verify.mjs` now stops
at the first such response, exits `3`, and writes a registry whose reasons name
the real cause instead of emitting the same rate-limit line for every repo.
- The registry `data/verified.json` is the single source of truth for Path B, refreshed by `.github/workflows/verified.yml` daily and on every relevant push. A refresh only reads the GitHub API: it parses each repo's HEAD `plugin-doctor.yml` gate configuration (which must pin `@perrylink/dsh-plugin-doctor@<version>`, use a working `--only` argument, and self-verify that R0/K1 actually ran), then checks the conclusion of that HEAD's `plugin-doctor` workflow run. **This repo's CI never clones, installs or executes any third-party code.**
- Badge appearance: the visual language follows the two newer badges in the ecosystem (`dsh.directory`'s monospace-uppercase + letter-spacing + mark + gradient, and `awesome-dsh-plugin`'s seal block) — **a silver/platinum metallic left segment, a shield tick mark, and ink-blue monospace uppercase**, with the right segment a **solid GitHub-convention status colour** (green/orange/red/grey) carrying a monospace uppercase status word, and the status additionally expressed by a **path-drawn icon** (✓ / ! / ✕ / –) so it stays readable with colour-vision deficiency. 5px corner radius + 1px stroke; **the stroke is required** — without it the silver left segment disappears against a white README background.
- Four states (value text uses the shields / GitHub Actions conventional words): `passing` (green: the HEAD run succeeded) / `warning` (orange: HEAD has not run yet, a run is still queued, or a gate precondition is missing) / `failing` (red: the HEAD run failed, or the gate configuration does not hold — including a "fake gate" whose `--only` argument is doubly mis-encoded) / `no data` (grey: the API query failed). The badge is **dynamic**: once it stops passing it turns red. The precise R+K scope lives in this section and in the registry's `meaning` field, not in the badge text (the badge links back here).
- To join Path B: open a PR against `data/verified-repos.json` adding `{ "repo": "<owner>/<name>", "package": "<npm package name>" }`, and add `plugin-doctor.yml` to your own repo; the entry must pass the audit above. **Path A needs none of this.**
- **The gate file is shipped, not scraped.** Copy [`plugin-doctor.yml`](plugin-doctor.yml) — the canonical, ready-to-use workflow — to `.github/workflows/plugin-doctor.yml` in your repository and adjust the pin. It is also inside the npm tarball, so `npx @perrylink/dsh-plugin-doctor` users can read the shipped copy instead of reconstructing the step from this README. Group names use the **ASCII aliases `R,K`** (supported since 0.1.5, keeping file and command line pure ASCII), and the tail self-verifies that R0/K1 really ran.

> Why the gate installs and builds nothing, and why this repo does not run the badge itself: the static R/K checks read only the committed tree (no dependencies needed), whereas `npm run build` fails in an environment without the harness aliases, and its prebuild wipes the committed `lib/`, manufacturing a false red. Concentrating third-party dependency installs into this repo's CI, on the other hand, would be a supply-chain risk. So the gate runs inside each repo's own CI against the committed tree, and this repo only audits and issues the Path B badge.

## Where the criteria come from (full text and URLs in SURVEY.md)

- **harness side**: `docs/user/develop/basic/publish.md`, `apps/cli/src/plugin.ts` (the activation gate is the only switch),
  `packages/bundle/headless/README.md` (the MISSING_CREDENTIAL criterion), Releases (the 0.1.2-rc.1 / 0.1.3-alpha.1 changes),
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-loader-smoke` (the official "temporary DSH_HOME + expected exit code" pattern).
- **Cordis side**: the cordiverse/cordis v4 source (registry/fiber/reflect/events.ts) + the DSH cordis-primer/tutorial docs +
  the v3 `@cordisjs/core@3.10.2` d.ts diff (the 3.x→4.x blacklist).
- **Ecosystem side**: the dsh-plugin-certification spec v1, adp-list `entries.mjs`/`check-submission.mjs`,
  dsh-catalog `validate.mjs`/`deploy.yml` live smoke, omdsh build-submission, dsh-plugin-kit `verify/*`.

## Release health

A green release workflow does not prove a correct release. On 2026-10-05 the family shipped
37 packages and the failures that mattered were invisible in the job colour: 36 CHANGELOGs
carried the literal date `undefined`, two packages published successfully and still ended red,
one failed `ENEEDAUTH` because npm's trusted-publisher binding named a workflow file that no
longer performs the OIDC exchange, and one never reached npm at all because its pre-publish
`verify` gate failed first and the publish job was `skipped`.

`scripts/check-release-health.mjs` checks the four things that cover all of those:

| Pass | Question | Needs network |
|---|---|---|
| LOCKSTEP | does every version carrier in the repo agree with `package.json`? | no |
| PUBLISHED | is the local version the one on the registry? | yes |
| PROVENANCE | which workflow file published it, and is that a current publish file? | yes |
| FILES | does the published tarball still carry `src/`, `lib/` or `dist/`? | yes |

```sh
# one repository, offline (the mode a downstream repo should use in its own CI)
node scripts/check-release-health.mjs --repo . --no-registry

# the whole declared family, from the registry, without checking any of it out
node scripts/check-release-health.mjs --roster data/verified-repos.json
```

Exit codes: `0` healthy, `1` at least one problem, `2` usage error. `--json <path>` writes the
machine-readable report, `--quiet` prints only failures. The weekly
`.github/workflows/release-health.yml` runs both modes and uploads the report.

Only two carrier shapes fail the check, because only two are asserted family-wide:
`src/version.ts`'s exported `VERSION`, and a `VERSION` file where one exists. A `SKILL.md`
version difference is reported as a note — most skills version independently.
## Known limits (stated honestly)

- The K group is a **heuristic static scan**: K1/K3/K4 miss complex wrappers and can also raise false alarms — every warn-level finding needs a human look and never condemns a plugin automatically.
- D3 only proves that "the composition boots as far as a model request"; it **does not prove the tool schemas are valid or the business logic correct** (that needs a keyed e2e run or a mock LLM).
- A pnpm `ignored-builds` block is an environment-recipe problem: when D1 hits it, the check degrades to warn and prints the compat.yml allowBuilds recipe, matching the certification spec v1's environment-blocked line, and it never counts as a plugin defect.
- npm-line hosts (0.1.2-rc.1) have no engines/peerDependencies enforcement in their packument, so R6 is advisory there.
- A measured trap in this environment: a `$` anchor (without the `m` flag) does not match the position before a lone trailing `\r`, so parsing CRLF text must split on `/\r?\n/` (already handled internally — do not regress it).

## Status

Official repository: GitHub `PerryLink/dsh-plugin-doctor` (Apache-2.0), npm `@perrylink/dsh-plugin-doctor`.
**Current version 0.4.6**, published to npm. Releases go out through **npm Trusted
Publishing (OIDC)** — no long-lived token — after the `NPM_TOKEN` secret expired
and blocked the 0.2.4 and 0.3.0 attempts. See `CHANGELOG.md`. CI usage
(**please use the ASCII aliases**):

```powershell
npx --yes @perrylink/dsh-plugin-doctor@0.5.0 --repo . --no-smoke --only "R,K"
```

Or as a **GitHub Action** — no install step, no copied workflow file:

```yaml
- uses: PerryLink/dsh-plugin-doctor@v0.4.6
  with:
    only: R,K
```

**43 PerryLink repositories** ship the gate, and the whole fleet was moved onto one
byte-identical template pinned to the current version on 2026-09-23/24, after the
change was verified against every gated repository first. New adopters should pin
the **newest published** version — currently 0.4.6.

> **Honest status: there are no external adopters yet.** That, not catalogue
> coverage, is what limits this project — it is already in 33+ directories
> including every high-star one. Measurements and the reasoning are in
> [`OUTREACH.md`](OUTREACH.md) §C4.

> Every 0.2.0 change is **additive** (new fields / new options / new exit codes); the criteria for the existing 37 repos are unchanged, verified against the 37-repo baseline with **diffs = 0**.

# dsh-provider-proxy

[![CI](https://github.com/apolenkov/dsh-provider-proxy/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/apolenkov/dsh-provider-proxy/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@apolenkov/dsh-provider-proxy?style=flat-square&logo=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@apolenkov/dsh-provider-proxy)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-yellow?style=flat-square)](./LICENSE)
[![Node >= 22](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22-339933?style=flat-square&logo=node.js&logoColor=white)](./package.json)
[![DSH ^0.2.1-rc.2](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%5E0.2.1--rc.2-4D6BFE?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
[![Tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-41%20passing-brightgreen?style=flat-square)](#development)

Per-provider and per-model outbound proxy routing for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

DeepSeek Harness applies **one** proxy policy per process (`HTTP_PROXY` / `HTTPS_PROXY` / `NO_PROXY` / `ALL_PROXY`). This plugin layers two routing axes on top of it, configurable per provider host and per model ID — from a Plugins settings page, without touching YAML unless you want to.

```text
ctx.llm.stream({ provider, model })
        │  llm/stream waterfall → AsyncLocalStorage store per stream pull
        ▼
   adapter → globalThis.fetch
        ▼
   RoutingDispatcher (this plugin)
        ├─ model rule matched?  → direct / proxy / inherit
        ├─ host rule matched?   → direct / proxy / inherit
        ├─ loopback?            → always direct
        └─ otherwise            → the launcher’s policy (env + NO_PROXY)
```

- **Host axis** (`providers`): matches the request URL host — exact, subdomains, optional `host:port`. Applies to every `fetch()` in the process (LLM, web search, MCP).
- **Model axis** (`models`): matches the `provider`/`model` pair of the model call that issued the request. Exact ids and trailing-`*` prefixes, with an optional provider pin.
- **Precedence**: provider-pinned exact model → bare exact model → provider-pinned prefix → bare prefix → provider host rule → `default` (`inherit` or `direct`).

## Install

Prerequisite: a DSH profile with a plugin manager (the Desktop app and `dsh web` both qualify).

**From npm** (recommended):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @apolenkov/dsh-provider-proxy
```

**From git** (a release tag, no registry involved):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add git+https://github.com/apolenkov/dsh-provider-proxy.git#v0.1.0
```

**From a local checkout:**

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/dsh-provider-proxy
# or: link the directory in the profile's package.json and run pnpm install there
```

Then restart DSH. The bundle inserts the `provider-proxy` row; routes live in that row's config.

> npm note: the package is `@apolenkov/dsh-provider-proxy`; the unscoped name `dsh-provider-proxy` belongs to an unrelated package on the public registry, so never `pnpm add dsh-provider-proxy`.

## Configure

### In the UI (recommended)

Open **Plugins** in the sidebar → open the **dsh-provider-proxy** bundle → **Configure**. The page shows:

- **Default route** (`inherit` or `direct`);
- **Provider rules**: label, hosts (comma or newline separated), proxy (`inherit` / `direct` / custom `http(s)://` URL);
- **Model rules**: model id (exact or trailing `*`), optional provider pin, proxy.

Edits are staged locally and applied on **Save** with revision fencing: if someone changed the config meanwhile, the save is refused instead of silently overwriting. Clearing the form is never written; leaving the page drops staged edits.

### In YAML

Add or edit the row in the profile’s `cordis.patch.yml` (HMR applies it live, no restart):

```yaml
- id: provider-proxy
  name: "dsh-provider-proxy"
  config:
    default: inherit
    providers:
      corp:
        hosts: ["llm.internal.example"]
        proxy: direct
      opencode-go:
        hosts: ["opencode.ai"]
        proxy: "http://127.0.0.1:1301"
    models:
      "muse-spark-1.3-contributor":
        provider: opencode-go
        proxy: "http://127.0.0.1:1301"
      "longcat-*": inherit
```

An invalid entry refuses the whole configuration (fail-closed): the plugin logs the reason, keeps the previous routes, and never partially applies them.

### Proxy values

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `inherit` | Use the launcher’s process proxy policy (env + `NO_PROXY`). |
| `direct` | Connect to the origin directly, ignoring the process proxy policy. |
| `http(s)://…` | Route through that proxy (`ProxyAgent`). SOCKS and PAC are rejected. |

The UI additionally refuses proxy URLs with embedded credentials — keep secrets out of the profile patch.

## Muse Spark example

Route one model through its own proxy while everything else follows the launcher policy:

```yaml
- id: provider-proxy
  name: "dsh-provider-proxy"
  config:
    default: inherit
    models:
      "muse-spark-1.3-contributor":
        provider: opencode-go
        proxy: "http://127.0.0.1:1291"
```

See [`examples/models-muse-spark.yaml`](./examples/models-muse-spark.yaml) (sanitized: loopback endpoints, no credentials). The same rule can be created in the Plugins page — the walkthrough is captured with [`assets/scripts/record-proxy-ui.sh`](./assets/scripts/record-proxy-ui.sh) into [`assets/gifs`](./assets/gifs/).

## Verify it works

The plugin writes its last apply outcome (never secrets) to `$DSH_HOME/provider-proxy/state.json`:

```json
{
  "appliedAt": "2026-10-22T07:59:22Z",
  "pid": 42120,
  "status": "active",
  "routes": "muse-spark-1.3-contributor→http://127.0.0.1:1301, llm.internal.example→direct, default→inherit"
}
```

A live rule can be proven by pointing it at a dead proxy (`http://127.0.0.1:9`) and watching the request fail with `ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:9` instead of reaching its target — then restore the real proxy.

## Limits

- WebSocket transports are not guaranteed to pass through the undici dispatcher; use an `http`/`https` transport for strict routing.
- `web_fetch` pins validated addresses through the launcher's own policy and may bypass these routes; model traffic is covered.
- Model rules apply only inside `llm/stream`; web search and MCP use the host axis.
- A model rule never fires for non-model traffic that happens to hit the same host, and a host rule never overrides `localhost` / loopback.
- Proxy URLs with credentials are accepted by the transport but rejected by the UI; prefer credential-free proxy endpoints.

## Walkthrough

![Proxy routes settings page: provider and Muse Spark model rules, an inline validation error, and a successful save](assets/gifs/proxy-ui.gif)

Recorded in a scratch profile with a loopback proxy: open the bundle’s Configure page, add the Muse Spark model rule, trigger and fix a validation error, save. Individual frames live in [`assets/screenshots/`](./assets/screenshots/); reproduce or re-record with [`assets/scripts/record-proxy-ui.sh`](./assets/scripts/record-proxy-ui.sh).

## Publishing

Owner-side checklist for the first public release (repository URL, npm scope, market index,
hub listing): [docs/publishing.md](./docs/publishing.md). Automated gates:

```sh
pnpm check:release   # strict manifest + secrets + generated market index + tests
pnpm release:market  # writes market/dsh-market.json from package.json + HEAD
```

## Development

```sh
pnpm install --ignore-scripts   # or: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm test                       # node:test, 41 tests: matching, precedence, ALS isolation, egress, wiring, volatile updates, agent retirement, client contract, UI form logic
pnpm check                      # manifest + secrets + market validation + full test suite
```

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md) (workflow, commit style, release checklist), [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md), and [docs/](./docs/) — an index with architecture, configuration reference, UI guide, publishing checklist, marketplace notes, troubleshooting, and a glossary.

## Marketplace

To list this plugin in a DSH market, ship a format-1 index validated with `pnpm check:market`. A documented example lives in [`market/dsh-market.example.json`](./market/dsh-market.example.json); production indexes must replace the example repository URL and commit. Listing on community hubs (e.g. [dsh.market](https://dsh.market/)) additionally requires the `dsh-plugin` topic on the GitHub repository or a submission through the hub’s own flow — see [docs/marketplace.md](./docs/marketplace.md).

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](./LICENSE). DeepSeek Harness itself is a separate project by DeepSeek; this plugin is community work and is not affiliated with or endorsed by them.

# dsh-gxworks

仓库：<https://github.com/Arienax/dsh-gxworks> · 市场索引：<https://arienax.github.io/dsh-gxworks/index.json>

把 [GXWorks Agent](https://github.com/Arienax/gxworks-agent) 的 **MCP 服务**和 **路由 Skill** 打包成
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 插件。安装一次，Harness 里的 Agent
就能对三菱 PLC 工程做只读检查、程序生成、离线 `.gxw` 编辑、后台原生编译检查和 Simulator2 观察。

English: [README.en.md](README.en.md)

## 插件做了什么

这一层 bundle patch 插入两行插件，两者互相独立、可分别停用：

| 行 | 插件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `gxworks-mcp` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` | 以 stdio 启动本机 GXWorks Agent MCP，工具在会话里呈现为 `mcp__gxworks__<原始工具名>` |
| `gxworks-skills` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem` | 注册一个只扫描本包 `skills/` 的独立技能源（`providerName: gxworks`），带进 `gxworks-mcp-router` 技能 |

`launch/mcp-launch.mjs` 负责把 Windows 上的安装形态收敛成一个命令：它先找安装根
（`--agent-root` → `GXWORKS_AGENT_ROOT` → 从工作目录向上找），再依次尝试
`GXWorks-Agent-MCP.exe`、`.venv-mcp`、`.venv`、`py -3`、`python`，并在调用方没有指定模式时补上 `--local`。
它的 stdout 只承载 MCP 协议数据，诊断一律写 stderr。

## 目录结构

```
dsh-gxworks/
├── package.json            bundle 清单（dsh.bundle.patch、locale/icon 导出）
├── cordis.patch.yml        插件行：MCP 连接 + 技能源
├── launch/mcp-launch.mjs   stdio 启动器（安装根解析、模式默认值、arg 透传）
├── skills/
│   └── gxworks-mcp-router/ 上游技能原样副本（SKILL.md + references/）
├── locale/{en,zh}.json     插件管理页的标题与说明
├── icon.svg                插件图标
├── scripts/sync-skill.mjs  从 GXWorks Agent 检出重新同步技能
└── tests/launch.test.mjs   启动器解析顺序的单元测试
```

## 前置条件

- Windows。原生编译、GX Works2 界面交互与 Simulator2 采样依赖本机安装的三菱软件；
  纯 Python Core 的读取、生成与静态检查不需要它们。
- 本机存在 GXWorks Agent：源码检出（含 `.venv` 与 `scripts/mcp_entry.py`）或 MCP 独立发布包（含
  `GXWorks-Agent-MCP.exe`）。
- DeepSeek Harness profile（Web 或 CLI），Node.js ≥ 22.12。

## 安装

先在命令行里登记本机安装根。Harness 的工作目录通常在自身源码或其他工程里，不一定紧邻 GXWorks Agent，
所以这一步是一次性、跨会话生效的：

```powershell
node launch/mcp-launch.mjs --set-root D:\gxworks-agent
node launch/mcp-launch.mjs --print-plan      # 核对解析结果
```

它把路径写入 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-gxworks\settings.json`；目录里必须存在
`GXWorks-Agent-MCP.exe` 或 `scripts\mcp_entry.py`，否则直接拒绝。也可以用环境变量
`GXWORKS_AGENT_ROOT` 代替，或把工作目录放在安装目录之内。

然后在 Harness 里装这个包（未发布 npm 时用源码安装形式，`--profile` 换成你自己在用的 profile）：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Arienax/dsh-gxworks
```

发布到 npm 之后，等价命令是 `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-gxworks`。

也可以在本机源码检出目录里用插件管理器按绝对路径链装：

```
plugin_manager(action: install_bundle, target: "D:\\dsh-gxworks")
```

或者手动把本包加入 profile：在 profile 的 `package.json` 里把它登记到 `dsh.profile.bundles`，
让 `cordis.patch.yml` 进入层栈。安装后确认三件事：

1. 插件列表里 `gxworks-mcp` 与 `gxworks-skills` 两行都是 active；
2. 工具列表出现 `mcp__gxworks__*`，例如 `mcp__gxworks__list_projects`；
3. 技能目录出现 `gxworks-mcp-router`。

安装失败时先看 Harness 日志里 `dsh-gxworks` / `mcp-client(gxworks)` 的输出，再按下文排错。

## 配置

启动器读取的环境变量：

| 变量 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `GXWORKS_AGENT_ROOT` | GXWorks Agent 安装根，优先于已记住的路径 |
| `GXWORKS_AGENT_HOME` | 同上，兼容旧名 |
| `GXWORKS_MCP_EXE` | 直接指定 `GXWorks-Agent-MCP.exe`，跳过安装根解析 |
| `GXWORKS_MCP_WORKSPACE_DIR` | `local` 模式的工程工作区；不设时用 GXWorks Agent 的默认 MCP 工作区 |
| `GXWORKS_AGENT_SERVICE_URL` | `service` 模式的本地 Web 源，默认 `http://127.0.0.1:8765` |
| `PLC_WEB_AGENT_TOKEN` | `service` 模式的 Agent 令牌（通常由 GXWorks Agent 写入 Credential Manager） |

安装根的完整解析顺序：`--agent-root` → `GXWORKS_AGENT_ROOT` / `GXWORKS_AGENT_HOME` →
`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-gxworks\settings.json` → 工作目录及其上级 → `PATH` 上的
`GXWorks-Agent-MCP.exe`。`--print-plan` 会打印最终命令与 `agentRootSource`。

除环境变量外，其余参数直接写进 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `args`。`args` 是一个表达式返回的数组，
在数组里追加参数即可，例如连接已启动的 Web 工作台：

```yaml
        args: !!js "(() => { const p = process.getBuiltinModule('node:path'); const u = process.getBuiltinModule('node:url'); return [p.join(u.fileURLToPath(baseUrl), 'launch', 'mcp-launch.mjs'), '--service']; })()"
```

常用的透传参数：

| 参数 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `--local` | 独立工程运行时，编辑直接保存为版本（默认） |
| `--service` | 连接已启动的 Web 工作台，按工作台审批策略出提案 |
| `--workspace <dir>` | 指定工程工作区 |
| `--project <id>` / `--version <id>` | 固定选中的工程与版本 |
| `--state-dir <dir>` | 独立运行时的状态目录（必须在工作区之外） |
| `--approval-mode ask\|auto\|full` | 操作者显式给出的外部操作许可；`full` 还需 `--confirm-full-access` |

此外还有本插件自己的三个参数，只在命令行上使用，不会传给 MCP 服务：
`--set-root <dir>`（记住安装根）、`--agent-root <dir>`（本次使用指定安装根）、`--print-plan`（只打印解析结果）。

`toolCallTimeoutMs` 在 patch 里设为 10 分钟，因为原生编译、冷重开和波形采样都会超过默认的 60 秒；
连接中断由 `reconnect` 自动重试，`failOnStartupError: false` 保证本机没装三菱软件时 Harness 仍能启动。

## 工具与技能

- MCP 工具覆盖工程选择与结果、源码发现与静态分析、生成与离线编辑、FBD/ST/SFC、原生工程与编译分析、
  Simulator2 观察。完整清单与参数以连接后的 `tools/list` 为准。
- `gxworks-mcp-router` 技能记录按任务意图选入口工具、参数要点与调用顺序，覆盖
  `local` / `service` / `context` 三种接入模式的回执判读。它只在需要时加载，不占常驻上下文。

原生写操作、界面交互与 PLC 运行语义分别取证：编译通过不等于运行正确，`local` 模式保存版本也不等于
已经过工作台复核。

## 验证与排错

```powershell
# 登记安装根，并看启动器为当前机器解析出的命令
node launch/mcp-launch.mjs --set-root D:\gxworks-agent
node launch/mcp-launch.mjs --print-plan

# 在 GXWorks Agent 目录里验证 Python 侧运行时
.venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts\mcp_entry.py --local --check
```

| 现象 | 处理 |
| --- | --- |
| 日志提示“未找到本机 GXWorks Agent 安装目录” | 运行 `--set-root`，或设置 `GXWORKS_AGENT_ROOT` |
| 日志提示 Python 运行时不可用 | 在安装目录创建 `.venv` 并 `pip install -r requirements/mcp.txt`，或改用独立发布包 |
| 日志提示 `serverName "gxworks" is already in use` | profile 里还有另一个 `mcp-client` 行用了同名 `serverName`，改成唯一名字 |
| 工具调用超时 | 原生编译等慢操作调大 `toolCallTimeoutMs`；写入状态不明时先用 `get_operation_status` 核对 |
| 技能目录里没有 `gxworks-mcp-router` | 确认 `gxworks-skills` 行处于启用状态，且 `<包目录>/skills/gxworks-mcp-router/SKILL.md` 存在 |

## 卸载

```
plugin_manager(action: remove_bundle, target: "dsh-gxworks")
```

或从 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 移除本包。卸载只影响 Harness 侧的连接与技能，
不改动 GXWorks Agent 的工程、状态目录或 GX Works2 安装。

## 插件市场

本仓库同时是一份自建插件市场索引，托管在 GitHub Pages：

```
https://arienax.github.io/dsh-gxworks/index.json
```

在 Harness 里打开「插件」页 → 实验性插件里开启 **Custom plugin markets** → 在「发现」的**索引源**里加上这个
URL，就能看到并安装 `dsh-gxworks`。索引只描述本仓库，安装仍走 `plugin_manager` 并需要你确认；条目里的版本
固定到具体 Git 提交，DSH 兼容性由 `engines.dsh` 声明（当前 `>=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0`）。

索引是生成物：`market/plugins.txt` 是来源列表，`docs/index.json` 由 DSH 自带的生成器写出并已通过其校验器。

```powershell
cd D:\dsh\deepseek-harness
pnpm --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market-generator start `
  --input D:\dsh-gxworks\market\plugins.txt `
  --output D:\dsh-gxworks\docs\index.json `
  --title "GXWorks Agent Plugins" `
  --description "GXWorks Agent 的 MCP 服务与 PLC 任务路由技能，供 DeepSeek Harness 使用。"
```

发版顺序是：改 `package.json` 的 `version` → 提交并推送 → 重新生成索引 → 提交 `docs/index.json`。
生成器只读已推送的提交，未推送的改动不会进入索引。

## 开发

```powershell
npm test          # 启动器解析顺序的单元测试
npm run check     # 语法检查 + 测试
npm run sync-skill -- --source D:\gxworks-agent
```

`skills/gxworks-mcp-router/` 是上游技能的原样副本，由 `scripts/sync-skill.mjs` 重新同步并写入来源说明；
上游技能是唯一事实来源，本仓库不在此处改写技能内容。

## 许可与来源

本仓库中由本项目作者编写的源码、文档与配置采用 [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE)。
`skills/gxworks-mcp-router/` 来自 `Arienax/gxworks-agent`（Apache-2.0），来源与同步提交记录在
[COPYING.md](skills/gxworks-mcp-router/COPYING.md)。

本插件不分发 GX Works2、Mitsubishi Electric 软件、厂商手册或商标内容；原生功能依赖用户自备的合法安装。

# `@phoenix-ai/dsh-base` English | [中文](README.zh.md) The shared dsh core as a profile bundle: [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml) inserts every base plugin row — model adapters, the shared [`agent-default-model`](../../core/agent-default-model/README.md) selection, tools, persistence, policy, settings/credentials, telemetry, and the core spawn/fork subagent providers — over the empty profile root, as the first layer of every profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` list. The optional Codex and Claude Code providers stay outside this package and its production dependency closure; a Profile installs either [product provider Bundle](../../subagent/README.md) only when needed. The default `@phoenix-ai/dsh` production closure therefore includes neither product provider, the Claude Agent SDK, nor the Codex wrapper and platform payloads. Later bundle layers (e.g. [`dsh-web-app`](../web-app/README.md)) and the user's profile `cordis.patch.yml` override these rows by id; a patch replaces a row's whole `config`, so mode-specific values live in mode bundles, not here. The package has no runtime API; the profile composer resolves the patch through the `dsh.bundle.patch` manifest field, never through code. The base also mounts the low-latency [`quality-policy`](../../guard/quality-policy/README.md), which keeps verification evidence fresh across mutations without adding a model round on the compliant path. The host mounts `image_generation` once so existing and newly authored presets inherit it, subject to explicit tool filters. Image backend availability and account limits are checked by the existing image worker. The patch gates both shell stacks by platform on its own rows: `bash-sandbox`/`tool-bash` carry `disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'` (bash has no Windows runner), and their twins `pwsh-sandbox`/`tool-pwsh` mount on win32 only with the inverted expression — one shared patch file, exactly one shell stack per host. The permission surface stays exactly as on POSIX: `sandbox`/`sandbox-policy` enforce the file-effect policy through the Windows ACL restricted-token runner (the win32 chain of `dsh-sandbox-local` → `@phoenix-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl`), the permission switcher and the approval service run unchanged, and `fs-sandbox` keeps fencing `ctx.fs` writes — mounting `dsh-fs-local` alongside it would double-register `ctx.fs` and fail the load. A Windows host that prefers the unconfined local pwsh executor or full access overrides these rows through its profile or home `cordis.patch.yml` (the bash-restore recipe must be complete: disable `pwsh-sandbox`/`tool-pwsh` AND re-enable `bash-sandbox`/`tool-bash` — both executor families register the same `bash` service, so an incomplete recipe fails loud at load). POSIX hosts see the pwsh rows disabled. The optional Home Assistant rows are disabled unless `PHOENIX_HOME_ASSISTANT_URL` is present. Enabling them also requires explicit JSON entity and service allowlists; the token is referenced by environment-variable name and is never stored in the bundle patch. The row set and its rationale are documented inline in the patch file; the [generated composition graph](../../../apps/cli/composition.md) renders it. ## Model Experience Indirectly, through the inserted rows: this bundle selects the shipped persona-less prompt base, tool set, the OpenRouter-backed default model route, and the adapters that mode bundles specialize. It contributes no model-visible text of its own. #### KV Cache effect None directly; each inserted row's package owns its effect. ## Known Limitations and Deferred Work - **A patch replaces whole row configs** — profile overrides must restate every field a row keeps; there is no deep-merge layer. - **The Windows temp grant is a private per-session subdirectory** — `workspace-write` confines writes to the workspace plus the session's own temp subdirectory (`\dsh-`, TMP/TEMP rewritten for confined children); `read-only` grants nothing. See `@phoenix-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl`.

# PHOENIX English | [中文](README.zh.md) **PHOENIX is a universal, provider-agnostic AI agent harness for local-first and bring-your-own-provider workflows.** It is being built around intelligent model selection, durable continuity, repository intelligence, tools, multi-agent execution, recovery, evaluation, and bounded self-improvement. Capabilities land incrementally and are not presented as complete until their repository gates are green. ## Development status PHOENIX is under active development. Its product identity is PHOENIX across the repository presentation, Web UI, PWA metadata, browser title, and visual system. Some internal package and CLI identifiers are intentionally retained for compatibility with the upstream runtime while PHOENIX evolves through isolated, testable downstream layers. Those implementation details do not define the product identity. ## Run ### One-line Windows install Open PowerShell and run: ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arisnachy/phoenix-harnes/main/install-phoenix.ps1 | iex ``` The bootstrap installs missing Node.js/Git through `winget`, clones or fast-forwards the dedicated PHOENIX installation, performs an immutable dependency install and build, and creates **PHOENIX HARDNESS** shortcuts in the Start menu, Windows startup, and the taskbar shortcut store. Windows versions without a localized pin action still receive a taskbar-ready shortcut; pin it once from the shortcut context menu. Use `-NoStartup` or `-NoTaskbar` to opt out. Managed installations check the promoted `stable` branch at launch and apply only clean, preflighted updates; a clean managed release checkout may also safely replace unrelated legacy history while retaining a recovery ref. Set `PHOENIX_AUTO_UPDATE=0` to disable that check. Local changes are preserved instead of overwritten. The script is not a signed MSIX; code signing remains a release gate until a project certificate is configured. ### VS Code and Cursor Build the installable extension with `pnpm --dir apps/vscode run package:vsix`, then install `dist/phoenix-hardness-vscode.vsix` from **Extensions → Install from VSIX**. Its Explorer panel starts the local PHOENIX runtime and opens the Web UI without reading model credentials. ### Run from source Install Node.js 22.19 or newer, then: ```powershell git clone https://github.com/arisnachy/phoenix-harnes.git cd phoenix-harnes .\phoenix-windows.cmd ``` `phoenix-windows.cmd` changes to its own repository directory, uses the Corepack copy included with Node.js to prepare dependencies, builds PHOENIX when needed, and starts the local Web UI. A global `pnpm` installation is not required. ### Stable automatic updates PHOENIX source installations follow the repository's stable update channel. A new `main` commit is published to clients only after the current `main` CI succeeds. Running installations detect the new stable commit and, by default, install it after the active PHOENIX session closes; Windows also checks the stable channel before the next launch. Automatic installation requires an official `origin`, branch `main` or `stable`, a clean worktree, a successful isolated preflight build, and a recovery checkpoint. A locally modified checkout may still prepare and validate a candidate in detached staging, but it is never overwritten or activated until clean. Fast-forward releases use `git merge --ff-only`; managed release checkouts with unrelated legacy history use a guarded `git reset --hard` after preflight. A failed live update rolls back to the previous known-good commit. Development branches and locally modified checkouts are never overwritten automatically, and the updater never mutates PHOENIX user data, credentials, sessions, memories, or projects. Set `PHOENIX_UPDATE_MODE=notify` for notifications without installation or `PHOENIX_UPDATE_MODE=off` to disable checking. See [PHOENIX Stable Auto-Update](docs/evolution/PHOENIX_AUTO_UPDATE.md) for the complete release, recovery, and trust contract. Codex plugin and OpenClaw skill updates use the isolated [upstream intake](docs/evolution/PHOENIX_UPSTREAM_INTAKE.md), which stages and verifies candidates before changing initialized bridges. ### Configure OpenRouter on Windows PHOENIX starts with the `openrouter/free` model route selected. Create an [OpenRouter API key](https://openrouter.ai/settings/keys), then configure it inside PHOENIX: 1. Open **Settings → Models → OpenRouter**. 2. Paste the key and save it. The key is written to the local PHOENIX credential store and is not committed to Git. 3. Use the model selector in the composer to switch from `openrouter/free` to another OpenRouter model. The provider, key, endpoint, model catalog, and active model are managed from the Web UI. Free models are intended for testing and remain subject to OpenRouter availability and rate limits. ### Connect ChatGPT / Codex PHOENIX keeps OpenAI API-key authentication separate from ChatGPT subscription authentication. The native Codex bridge uses the official Codex app-server managed ChatGPT login, so Codex owns OAuth persistence and token refresh. PHOENIX does not ask for a ChatGPT password and does not parse, copy, or persist ChatGPT OAuth tokens. When the native Codex bridge is mounted, **Settings → Models → Account connections** offers **ChatGPT / Codex** sign-in. The same native account plane can read the active ChatGPT plan, Codex rate-limit windows, reset times, and account token-activity data without routing the subscription through the generic `pi-ai` OAuth adapter. ## Community and support Use this repository's [Issues](https://github.com/arisnachy/phoenix-harnes/issues) and [Discussions](https://github.com/arisnachy/phoenix-harnes/discussions) for PHOENIX feedback, bugs, design discussion, and support. ## Contributing See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). ## Development Start with the [development guide](docs/development.md) and [architecture documentation](docs/architecture.md). That plugin resolves the built frontend dist through `@phoenix-ai/dsh-web-frontend`'s exports, samples bind-dependent LAN trust once, provides it as `webRuntime` to the browser-trust fence and client roster, mounts the [`frontend-static`](../../host/frontend-static/README.md) fallback owner, and registers the harness-source and web-surface prompt sections plus the bash-visible `DSH_WEB_URL` runtime variable when `surfaceContext` is true. After its Loader tree settles, it prints the `dsh web:` URL line when `printUrl` is true and opens the canonical host URL in the default browser when `openBrowser` is true and the inherited `SSH_CONNECTION` and `SSH_TTY` are blank or absent. An SSH launch keeps the URL line but suppresses browser handoff because the SSH client or editor owns the local forwarded address. Immediately before a handoff, the runtime prints `dsh web: opening the default browser; pass --no-open to disable`. A short-lived Node helper runs the maintained platform opener with the canonical scrubbed child environment. On Windows it stays alive until the short-lived PowerShell launcher exits, because `open` reports spawn before that launcher has handed the URL to the shell; elsewhere the helper stops after the opener accepts spawn. A helper failure writes a diagnostic with its reason and the manual URL to stderr without stopping the server, and no path waits for the browser to exit.
