It rejects `--host 0.0.0.0` before publishing that service because the CLI intentionally does not support all-interfaces binding yet. Flag-configured rows inject the service and read it directly from lazy config, so nothing binds a port before argument resolution and `dsh --profile web --help` starts no server. [`dsh-headless`](../headless/README.md) is a sibling surface over the same base and does not mount this bundle. ## Model retry defaults Web uses the shared bounded normal default of five eligible retries after the initial request. The `deepseek-official` route and settings-added pi-ai routes use that default when they omit `retryPolicy`; explicit provider policies still win. Web adds no retry-specific composition override, so the same omission behavior applies to non-Web profiles. ## MiniBrowser CDP lifecycle The inline MiniBrowser reuses one loopback CDP WebSocket per Chromium tab and multiplexes commands with request IDs. Viewport setup stays on that connection, concurrent frame requests for the same target share one capture, and a closed target rejects pending work immediately so a stalled preview can recover on the next request. State reads use one tab listing and update the shared descriptor only when its endpoint or selected tab changes. Explicit tab identifiers scope previews to their intended target. Browser actions have a shared deadline and cancel outstanding CDP work when their HTTP client disconnects; cancellation never replays a mutation. ## Model Experience ### Harness-source and Web-surface context #### What the model sees When `surfaceContext` is true, the `harness:source` section identifies the on-disk Harness implementation without claiming it is the working directory, and the `app:web-surface` global section (order −98) orients the model to the GUI: the canonical local URL, the "this page" referent, the update contract (the reload receiver is always on; no-refresh reloads additionally need the `pnpm run dev:web` watcher), and the instruction not to start replacement servers. `DSH_WEB_URL` additionally appears in the managed bash environment with its description, resolved per invocation from the live server. When it is false, neither section nor the variable is registered. #### Token effect One source line and one prompt paragraph per session plus two managed-environment variable lines; constant per process. #### KV Cache effect The prompt section sits near the system prompt's head and is stable for the life of the process (the port is a boot fact), so it does not invalidate the cache across turns. ## Known Limitations and Deferred Work - **The frontend dist must be built** — `require.resolve` of the dist fails loud at activation with a build hint; there is no source-serving fallback. - **`lanAddresses` is a boot-time snapshot** — interface changes after boot are not re-advertised; the printed LAN URL always matches the configured trust fence. - **Only handoff startup is observable** — observation ends when the platform opener accepts spawn, except that Windows waits for its short-lived PowerShell launcher to exit; a later browser exit is not reported, and the printed URL remains the manual fallback. - **SSH forwarding owns the browser URL** — the printed canonical URL names the remote host's loopback endpoint; automatic handoff is suppressed, and the SSH client or editor must expose and open its local forwarded address. - **Browser command overrides are launch-only** — a discovered `.env` may not set `BROWSER`; only an inherited value may reach an opener path that honors the variable, so a checkout cannot choose an executable for automatic handoff.

# dsh-qq-bot —— 把 QQ 接到 DSH Agent

> **当前版本 0.8.x**：要求 **DSH ≥ 0.1.7**，DSH 0.2 已适配（工具走 `ctx.get('tools')` 注入契约）。
> 本仓库就是维护主干 [arrow1031/dsh-qq-bot](https://github.com/arrow1031-dev/dsh-qq-bot)，**已解除封版**：
> 安装跟随 `main`、功能与修复走 PR。需要兼容 DSH 0.1.6 及更早的旧版本（0.6.x）请自行选择早期 tag 下载；
> 早期版本同时想用新功能，请自行处理。

**维护者** [@arrow1031](https://github.com/arrow1031) · **核心贡献者** [@nd002723](https://github.com/nd002723) · **许可** [MIT](LICENSE) · **AI 生成声明** [AI-DISCLOSURE.md](AI-DISCLOSURE.md) · **更新日志** [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)

> **⚠️ 行为约定（0.6.8 起沿用，0.8.x 不变）：bot 不自动附带聊天上下文**
>
> 被 @ / 回复 bot 时，不再自动把群内「最近相关发言」硬塞进会话上下文（省 token、上下文更精简）。
> 需要结合群内近期消息/图片作答时，Agent 会**主动调 `qq_history` 工具**拉取（见 [qq_history 小节](#qq_history聊天记录ai-自取)）。
> 可感知影响：bot 对群内前文的「记忆力」取决于模型是否自觉调工具；若群成员觉得 bot 变迟钝，这是**预期行为**而非故障。

一个可以装进 DSH profile 的插件：QQ 消息进来 → 交给 DSH Agent → 回复发回 QQ。

复用现成生态，不自造协议：

```
QQ 客户端
   │ QQ NT 协议
   ▼
NapCat（或 OneDisc / Lagrange 等 OneBot 11 实现）   ← 登录、收发、风控
   │ OneBot 11：正向 WS / 反向 WS + HTTP API
   ▼

lib/index.js（Cordis 插件入口，0.8 起模块化拆分）
```

## 二、快速开始

### 1. 起一个 OneBot 11 实现（推荐 NapCat）

NapCat 官方 Docker 镜像（**支持 amd64 与 arm64**）：

```sh
docker run -d --name napcat --restart=always \
  -e NAPCAT_GID=$(id -g) -e NAPCAT_UID=$(id -u) \
  -p 3000:3000 -p 3001:3001 -p 6099:6099 \
  mlikiowa/napcat-docker:latest
```

- WebUI：`http://<主机IP>:6099/webui`，用手机 QQ 扫码登录；登录 token 默认在 `docker logs napcat` 里。
- 容器内配置目录 `/app/napcat/config`，QQ 数据目录 `/app/.config/QQ`（想固化登录就挂这两个卷）。
- 在 NapCat 的「网络配置」里确认 **OneBot 11**：
  - **HTTP 服务器** `3000` —— 用来发消息
  - **正向 WebSocket** `3001` —— 用来收事件
  - 若设了 `access_token`，记下来填进插件配置
- 端口默认就是 3000/3001，和本插件默认值一致，**不用改代码**。

### 2. 安装插件

本插件**不在 npm 上**，从本仓库或 Release 附件装（维护仓库：<https://github.com/arrow1031-dev/dsh-qq-bot>）：

```sh
# 跟随 main（已解除封版：升级即最新，不锁 tag）
# 升级已有安装：dsh plugin --profile web update
dsh plugin --profile web add github:arrow1031-dev/dsh-qq-bot

# 本地 tarball（自己改了代码之后）
npm pack
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-qq-bot-<版本号>.tgz
```

`--profile` 换成你实际在用的 profile：**桌面版是 `--profile desktop`**，`dsh web` 部署一般是 `--profile web`。

`dsh plugin` 本质是 pnpm 的前置封装：装完包后，它会**自动把声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch` 的依赖加入 profile 的层栈**（本包的 package.json 已声明），并连同唯一的运行时依赖 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 一起装上。装完**重启 DSH（桌面版重启应用 / CLI 重启 `dsh web`）**生效。

> **版本要求**：0.8.x 要求 DSH ≥ 0.1.7；DSH 0.2.x 已适配（见下文「DSH 0.2 兼容」）。

> **升级注意**：`dsh plugin add` 走 pnpm，按 tarball **完整性哈希**缓存——改了代码要打成**新版本号文件名**再装（0.8.0 → 0.8.1），沿用旧名会被判「已最新」跳过。
> `lib/client.js` 是浏览器侧代码，装完重启后还要**刷新浏览器页面**才加载新 bundle。

### 3. 在 QQ 里试

- **群聊**：默认要 **@机器人** 才有反应，`@` 会被去掉再交给 Agent。
  - **回复（引用）机器人的消息**也视同 @ 处理（`reply.botReply`，默认开启），带图照常走识图流程。
  - **需要结合群内近期消息/图片作答时，AI 会主动调 `qq_history` 工具自取**（不再自动硬塞上下文）——识别窗口锚定触发本条回复的那条消息往前 `scopeMessages` 条，最多 `imageLimit` 张图（默认 5/3，设置页可调）。
  - **回复别人 + 正文 @bot**：同样触发（引用回复），上下文同样交给 AI 自取。
  - **bot 被点名时（@ / 回复 bot / 命令前缀 / 管理指令）**：回复统一**引用你的消息**（QQ 引用回复）。
- **私聊**：默认直接回。
- 长回复按换行切成 ≤1200 字多条发送。
- 每个群/每个人是独立的 DSH 会话（id 形如 `qqbot-group-33333`），会落盘并出现在 Web UI 会话列表里，可以像普通会话一样打开继续聊。
- 新会话的**显示名固定为 `群聊_<群号>` / `私聊_<QQ号>`**（`session.fixedName`，默认开启），不再让 LLM 自动起标题；已建会话保持原名。

## 三、两种连接模式，怎么选

| 场景 | 用哪个 | 配置 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| NapCat 和 DSH 在同一台机器/同一容器 | **正向 WS**（默认） | `mode: forward`，我们连 `ws://127.0.0.1:3001` |
| NapCat 在别的容器/主机，或网络方向只允许 NapCat 连出来 | **反向 WS** | `mode: reverse`，我们在 `0.0.0.0:6199` 监听，NapCat 里填 `ws://<DSH主机IP>:6199/` |

反向 WS 的鉴权：请求头 `Authorization: Bearer <token>` 或 URL 上的 `?access_token=<token>` 都接受（后者是因为浏览器/Node 的标准 WebSocket 客户端无法自定义请求头）。

## 四、配置

### 方式一：在 DSH 设置里改（推荐）

重启 `dsh web` 后，打开 **设置 → QQ 机器人**，所有配置都在这一个选项卡里：
连接方式、WS/HTTP 地址、access_token、群聊开关与 @ 要求、白名单、命令前缀、
身份权限（QQ 号、preset 分流、工具闸）、群管理、会话（独立会话、固定命名、preset）、
回复分片长度、慢回复提示、来源前缀、逐帧日志、
图片视觉（开关 / provider / model / 最多张数 / 下载超时）、联网搜索（代理 / 端点 / key）、
生图（接口地址 / key / 模型 / 重试与轮询）、人格（开关 / 名字 / 设定 / 自定义 preset id）。
设置页按功能分组排列：接入与范围 → 身份与权限 → 群管理 → 会话 → 回复 → 图片视觉 → 联网搜索。

- 改完点「保存」；**连接方式那几项**（模式/地址/token）保存后会自动重启适配器，其它项下一条消息生效。
- 类型映射：布尔是勾选框；白名单是逗号分隔的文本框；连接方式是下拉框。
- **配置落点（DSH ≥ 0.1.7）**：插件把自己的 `Config` schema 交给 DSH 当设置表单，界面上的改动由 DSH
  写进 **profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`**（也就是下面「方式二」里那个文件）；0.1.6 时代的独立
  `settings.yaml` 文档已经不存在了。
- 设置命名空间就是**条目 id**（默认 `dsh-qq-bot`）；条目被改名时，客户端会回退匹配「以 qq-bot 结尾」的那个命名空间。
- 连接状态不在设置页里显示，在对话里让 Agent 调用 `qqbot` 工具（`action=status`）看。
- `access_token` 是**只写**字段：已设置时页面显示「已设置；留空则保持不变」，只有输入新值才会覆盖。
  Host 侧把它声明成 schema 的 secret，值不会下发到浏览器，保存时也不会被空值清掉。

### 工作区（自动管理，无需配置）

Agent 会话的工作目录**不需要任何配置**：插件读取 DSH 官方默认 Workspace 的位置
（`<系统 Documents>/deepseek-harness`），在它的同级目录自动创建 `QQ_msg` 作为工作区根，
并注册为 DSH workspace——**Web UI 会话侧栏的「QQ 消息」分组**，新 QQ 会话自动归入该分组：

- Windows：`C:\Users\<用户名>\Documents\deepseek-harness\QQ_msg`
- Linux / macOS：`~/Documents/deepseek-harness/QQ_msg`（系统没有 Documents 目录时退到 `~/deepseek-harness/QQ_msg`）

带图消息的原图缓存放在 `QQ_msg/qq-images/<会话id>/`，**会话结算后自动删除该缓存**，
会话与工作区本身保留。旧的 `workspace` 配置项已废弃移除。

### 方式二：改 composition 行配置（当 base 层用）

**不要改包内的 `cordis.patch.yml`**（升级会覆盖）。写进你自己的
`$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` —— 它在所有 bundle 之后应用，按 id 定向覆盖：

```yaml
- id: dsh-qq-bot
  config:
    mode: forward                 # forward | reverse（工作区自动管理，见上文）
    onebot:
      wsUrl: 'ws://127.0.0.1:3001'      # mode=forward 用
      listen: '0.0.0.0:6199'            # mode=reverse 用
      httpUrl: 'http://127.0.0.1:3000'  # 留空则改用 WS action 发消息
      accessToken: ''
    group:
      enabled: true
      requireAt: true             # 群里是否必须 @
      allow: []                   # 群号白名单，空数组 = 所有群
    private:
      enabled: true
      allow: []                   # 用户号白名单，空数组 = 所有人
    commandPrefix: ''             # 例如 '/ai'，空串 = 不限制
    reply:
      maxChars: 1200
      ackAfterMs: 8000            # 慢回合先回「正在处理」；0 关闭
      ackText: '正在处理，请稍候…'
      contextHeader: true         # 给消息加 "[QQ群 123 · 小明(22222)]" 前缀
      firstTurnHint: '（提示：这是一次 QQ 聊天。请用简体中文、简洁自然的口语作答；不要输出 Markdown 表格，代码块保持简短。）'
    auth:                         # 权限，见「五、权限与群管理」
      owners: []                  # 拥有者 QQ：全权限 + 永久授权 + 可走独立会话
      superAdmins: []             # 后台设定的高级管理员（不可永久授权）
      ownerPreset: ''             # 填了才把拥有者/非拥有者分成两条会话
      guestPreset: ''             # 非拥有者用的 preset（仅人格分离，非安全边界）
      guestDshTools: false        # 是否允许访客用 DSH 内部工具（默认否）
      guestToolAllow: ['qqbot', 'qqgroup', 'qq_websearch', 'qq_webfetch', 'qq_imgsearch', 'qq_history']   # 访客仍可用的工具白名单
      grantTtlMinutes: 60         # 群管理员动态授权默认时长
      grantMaxTtlMinutes: 1440    # 群管理员单次可授最长
    admin:
      enabled: true
      manageGroups: []            # 可管理的群；空 = 回退用 group.allow
      requireGroupAdmin: true     # 是否承认「本群管理员」这一路权限
      prefix: '/'                 # 指令前缀（必须在消息首位）
      dryRun: false               # true = 只回复将执行什么
      allowConsole: false         # 允许 Web UI 会话直接调用管理工具
    session:
      fixedName: true             # 固定新建会话名为 群聊_<群号> / 私聊_<QQ号>（不再 LLM 自动起标题）
    perChatSession: true          # true=每个 QQ 会话一个 DSH 会话
    agentPreset: ''               # ''=部署默认 preset；可填自定义 preset id 换人格/工具
    adapterPath: ''               # ''=用包内自带适配器
    nodePath: ''                  # ''=自动解析 node
    logAdapterFrames: false       # 排查时开，会打印每一帧 JSON
    vision:
      enabled: true               # 图片视觉：收到图片时用视觉模型识别并并入回复
      provider: ''                # 视觉 provider 路由（留空 = 会话模型；复用 DSH 自定义 providers）
      model: ''                   # 视觉模型 id（留空 = 会话模型；官方如 deepseek-flash）
      maxImages: 3                # 单条消息最多送入的图片数
      downloadTimeoutMs: 10000    # 图片下载超时（毫秒）
    webSearch:                    # qq_websearch 联网搜索
      proxy: ''                   # http://host:port；留空 = 直连；搜索与 url 抓取都走它
      baseUrl: ''                 # 留空 = https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic/v1（仅 multiEngine=false 用）
      apiKeyEnv: ''               # 留空 = DEEPSEEK_BALANCE_API_KEY（自动读 DSH 凭据服务）
      maxUses: 5                  # 每次搜索最多触发次数
      multiEngine: true           # 多引擎组合搜索（默认开）：Tavily → DuckDuckGo → Yandex/Bing/Wikipedia
                                  # 全部走上方 proxy；关闭则落回官方 DeepSeek web_search
    moli:                         # dsh-moli 接管（qq_webfetch 用 Moli 渲染）
      enabled: false              # 默认关；开启后 qq_webfetch 改用 Moli 无头浏览器渲染抓取（可抓 SPA/JS 页；需已安装 moli 引擎，否则无效）
      proxy: ''                   # http://host:port；留空自动透传 webSearch.proxy
      exePath: ''                 # moli 可执行文件路径；留空自动探测 ~/.local/bin/moli 与 PATH
    history:                      # qq_history 聊天记录（AI 自取）
      scopeMessages: 5              # 识别窗口：触发消息往前最多多少条
      imageLimit: 3                 # 窗口内最多识别多少张图（最近的优先）
    imageGen:                     # qq_draw 生图（自填接口，插件不带 key）
      enabled: false              # 打开后 AI 才能画图
      baseUrl: ''                 # OpenAI 兼容，例 https://api.example.com/v1（请求 地址/images/generations）
      apiKey: ''                  # 只写字段；留空则读下面那个环境变量
      apiKeyEnv: IMAGE_API_KEY
      model: seedream-5.0-lite
      size: 1024x1024
      timeoutMs: 180000          # 单次请求超时
      maxAttempts: 4             # 失败重试次数（含首次；429/5xx/网络/空结果）
      retryIntervalMs: 5000
      poll: true                 # 供应商返回 task_id 时继续轮询
      pollIntervalMs: 5000
      maxPolls: 30
    persona:                      # 自定义人格：每个新会话第一轮附一次
      enabled: false
      name: ''
      text: ''
    agentPresetCustom: ''         # 自定义 preset id（如 qq）；非空时优先于 agentPreset
    imgSearch:                    # qq_imgsearch 图片反搜
      enabled: true               # 默认开；关闭后工具返回「已关闭」
      maxResults: 5               # 每次反搜最多返回结果数
      saucenaoKey: ''             # SauceNAO API key（saucenao.com 注册可得）；留空不启用
      weightedShuffle: false      # 有代理时按体量权重随机重排引擎顺序（避免固定引擎一直打头）
                                  # 请求全走上方 webSearch.proxy：无代理 = 直连引擎按可用性优先
                                  # （TraceMoe → IQDB）；有代理 = 放开全部可用引擎按用户体量优先
                                  # （Yandex → Tineye → Copyseeker → SauceNAO → IQDB → TraceMoe）
```

`agentPreset` 是换人格的正规做法：给 QQ 机器人做一个专属 preset，把 id 填进来。

### 图片视觉（vision）

收到图片时用视觉模型识别并并入 Agent 输入（原图缓存到 `<QQ_msg>/qq-images/<会话id>/`，会话结算后删除）。
`provider` / `model` 留空 = 会话模型；也可以给视觉单独指定 provider / model。

**官方视觉模型（DeepSeek API）**：`deepseek-flash` 接受图片与文本（OpenAI 兼容，base64 data URL 或图片 URL 均可，支持 JPEG / PNG / GIF / WebP）。
旧的 `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` 名字**已退役**，但请求仍被接受（由最新 Flash 服务）。见 [DeepSeek Vision 文档](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/vision/)。

其它 OpenAI 兼容通道：选一个在 DSH providers 里声明了 `input: [text, image]` 的模型即可；
注意 `deepseek-v4-flash-0731` 这类默认模型实测**不真正支持图片**（图不进上下文、会编造解释），换视觉模型时务必确认声明了图片输入。

## 五、权限与群管理

权限是**三路并行取并集**（不是"先命中先返回"）：

| 路径 | 谁 | 能做什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 静态名单 `auth.owners` | 拥有者 | 全部权限 + **永久授权** + 可走独立的拥有者会话 |
| 静态名单 `auth.superAdmins` | 后台设定的高级管理员 | 群管理权限（**不能**永久授权） |
| 动态授权 | 被临时授权的人 | 仅被授予的那几项，**仅限本群**、带时限 |
| 本群身份 | 该群的 admin / owner | 群管理权限（可用 `admin.requireGroupAdmin` 关掉这一路） |

任一路给到某项权限即拥有它；来源会在 `/whoami`、`/perms` 里如实列出，便于排查"他为什么有权"。

权限项：`query`（查询）、`mute`（禁言）、`kick`（踢人）、`recall`（撤回）、`settings`（群名/名片/管理员/全员禁言）、`grant`（给本群成员授权），拥有者另有 `permanent`（永久授权）。

### 动态授权（群维度，不可跨群）

- 拥有者或**本群管理员**可以给本群成员临时授权：`/grant @某人 mute 30`（30 分钟）
- 只有**拥有者**能永久授权：`/grant @某人 kick forever`（非拥有者发这条会被拒）
- 群管理员单次最长 `auth.grantMaxTtlMinutes`（默认 1440 分钟）
- 授权键是「群号 + QQ 号」：**在 A 群授的权，在 B 群一律无效**
- `/revoke @某人 [权限]` 撤销、`/grants` 列出本群全部授权

### 非拥有者不使用 DSH 内部功能：执行级工具闸

用一个 `tools.guard` 硬闸，**只在建会话时注册一次**，判据是闭包里的可变标志位：

- 注册在 `agent.ctx` 上 → 只作用于该会话的 agent
- 每次工具执行时才求值 → 拥有者/访客交替说话**不需要增删限制**
- 用**白名单**（`auth.guestToolAllow`，默认 `qqbot,qqgroup,qq_websearch,qq_webfetch,qq_imgsearch,qq_history`）→ `run_code`（PTC 保留传输）这类"不在全局层"的特殊工具也会被自动挡住；访客联网统一走 `qq_websearch`（搜索）与 `qq_webfetch`（抓网页），DSH 自带的 `web_fetch` 已从默认白名单移除
- 被拦时返回拒绝原因，模型会把它转达给用户（最多多一次"被拒绝的调用"往返）

因此它同时满足：**0 额外 token**（不注入提示词、不改工具表、不记 `request/header`）、**单会话单历史**、**不改 DSH 本身**。

想放开就设 `auth.guestDshTools: true`（不建议）。

> 为什么不用"每条消息增删 `tools.restrict`"：`restrict` 是静态过滤器，想按说话人变就得反复增删，工具面抖动会让 agent loop 多记 `request/header`，反而更费 token、代码也更多。guard 是每次执行才求值的函数，配一个可变标志位就够。

### 会话分流（可选，**仅供人格分离**）

`auth.ownerPreset` / `auth.guestPreset` 都留空时，拥有者与非拥有者**共用一条会话**（默认，也是推荐）。填了 preset id 才分成两条：

- 拥有者走 `qqbot-group-<群号>`，挂 `ownerPreset`
- 非拥有者走 `...-guest`，挂 `guestPreset`

**这只是换人格，不是安全边界**——工具隔离由上面的 `guard` 负责。分流要付代价：同一个群会有两条历史，拥有者看不到访客说了什么。除非确实要给访客不同的说话风格，否则别开。

全局 `agentPreset`（设置页下拉：部署默认 / standard / ptc / minimal / cordis）决定**新会话**用什么 preset，已建会话不变；分流时某方 preset 留空会自动回落 `agentPreset`。

上下文头会带身份，例如 `[QQ群 33333 · 小明(22222) · 身份:访客｜本群管理员+动态授权[mute 至 ...]]`，让 Agent 自己决定怎么对待这个请求。

### 指令的严格性（防"聊天内容夹带指令样内容"被误执行）

1. 前缀必须位于**消息首位**（前面只允许空白）——`你好 /mute @x` 不会被当成指令
2. 动词必须完全匹配已知指令，未知动词照常交给模型
3. token 数量必须落在该指令声明的 `[min,max]` 内，**多余内容判为用法错误、不执行**
4. 权限不足直接拒绝，且不做任何动作

指令**不需要 @ 机器人**（刻意放在 `requireAt` 之前），但上述规则一条都不放宽。

### 指令表

| 指令 | 权限 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/help` | — | 列出全部指令 |
| `/whoami` | — | 看我在本群的身份与权限来源 |
| `/perms [@某人]` | query | 看某人在本群的权限来源（三路） |
| `/grants` | grant | 列出本群的动态授权 |
| `/grant @某人 权限[,权限] [分钟\|forever]` | grant | 临时授权（仅本群） |
| `/revoke @某人 [权限]` | grant | 撤销授权 |
| `/members` | query | 成员列表（最多列 30 条） |
| `/info` | query | 群信息 |
| `/mute @某人 [分钟=10]` | mute | 禁言（0 = 解禁） |
| `/unmute @某人` | mute | 解除禁言 |
| `/kick @某人` | kick | 移出本群 |
| `/recall [消息id]` | recall | 撤回；**回复某条消息再发 `/recall` 可省略 id** |
| `/banall on\|off` | settings | 全员禁言开关 |
| `/card @某人 新名片` | settings | 改群名片 |
| `/admin @某人 on\|off` | settings | 设/撤管理员 |
| `/rename 新群名` | settings | 改群名 |

### Agent 工具（与指令共用同一套鉴权）

`qqgroup` 的 `action`：只读 `group-list`/`group-info`/`member-list`/`member-info`，写操作 `mute`/`unmute`/`kick`/`whole-ban`/`set-card`/`set-admin`/`rename`/`recall`/`poke`。

工具的"说话人"取自**本会话最近一条消息**，所以群里普通成员没法靠一句话驱动管理动作——这一点是提示注入的主要防线。`group_id` 留空时默认用当前会话所在的群。

### 群事件

适配器会把完整事件字段透传上来（`operator_id` 谁操作的、`duration` 禁言时长、`target_id`、`card`，以及被引用消息的 `reply_to`）。当前版本只做透传与计数（`qqbot status` 里能看到），**自动治理尚未实现**。

### 建议的上线顺序

1. 在设置里填 `auth.owners`（至少填自己）
2. 打开 `admin.dryRun`，在群里发几条指令确认解析与回执
3. 关掉 dryRun，再按需加 `auth.superAdmins`
4. 非拥有者用 DSH 功能由**访客工具闸默认拦截**，无需额外配置；确实想放开再改 `auth.guestDshTools`

## 六、Agent 能用的工具

插件注册了一个动态工具 `qqbot`：

- `{action:'status'}` —— 连接状态、模式、适配器 pid/端口、各 QQ 会话的回合数、统计计数
- `{action:'send', message_type:'group'|'private', target_id:'123', text:'...'}` —— 主动发一条 QQ 消息
- `{action:'interrupt', conversation:'group-123'|'all'}` —— 中断正在跑的回合

### qq_websearch（联网搜索）

访客白名单内可直接调用：

- `{query, max_uses?}` —— 按关键词搜索，返回 `{ok, count, sources, text}`；后端走**多引擎组合搜索**（`multiEngine` 默认开）：Tavily（配 `TAVILY_API_KEY` 才启用，环境变量或 DSH 凭据 refs）→ DuckDuckGo（html→lite，串行 + 限流记忆）→ Yandex / Bing / Wikipedia 并发兜底、聚合去重（相关性闸门防无关链接）；关闭 `multiEngine` 则落回官方 DeepSeek web_search。抓取网页请用 `qq_webfetch`。

搜索请求都走 `webSearch.proxy`（非空时经 HTTP CONNECT 隧道 + TLS，含境内/境外分流；留空直连）。`webSearch` 配置段：代理 / 端点 / key 环境变量名（默认 `DEEPSEEK_BALANCE_API_KEY`，自动读 DSH 凭据服务）/ 每次最多触发次数 / 多引擎开关（默认开）。

### qq_webfetch（抓取网页）

访客白名单内可直接调用：

- `{url, max_chars?}` —— 抓取指定网页原文/渲染文本（http/https，仅公网），返回 `{ok, url, status|via, text}`；请求受 `webSearch.proxy` 管控（留空直连、非空走 HTTP CONNECT 隧道），抓取前校验目标为公网 IP，内网/回环/私有地址一律拒绝（防经代理扫内网）。
- 配置 `moli.enabled`（默认关）后改用 **Moli 无头浏览器渲染抓取**（可抓 SPA/JS 渲染页）；代理自动透传 `webSearch.proxy`（可被 `moli.proxy` 覆盖）；未检测到 moli 引擎时开关无效，工具返回 `moliUnavailable` 明确报错。

### qq_imgsearch（图片反搜）

访客白名单内可直接调用：

- `{url, max_results?}` 或 `{file, max_results?}` —— 给定**公网图片 URL** 或**本地图片文件路径**，返回 `{ok, count, sources, via, text}`；来源带 `url/title/snippet`。
- **本地文件流程**：先上传图床（`zixiaoyun/scdn/uguu` 三床按实测质量**加权随机**排优先度，依次试到第一个成功，一律走 `webSearch.proxy` 管控）拿公网 URL → 再反搜；**上传失败回退**：不经过图床、直接把文件发给 TraceMoe（文件直传搜图）。`file` 路径限 `qq-images` 目录内（访客不能读任意文件）。

引擎组合（全部请求走 `webSearch.proxy`，与 `qq_websearch` 同一套代理管控，本插件独立实现）：

- **无代理**（留空直连）：按**可用性优先** —— TraceMoe（动画截图识别，URL 模式 JSON，直连最快）→ IQDB（ACG 图库）→（有 key 时 SauceNAO）→ Soutubot
- **有代理**：**放开全部可用引擎按用户体量优先** —— Yandex（全球搜索引擎）→ Tineye（全球图片搜索）→ Copyseeker（聚合，结果最多）→（有 key 时 SauceNAO）→ Soutubot（搜图Bot酱，多库：pixiv/danbooru/gelbooru 等）→ IQDB → TraceMoe；聚合去重，cap 满即停，单引擎失败自动继续下一引擎。
- 开启 `imgSearch.weightedShuffle` 后，有代理时按**体量权重随机重排**（Yandex/Tineye/Copyseeker 权重 30/25/25，SauceNAO 15，Soutubot 8，IQDB/TraceMoe 5）：体量大引擎大概率先跑，但顺序每次不同，避免固定引擎一直打头。
- **Soutubot**（soutubot.moe，开源 imsearch）：API 只收文件 → 引擎先下载图片（二进制走代理）再上传 `/api/search` 拿 `result_id` → 查 `/api/results` 多库结果（pixiv 直链 / danbooru / gelbooru / zerochan 镜像 + 画师/角色标签）。
- **`kind=comic` 漫画模式**（`qq_imgsearch` 参数）：漫画/本子截图优先 **Soutubot → SauceNAO（有 key）→ IQDB → TraceMoe**（无代理同链），有代理时再 Yandex/Tineye/Copyseeker 兜底；`weightedShuffle` 开启时漫画权重 Soutubot 40 / SauceNAO 30 / IQDB 20 / TraceMoe 10 / 通用 5。**`kind=comic` + 本地文件（`file`）时不上图床**：Soutubot 直接传文件（soutubot API 只收文件），失败/无结果回退 TraceMoe 文件直传。

引擎实测（2026-10，PicImageSearch 图床 URL 全矩阵交叉验证）：直连可用 TraceMoe / IQDB / Soutubot；代理可用 Copyseeker（184 条）/ Yandex（15 条）/ Tineye（图床新图未收录时 0 条，收录后正常）；SauceNAO 需 `saucenaoKey`；其余（ascii2d / anime_trace / bing / google_lens / ehentai）不可用。`imgSearch` 配置段：`enabled`（默认开）/ `maxResults`（默认 5）/ `saucenaoKey` / `weightedShuffle`。

### qq_history（聊天记录，AI 自取）

访客白名单内可直接调用（群聊里被 @ 或需要结合群内近期消息/图片作答时，Agent 会主动调它）：

- `{group_id?, user_id?, count?, with_images?}` —— 拉取当前群最近消息，返回 `{ok, group_id, messages:[{time, user_id, nickname, text, images:[{url, description}]}]}`；`group_id` 默认当前群，`user_id` 可只筛某人的发言，`count` 默认 20、上限 50，`with_images` 默认开。
- **识别窗口锚定「最新提及」**：只对触发本条回复的那条消息（@ bot / 回复 bot / 命令前缀）**往前 `scopeMessages` 条**（默认 5）内的图片做识别，最多 `imageLimit` 张（默认 3，最近的优先）；更早的 @ 不锚定、其附近图片不因「也是被提及」而识别，避免重复拉取/重复识图。
- 窗口内图片用插件的视觉链路识别（下载 + `askVision`），返回 URL + 描述；识别失败只给 URL 不阻塞。配置见 `history` 段（`scopeMessages` / `imageLimit`）。

### qq_draw（生图，可直接发到 QQ）

在 设置 → QQ 机器人 里填好接口后，AI 就能按描述画图：

- `{prompt, model?, size?, reference?, caption?, send?}` —— `prompt` 越具体越好；`reference` 可给公网 URL 或 `qq-images` 下的本地图（保持同一形象做「自拍」）；
  `send` 默认 true，直接把图画成 QQ 图片段发到当前会话，`caption` 是随图发的文字。
- 失败策略：`429 / 5xx / 网络错 / 空结果` 按 `retryIntervalMs` 重试到 `maxAttempts`；`4xx`（参数错、额度不足）直接报错、不重试。
- 异步供应商：响应里是 `task_id` 时按 `pollIntervalMs` 轮询（依次试 `.../images/generations/<id>`、`.../images/tasks/<id>`、`.../tasks/<id>`），最多 `maxPolls` 次；关掉 `poll` 就只尝试一次。
- 图片落盘：`<QQ_msg>/qq-images/gen/`；`qq_draw` 不在访客默认白名单（会花钱），要放开就自己加到 `auth.guestToolAllow`。
- 接口约定：OpenAI 兼容 `POST <baseUrl>/images/generations`，请求体 `{model, prompt, n:1, size?, image?}`，返回 `data[0].url` 或 `data[0].b64_json`（实测 `seedream-5.0-lite` 返回 url、约 40 秒）。

### 人格（人设）也在设置里换

两种做法，互不冲突：

- **自定义人格**：设置页「自定义人格」开关 + 名字 + 设定，开一次管所有新会话（第一轮末尾附一次身份设定，零额外 token）；已建会话不变，想立刻生效就删掉旧会话重开。
- **整档 preset**：`Agent preset` 下拉选内置 standard / ptc / minimal / cordis；自建 preset（例如 `qq`）填进「自定义 agent preset id」，非空时优先生效——这条路换的不只是人格，还有工具面。

### web_fetch（抓公网原文，仅拥有者）

DSH 自带的 `web_fetch` 工具仍然注册，但**已从访客默认白名单移除**——访客要抓原文请用 `qq_webfetch`（走 `webSearch.proxy` 代理、同样带公网 IP 过滤，`moli.enabled` 时可改用 Moli 渲染）。`web_fetch` 本身只允许公网 IP，内网/回环地址由 DSH 直接拒绝；拥有者不受访客白名单限制，照常可用。

### qqgroup（群管理）

见「五、群管理」一节。工具路径的授权依据是「当前会话最近一条消息是否来自管理员白名单」。

## 七、排错

| 现象 | 检查 |
| --- | --- |
| 日志一直「OneBot 未连接」 | NapCat 的「正向 WebSocket」是否开在 `onebot.wsUrl`；reverse 模式下 NapCat 是否指向了 `ws://<DSH>:6199/`；防火墙；token 是否一致 |
| 能连上但收不到消息 | OneBot 版本要选 **v11**；不能只开 HTTP，必须开正向或反向 WS |
| 群里 @ 了也不回 | `group.enabled`；`group.allow` 白名单；`self_id` 与消息里的 `self_id` 是否一致（`logAdapterFrames: true` 能看到原始帧） |
| 回「（本轮没有产生文字回复：...）」 | 括号里是从会话日志读出的 `turn/end` 原因，据此定位（模型路由、额度、工具报错等） |
| 发送失败 | NapCat 的 HTTP 服务器（默认 3000）是否开着；`accessToken`；看日志里的「发送失败」 |
| 日志在哪 | 插件前缀 `[dsh-qq-bot]`，适配器前缀 `[dsh-qq-bot]/adapter`，都打到 DSH Host 的 stdout |

## 九、关于 AstrBot

AstrBot 是 OneBot 的**消费方**（内置 aiocqhttp 反向 WS 服务端），和本插件角色重叠。
用 DSH 当大脑就别再接 AstrBot，否则同一条消息会被两个大脑各回一次。
对端只要是「OneBot 11 实现」（NapCat / OneDisc / Lagrange / LLOneBot 等）就行。

## 十、在手机容器里跑 NapCat 的注意事项

- NapCat 官方镜像有 **arm64** 版本，所以理论上能在 arm64 容器里跑；但容器里再跑 Docker 通常需要 privileged 权限，不一定允许。
- 备选：不用 Docker，直接在容器里跑 NapCat.Shell（需要对应的 Linux QQ + NapCat 版本）。
- 同容器时用 **forward 模式**连 `127.0.0.1:3001` 最省事；如果 NapCat 在别的容器，用 **reverse 模式**，让 NapCat 连到 `ws://<DSH主机IP>:6199/`。
- 端口 6099 是 NapCat 的 WebUI（扫码登录用），**不要暴露到公网**。

| `lib/onebot-adapter.mjs` | OneBot 11 传输适配器。零依赖（Node 22 内置 `WebSocket`/`fetch`），正向/反向 WS + HTTP，自动重连、发送限速 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle 补丁：把插件插入 profile 组合树 |
| `test/mock-onebot.mjs` | 零依赖 OneBot 11 模拟器（手写 RFC 6455 帧编解码） |
| `test/test-adapter.mjs` | 正向 WS 适配器回归（19 项） |
| `test/test-adapter-reverse.mjs` | 反向 WS 适配器回归（12 项） |
| `test/test-plugin.mjs` | Host 插件端到端（76 项，假 ctx + 真适配器 + Config 契约 + 配置热更新） |
| `test/test-client.mjs` | 客户端设置页（32 项，模拟模块加载器 + 最小 React 渲染 + 只写密钥护栏 + 命名空间回退） |
| `test/test-admin.mjs` | 权限·群管理·访客工具闸专项（32 项；dsh-tools 可解析时另含工具路径断言） |
| `test/test-http.mjs` | HTTP / 代理隧道（17 项） |
| `test/test-config.mjs` | 配置合并与 volatile 还原（11 项） |
| `test/test-websearch.mjs` | 多引擎搜索结果解析（5 项） |
| `test/run-all.mjs` | 一键全量（8 套件） |
| `CONTRIBUTING.md` / `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md` / `SECURITY.md` | 贡献流程、行为准则、安全报告 |
| `.github/` | issue / PR 模板、CODEOWNERS |
| `examples/dynamic-package-host.js` | 同一个桥接的「动态 Cordis Package」版本：不想装包、只想在当前 DSH 进程里临时跑时用 |
| `ARCHITECTURE.md` | **改动指南**（给要 fork 的人）：文件职责、数据流、设计决策原因、分步改动指南、调试手册、术语表 |
| `AI-DISCLOSURE.md` | AI 生成内容声明、验证情况、**尚未验证清单**、第三方归属、安全免责 |
| `CHANGELOG.md` | 版本演进（0.1.0 → 0.8.2，含 0.8.0 合并下游分支与 0.8.1 输入框修复） |
| `LICENSE` | MIT |

## 十二、设计说明（踩过的坑）

- **为什么中间要子进程？** 动态插件沙箱没有 `fetch`/`WebSocket`/`require`，用 `ctx.subprocess` 拉真 Node 进程、换行分隔 JSON 通信；协议层可独立测试，换 QQ 框架不影响插件。
- **为什么用 `sessionController` 建会话？** 直接 `agentLoop.create()` 建的 Agent 没装模型路由（首次请求必败）；`sessionController.create()` + `resolveAgent()` 才是官方组装路径（装 provider/model + preset）。
- **为什么用 `whenIdle()` + `deriveMessages()` 取回复？** 回合串行排队，回合后会话日志最新一条有文本的 assistant 消息就是回复，比订阅流式事件简单稳。
- **访客工具闸为什么用 guard？** 拆会话破坏对话一致性；`restrict` 是静态过滤器需反复增删。`tools.guard` 注册一次、每次执行才求值：0 额外 token、单会话单历史；标志位须在**串行回合内部**设置，否则排队消息互相覆盖权限。
- **设置契约为什么跟 DSH 0.1.7 改？** 0.1.7 删了 `settings.register()`，改为读插件导出的 schemastery `Config`（可编辑字段必须 `.volatile()`）；volatile 变更不重挂插件，需监听 `loader/volatile-update` 自己刷新配置。
- **为什么动态 `import('@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools')`？** peerDependency 由 DSH 提供；动态 import + try/catch，包不在时桥接照样工作，只是少一个 `qqbot` 工具。

## 十三、不想重启 DSH 也能先跑起来（动态 Cordis Package）

装包要重启 `dsh web`；想**在当前进程里立刻试**，用 `examples/dynamic-package-host.js` 作动态 Package：
交给 `cordis_define`（`code.host`）再 `cordis_run` 即可，与常驻插件**共用同一份磁盘源码**。
优点：立刻生效、不用重启；限制：**DSH 一重启就没了**，长期在线还得装包。
动态沙箱里没有 `require`/`fetch`/`setTimeout`，传输层必须靠 `ctx.subprocess` 拉子进程
（这也是 `lib/onebot-adapter.mjs` 存在的原因）。

## 十四、许可与维护

### 许可与作者

MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。维护者与贡献者见顶部（维护 [@arrow1031](https://github.com/arrow1031)，核心贡献者 [@nd002723](https://github.com/nd002723)）。

由**一次连续会话**完成（2026-09-20），全部代码 + 测试 + 文档：

| --- | --- | --- |
| 约 **5 小时 10 分** | 约 **110M** | 约 **¥7.2** |

**成本大概是一杯咖啡，以及一个无聊的下午。**

时间由文件系统时间戳推算，含人工真机确认与等待；会话中途切换过多个模型。

### 维护状态：社区化维护中（不封版）

本仓库就是主干：0.8.0 把下游开发者 [@nd002723](https://github.com/nd002723) 的分支
（模块化重构 + `qq_websearch` / `qq_webfetch` / `qq_imgsearch` / `qq_history`）并入
`main`，同时保留 0.7.0 的 DSH 0.2 兼容改造；0.8.1 修掉设置页列表输入框吞逗号的问题。

- 安装跟随 `main`，不再锁 tag；每次合并后在 `main` 打 tag 发 Release

**运行时依赖**：`@deepseek-ai/schemastery`（Config schema 用）；`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 可选（仅用于注册动态工具，缺失时自动降级）。适配器只用 Node 22 内置的 `WebSocket` 与 `fetch`——**本插件本身保持零 npm 依赖**。**唯一的可选功能例外**：`qq_webfetch` 的 Moli 渲染模式（`moli.enabled`）需要另外安装 [dsh-moli](https://github.com/nd002723/dsh-moli) 插件 + moli 引擎（未装时开关无效、工具返回 `moliUnavailable` 并回退普通 http 抓取），不影响其它功能。

# NInfer for DeepSeek Harness

Manage local NInfer models and editable server profiles inside DSH. Includes the supplied Qwen3.8 27B 262k reference configuration.

## Install in DSH

Requires DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2**, running its Web profile.

1. Open **Plugins → Add plugin → GitHub**.
2. Paste `https://github.com/averyjohnkucan-arch/dsh-ninfer`.
3. Install and enable the plugin. Reload the browser, or restart DSH if its manager requests it.
4. Open **Settings → Models → NInfer**.

The plugin is a ready-to-install Cordis bundle. It does not patch DSH, replace its UI, install a second DSH, or require a plugin compilation step. Its package uses DSH's shipped peers, so installation does not download another provider stack or ask to run provider dependency build scripts.

## Models

Choose **Add model**, then **Select model files**. Browse the host's model directory and select multiple files, or **Select all model files here**. You can navigate between directories while retaining the selection. **Inspect and assign** reads headers and assigns the main model, its ordered shards, the vision projector and MTP. It reports missing shards, mixed main-model sets and unsupported MTP formats.

Edit the profile and save. **Start** prepares a missing runtime/model pack before starting the server. Runtime installation and model preparation show progress and can be cancelled. Existing installed engines and prepared packs can be selected under **Runtime and imported model data**. The model becomes available in DSH's conversation model picker after saving.

**Edit** reopens a saved profile. **Remove profile** deletes its saved configuration and stops its owned process; downloaded model files are retained. **Attach running server** explicitly connects to an already-running server advertising the profile's model ID. Stopping or disabling an attachment only detaches; it never terminates the external process. Launch settings are not applied to an external server.

All documented inference flags from the pinned executable's help have controls under **All engine CLI options**. Blank means the engine default; boolean **Omit flag** means the flag is not passed, not that an engine-default feature is necessarily disabled. The complete JSON editor supports repeated flags as arrays and multi-value flags as `{"argv":["first","second"]}`. Additional argv is an array, never a shell string. Environment variables and the complete server configuration are also editable.

## Updates, disable and removal

Update each repository independently through DSH's plugin manager. Turn its switch off to remove its card, provider registration and tools, and stop the servers it owns. Remove the bundle to uninstall its code. Saved profiles and runtime data remain in `~/.dsh/dsh-ninfer/` (or `$DSH_HOME/dsh-ninfer/`) so reinstalling restores them. Delete that plugin-owned data directory separately if you want a complete reset. Neither plugin requires the other.

## Integration

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch` and `dsh.client`; the patch inserts only its own Cordis row. The client registers React UI through the documented `settings.models.footer` slot and uses DSH theme tokens and locale service. The Host registers an `LlmAdapter` through `ctx.llm.registerAdapter`, delegates wire conversion, images and replay to DSH's public `PiAiAdapter`, and owns a separate `ctx.webServer.register` route. An ephemeral bearer capability supplied through `webserver/index-inject` protects its JSON actions. There is no iframe, DOM injection or replacement of built-in provider cards.

Registrations and process lifetimes are owned by `ctx.effect`/`ctx.on`. The agent-facing `ninfer_models` tool uses the same operations as the card and DSH's `approveEscalation` mechanism; host-management calls require Full access or explicit per-call approval. UI actions require the owner's page capability. This initial version targets the local Web profile; remote delegated access and Electron-only profiles have not been validated.

## Development

```sh
pnpm install --ignore-scripts
pnpm test
pnpm run check
```

Node 22.19+ is required. Development provider dependencies may report skipped optional install scripts; the published plugin has no install scripts and consumes DSH's installed peer packages. The two repositories contain their own code and tests and can be developed separately.

## NInfer runtime

Engine: [iamwavecut/ninfer-all](https://github.com/iamwavecut/ninfer-all), tested source revision `5ed86dff9fe3a5a0776f40a7aea86cf381da990d`.

The runtime installer builds the pinned upstream source with the engine patch shipped in `patches/ninfer-dflash-checkpoints.patch`. The patch adds native DFlash/DFlash2 disk snapshots, including draft-cache frontier metadata and reusable system-prefix anchors. It does not modify DSH. Existing profiles and binaries are not silently replaced.

Build prerequisites are Git, CMake 3.24+, Ninja, a compatible C++ compiler, CUDA 13.1 (including NVTX3 headers), and FFmpeg/cURL development packages. The default target is Linux x86_64 Blackwell `sm120a`. To select another supported GPU architecture or toolchain:

```sh
CMAKE=/path/to/cmake npm run build:checkpoints -- --root /path/to/runtime --arch 120a --jobs 8
```

`NINFER_CMAKE_ARGS` accepts a JSON array of additional CMake arguments. The build writes `checkpoint-build.json` with the upstream revision and patch hash. Select the resulting `build/apps/ninfer-serve` executable in the profile. The optional `scripts/fetch-ninfer.py` still fetches the pinned stock OCI binary; that stock binary does **not** support DFlash disk checkpoints. Model weights remain external.

NInfer consumes `.ninfer` artifacts. GGUF-to-NInfer conversion is not implemented by this plugin. NInfer's server flags, calibration action, environment and optional temporary power-profile hold are exposed. Calibration is user-triggered and saves its profile path. There is no automatic tuning in this plugin.

## Included Qwen3.8 27B reference profile

The initial profile preserves the owner's supplied setup:

```text
--max-context 262144 --kv-capacity 262144 --max-concurrency 1
--kv-dtype rk4v4 --spec dflash2 --draft-tokens 7 --lm-head-draft
--embedding-q4 --gdn-state-fp16 --prefill-cublas --prefill-chunk 512
--ngram-draft-tokens 0
```

It uses model ID `qwen3.8-27b`, port 8188, text-only input, a performance power-profile hold, and the supplied environment/calibration paths. The owner's absolute paths are an editable reference; other installations must select their own downloaded artifact and runtime libraries.

Model: [neroued/Qwen3.8-27B-NInfer](https://huggingface.co/neroued/Qwen3.8-27B-NInfer), revision `1cbd84e7221e51186bd7f093a149912d2489625b`, supplied SHA-256 `81f924d440c27261d820c19a9f8d45794c5aee410f8a68bd358133fa8c0375da`.

The reported benchmark numbers belong to the owner's prior run and are not claimed as a new plugin benchmark. No model inference or calibration was rerun while importing this profile. Reinstalling the plugin retains edited profiles; the seed is created only when no profile store exists.

When Start or a chat finds an existing server on the saved port, it automatically reuses it only if `/v1/models` advertises the exact saved model ID. The plugin never takes ownership of that process: Stop detaches, and saved launch changes require restarting the external server yourself. A different model, an invalid response, or an authenticated server without matching credentials is rejected. Strata tuning requires a plugin-owned server and never reuses an external process.

## Per-model reasoning settings

Edit a model profile to add/remove reasoning levels, give each a display name,
and set the exact `reasoning_effort` backend value. Choose a default level, or
Engine default to leave the request unspecified. Custom names and values are
supported; availability is declared per profile, not assumed for every model.
The engine/template must accept the configured backend values.

Qwen3.8 profiles start with Off (thinking disabled), Low → `low`, Medium → `medium`, and XHigh → `xhigh`,
with Medium as default. The conversation model picker uses these profile-owned
settings through DSH's existing adapter reasoning metadata. No DSH core patch
is required. An empty level list hides the reasoning selector for that profile.

## Model Scheduler integration

Optionally install `dsh-model-scheduler` for shared GPU admission, queued chat switching, manual load/unload and separate configurable idle retention (five minutes by default) and switch grace (30 seconds by default). This provider remains independently usable. Scheduling policy lives in that separate Cordis service; no Harness core changes are required. Owned engine process groups are stopped before GPU release is reported. External servers are detached, never killed.

## Per-chat checkpoints and shared prefixes

The per-profile **Keep model loaded while idle** setting (`keepWarm: true`) preserves the running engine and its in-memory cache when the optional Model Scheduler is installed. Another queued model, image job, manual Unload or shutdown can still release it. Other profiles retain their normal idle timer.

For the qualified Qwen3.8 profile, `cacheStableHistory: true` enables positional system and tool updates through the public provider adapter. It requires `--chat-template` to point to this plugin's `assets/qwen3_8-cache.jinja` and `--preserve-thinking: true`. The external template derives from the pinned upstream Qwen3.8 template; stock NInfer remains unchanged. Tool declarations stay at their history positions while the full catalog remains available to the server for tool validation.

This processes new user text after Send. It does not process drafts or generate background answers. Changing the template requires a one-time cache rebuild. Cold loads, history edits, compaction, reasoning changes and non-additive tool changes can still require recomputation. Do not enable this template on unrelated model families without validation.

With the patched engine selected, enable **Save per-chat KV checkpoints**. The provider serializes restore → inference → save through its official DSH adapter. Every successfully completed inference step (including tool calls and token-limit stops) publishes a durable native checkpoint. Interrupted or failed steps retain the preceding valid checkpoint. Each chat retains its two most recently used model configurations. Auxiliary summarization/title calls and externally attached servers do not write checkpoints.

Checkpoints live in the plugin data directory under `kv/chats/`, with hashed chat IDs, private file permissions, atomic manifests, and compatibility fingerprints covering weights, executable and launch settings. Their contents include conversation state; treat this directory as private chat data. A missing, incompatible or corrupt checkpoint falls back to normal prefill and exposes a warning in model status.

When switching chats, the provider first checks for a compatible continuation still resident in the native GPU/host cache. Otherwise it restores a snapshot from disk. Fresh chats use an independent base checkpoint under `kv/bases/`, keyed to the model and exact system/tool/rendering configuration. It survives eviction of chat snapshots. A new configuration is warmed once using the system/tools, a blank synthetic user message and one discarded token (the native APIs require generation to retain state). No real user or assistant history enters that seed. Native prefix anchors limit reuse to the matching system/tool tokens before the real user message. Subsequent chats restore this base without rebuilding it. Existing chats always prefer their own latest checkpoint. Legacy cross-chat reuse remains a fallback when no independent base exists. Edits and compaction recompute from the last compatible native anchor, which may precede the exact edit position.

The patch uses NInfer's original checkpoint catalog (`--slot-save-path`), because its alternate hybrid cache does not expose native snapshots. The plugin manages that directory and rejects conflicting cache flags. It defaults to eight private anchors per continuation and an 8 GiB host-cache budget; explicit profile values take precedence. Smaller budgets can fail startup when the recurrent-state images exceed the engine's allocation limit. This path can have different memory/performance characteristics from stock DFlash2 caching. Snapshots are native full snapshots, not incremental deltas; long contexts can require substantial disk space and write bandwidth. Same-model resident reuse avoids reloading weights, but disk transfers and different-model loads are not guaranteed to finish in one or two seconds. See [measured checkpoint validation](docs/CHECKPOINT-VALIDATION.md) for the tested configuration and limitations.

The **Off** reasoning level disables thinking with `chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=false`; it does not send the literal `off` as an unsupported reasoning-effort value. Existing version-1 model profiles gain Off once on upgrade; custom names and Medium defaults are preserved. Set a custom row's backend value to `off` for the same behavior.

To qualify the native checkpoint path on your model, start a managed checkpoint-enabled server and run `python3 scripts/verify-checkpoints.py capture --url http://127.0.0.1:PORT --model MODEL --report REPORT.json`. Restart that server, run the same command with `restore`, then restart and run it with `cold`. The script compares restored continuation against uninterrupted greedy output, checks actual native cached-token counts, and compares shared-prefix reuse against a cold new chat. It writes one test snapshot named `dsh-qualification.kv`; use a dedicated test profile. This requires real model weights and GPU access; the ordinary plugin tests do not substitute for it.

# Strata for DeepSeek Harness

Manage Strata Unleashed GGUF models, vision/projector files, MTP, saved profiles and measured Flash Next tuning inside DSH.

## Install in DSH

Requires DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2**, running its Web profile.

1. Open **Plugins → Add plugin → GitHub**.
2. Paste `https://github.com/averyjohnkucan-arch/dsh-strata`.
3. Install and enable the plugin. Reload the browser, or restart DSH if its manager requests it.
4. Open **Settings → Models → Strata**.

The plugin is a ready-to-install Cordis bundle. It does not patch DSH, replace its UI, install a second DSH, or require a plugin compilation step. Its package uses DSH's shipped peers, so installation does not download another provider stack or ask to run provider dependency build scripts.

## Models

Choose **Add model**, then **Select model files**. Browse the host's model directory and select multiple files, or **Select all model files here**. You can navigate between directories while retaining the selection. **Inspect and assign** reads headers and assigns the main model, its ordered shards, the vision projector and MTP. It reports missing shards, mixed main-model sets and unsupported MTP formats.

Edit the profile and save. **Start** prepares a missing runtime/model pack before starting the server. Runtime installation and model preparation show progress and can be cancelled. Existing installed engines and prepared packs can be selected under **Runtime and imported model data**. The model becomes available in DSH's conversation model picker after saving.

**Edit** reopens a saved profile. **Remove profile** deletes its saved configuration and stops its owned process; downloaded model files are retained. **Attach running server** explicitly connects to an already-running server advertising the profile's model ID. Stopping or disabling an attachment only detaches; it never terminates the external process. Launch settings are not applied to an external server.

All documented inference flags from the pinned executable's help have controls under **All engine CLI options**. Blank means the engine default; boolean **Omit flag** means the flag is not passed, not that an engine-default feature is necessarily disabled. The complete JSON editor supports repeated flags as arrays and multi-value flags as `{"argv":["first","second"]}`. Additional argv is an array, never a shell string. Environment variables and the complete server configuration are also editable.

## Updates, disable and removal

Update each repository independently through DSH's plugin manager. Turn its switch off to remove its card, provider registration and tools, and stop the servers it owns. Remove the bundle to uninstall its code. Saved profiles and runtime data remain in `~/.dsh/dsh-strata/` (or `$DSH_HOME/dsh-strata/`) so reinstalling restores them. Delete that plugin-owned data directory separately if you want a complete reset. Neither plugin requires the other.

## Integration

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch` and `dsh.client`; the patch inserts only its own Cordis row. The client registers React UI through the documented `settings.models.footer` slot and uses DSH theme tokens and locale service. The Host registers an `LlmAdapter` through `ctx.llm.registerAdapter`, delegates wire conversion, images and replay to DSH's public `PiAiAdapter`, and owns a separate `ctx.webServer.register` route. An ephemeral bearer capability supplied through `webserver/index-inject` protects its JSON actions. There is no iframe, DOM injection or replacement of built-in provider cards.

Registrations and process lifetimes are owned by `ctx.effect`/`ctx.on`. The agent-facing `strata_models` tool uses the same operations as the card and DSH's `approveEscalation` mechanism; host-management calls require Full access or explicit per-call approval. UI actions require the owner's page capability. This initial version targets the local Web profile; remote delegated access and Electron-only profiles have not been validated.

## Development

```sh
pnpm install --ignore-scripts
pnpm test
pnpm run check
```

Node 22.19+ is required. Development provider dependencies may report skipped optional install scripts; the published plugin has no install scripts and consumes DSH's installed peer packages. The two repositories contain their own code and tests and can be developed separately.

## Strata runtime and supported formats

Engine source: [StrataUnleashed](https://github.com/averyjohnkucan-arch/StrataUnleashed), pinned to `c73cde37581e6a79664176a08a232480c1b1fcfc`, the latest revision inspected for this release. Engine updates are explicit version changes, independent of saved model settings.

The automated setup currently builds the NVIDIA CUDA engine on Linux from that pinned source, creates a Python environment, installs the engine's requirements, and builds CPU/CUDA vision readers. It attempts a Vulkan vision reader and retains CPU fallback if Vulkan tools are unavailable. This requires Python with venv support, Git, CMake, Ninja, a C++ compiler and a compatible CUDA toolkit/driver. These system prerequisites are not installed with administrator privileges. Another supported engine binary can be supplied manually. This first release is not a universal precompiled engine distribution.

Automatic model packing currently supports **qwen4exp / Flash Next** using the fork's own `iq_pack.py`. Other architectures need an upstream-prepared compatible runtime pack. A selected MTP GGUF must be Strata's packed Q2_0 format accepted by `mtp_rt.py`; arbitrary standalone FP16/Q4/Q8 MTP GGUFs are recognized but explicitly rejected before conversion. A prepared MTP runtime is supported. MTP is never silently dropped and the tuner does not move it off the text GPU.

Vision choices are Auto, GPU, iGPU/Vulkan, CPU, and Off. Auto uses iGPU on cards with at most 12 GiB when a compatible Vulkan reader and device index are configured, otherwise CPU; larger cards prefer GPU. An independently configured CPU vision reader is the fallback. Vulkan device selection uses a plugin-owned launcher wrapper so its environment does not redirect the CUDA text engine. Automatic iGPU discovery is not implemented; supply the Vulkan index. GPU/CPU/iGPU vision execution has not been rebenchmarked for this plugin release.

Only the engine's actual mixed K/V formats are accepted: FP16/FP16, FP16/Q8, FP16/Q6, Q8/Q8, Q8/Q6, Q6/Q8, Q6/Q6, Q8/Q5, Q5/Q5, Q5/Q4, Q4/Q4. K/V dropdowns do not imply that every Cartesian combination is supported. The explicit expert-tail-skipping environment control can alter model output and is never enabled automatically by the tuner.

## Saved configurations

Use **Import saved Strata configuration** to import an existing JSON run configuration. Existing engine arguments are retained in their original order until an inference control changes. Supplied settings are locked against tuning. The import records the source-file SHA-256 and its existing validation status. Moving `/opt/prod/...` paths to an existing Local AI v2 location changes paths only.

The owner's local installation includes Atomic Chat Q5 Regular/Turbo and Gyro Large Regular/Turbo from Local AI v2. These machine-specific profiles and model weights are not bundled into this public repository. Their saved records contain pending validation statuses; importing them does not make them newly validated and does not run inference.

## Tuning

**Tune saved profile** is opt-in and measures the selected model on the current GPU. Editing a value enables **Keep my value**; clear it to let the tuner adjust that control. Imported existing tunes are locked. Failed or cancelled tuning preserves the previous saved tune.

The search starts at 80% resident KV, probes FP16/FP16, Q4/Q4 and Q8/Q8, refines supported pairs with K prioritized, searches resident cells when needed, and targets 6–10% free GPU memory. It measures decode candidates, then prefill candidates with a separate decode regression check capped at 5% loss. Finally it searches expert slots toward 0.7–1.5% free VRAM, retaining a larger margin if the next allocation does not fit. The final candidate is measured at the requested full context and checked again for short decode. MTP stays on GPU when configured.

The tuner records actual token usage, timings, observed free VRAM, every trial and manual locks. Memory-search neighbor probes reduce reliance on monotonic allocation. This remains a bounded heuristic: it does not establish a global performance optimum or prove numerical equivalence after quantization. NVIDIA telemetry is currently required. The staged search and manual-lock behavior have automated tests; a new full hardware tuning sweep was intentionally not run for this release because the owner requested reuse of saved settings.

When Start or a chat finds an existing server on the saved port, it automatically reuses it only if `/v1/models` advertises the exact saved model ID. The plugin never takes ownership of that process: Stop detaches, and saved launch changes require restarting the external server yourself. A different model, an invalid response, or an authenticated server without matching credentials is rejected. Strata tuning requires a plugin-owned server and never reuses an external process.

## Per-model reasoning settings

Edit a model profile to add/remove reasoning levels, give each a display name,
and set the exact `reasoning_effort` backend value. Choose a default level, or
Engine default to leave the request unspecified. Custom names and values are
supported; availability is declared per profile, not assumed for every model.
The engine/template must accept the configured backend values.

Qwen3.8 profiles start with Off (thinking disabled), Low → `low`, Medium → `medium`, and XHigh → `xhigh`,
with Medium as default. The conversation model picker uses these profile-owned
settings through DSH's existing adapter reasoning metadata. No DSH core patch
is required. An empty level list hides the reasoning selector for that profile.

## Model Scheduler integration

Optionally install `dsh-model-scheduler` for shared GPU admission, queued chat switching, manual load/unload and separate configurable idle retention (five minutes by default) and switch grace (30 seconds by default). This provider remains independently usable. Scheduling policy lives in that separate Cordis service; no Harness core changes are required. Owned engine process groups are stopped before GPU release is reported. External servers are detached, never killed.

## Per-chat native KV checkpoints

Enabled by default for managed single-slot servers; turn it off in a profile’s KV checkpoints section. Checkpoints live under `<dataDir>/kv/chats/<hashed-session-id>/`, default `~/.dsh/dsh-strata/kv`. The latest native snapshot is kept for two model configurations per chat. Each successful model step saves the native slot to a private file, syncs it and atomically publishes its catalog entry before deleting the superseded snapshot. Failed saves preserve the last committed snapshot. Aborted/failed steps retain their earlier checkpoint. Auxiliary title/compaction calls do not replace a chat checkpoint.

Restores happen before generation, including after process restart. A new chat can restore the compatible snapshot with the longest matching system/message prefix; the engine validates its native format and computes the actual token prefix. Launch settings, model paths and file timestamps participate in compatibility checks. Restores never add old messages to a new conversation. Chat operations are serialized around restore/generate/save because the native API exposes slot 0. Large checkpoints require real disk/PCIe transfer time. Full OS power-loss testing has not been performed. Automatic tuning skips parallel/batch candidates while per-chat KV is enabled. Native parallel/batch mode does not support disk snapshots; its API reports that limitation and the card shows a KV warning. Externally managed servers are not checkpointed by this plugin.

The **Off** reasoning level disables thinking with `chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=false`; it does not send the literal `off` as an unsupported reasoning-effort value. Existing version-1 model profiles gain Off once on upgrade; custom names and Medium defaults are preserved. Set a custom row's backend value to `off` for the same behavior.

The provider marks the leading system/tool message with Strata's native shared-prefix metadata. For Qwen templates that reject system-only rendering, it prepares a tokenizer copy under the plugin data directory: only the non-generation prefix-rendering check is relaxed. Normal generation retains the original check and prompt output. Original tokenizer/model files are never edited. Other templates are used unchanged.

### Independent starting checkpoint

Fresh chats use a separate `kv/bases/` checkpoint keyed to the model and exact system/tool/rendering configuration. The base survives per-chat model eviction; changes create a new compatible base once. Existing chats prefer their latest per-step checkpoint. Each chat keeps its last two model configurations, with successful saves replacing the preceding step for that configuration.

The native server retains state only after a generation request. The plugin builds a base using system/tools, a blank synthetic user message and one discarded token. No real user or assistant history enters that request. The native `strata_prefix` anchor restricts reuse to the matching system/tool prefix before the real user prompt. The synthetic tail is never added to a conversation. Established chats do not pause to build new bases when their toolsets change. Legacy cross-chat matching is only a fallback when no base exists.
