# @botharness/vrm-companion A VRM companion Panel for [DeepSeekBot](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot): the Bot's character sits at a desk in a lo-fi study room in the style of Chill with You. It types while the Bot works, looks up while it thinks, turns to you and speaks the Bot's committed replies in a speech bubble, and between tasks sips coffee, rests its chin or checks its phone. Day, night and weather follow your local clock, and **Change character…** loads your own `.vrm` file (VRoid/VRM 0.x or VRM 1.0) without uploading it. ## Requirements - DeepSeek Harness (DSH) `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0`. - DeepSeekBot newer than 1.4.1, installed in the same Profile. The Panel uses DeepSeekBot's `botPresentation` and `dockPanels` services, which 1.4.1 and earlier do not provide, and the DSH Client `locale` service for its Chinese and English text; the Panel does not load without them. ## Install ```sh dsh plugin --profile add @botharness/vrm-companion@0.2.0 ``` Restart the Host. In Bot mode, select a Bot DM, open Messages and choose **VRM Companion** (**VRM 伴侣** in Chinese) in the Messages header. The pin icon creates a fixed instance for that Bot. See the [Panel guide](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/blob/main/docs/panel-plugin.md) for controls and behavior. ## License The source code is MIT; see [LICENSE](LICENSE). The bundled assets keep their own terms: - The default character, VRoid Project's AvatarSample_A, may be used, modified and redistributed without credit under its VRoid Hub conditions; it is not under the MIT license. See [assets/README.md](assets/README.md). - The room models are KayKit Furniture Bits by Kay Lousberg, CC0; see [assets/kaykit/README.md](assets/kaykit/README.md). - The lilToon shader port is MIT; see [assets/THREE-LILTOON-LICENSE.txt](assets/THREE-LILTOON-LICENSE.txt) and its third-party notices. ## Release `@botharness/vrm-companion` is versioned independently of DeepSeekBot and published by `.github/workflows/vrm-companion-release.yml`. 1. Bump `version` in `packages/vrm-companion/package.json` (a prerelease such as `0.2.0-rc.1` goes to the `next` dist-tag, anything else to `latest`) and merge it to `main`. 2. Tag that commit on `main` and push the tag: ```sh git tag vrm-companion-v0.2.0 && git push origin vrm-companion-v0.2.0 ``` 3. The workflow checks that the tag is on `main` and matches the package version, runs `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm build` and the VRM tests, then waits for approval in the `npm-release` environment. 4. After approval it runs `npm publish --provenance --access public` in `packages/vrm-companion`. It authenticates with npm trusted publishing when a Trusted Publisher for this workflow is configured on npmjs.com for `@botharness/vrm-companion`, and otherwise with the `NPM_TOKEN` secret.

## 宣传片 3 分钟看懂 DeepSeekBot：一组有身份、人格和记忆的 bots，在小镇里一起做事。点击封面即可播放。

DeepSeekBot（简称 **DSB**，是 DeepSeekBot 的缩写，才不是“大啥比”，哼）是 BotHarness 开发的 MIT 开源 GrokBot 平替，作为插件运行在 [DeepSeek Harness（DSH）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)里。你可以创建几个分别负责研究、写作或写代码的 Bot，像和同事一样私聊、拉群、派活；它们记得你，会按时做事，还能在 Slack、Discord、飞书 / Lark、QQ 和微信里以自己的身份回你消息。 模型用你在 DSH 里配置的服务商和额度；Bot 需要在后台持续工作时，运行 DSH 的电脑要保持在线。它和名字很像的 DS Bot（npm `ds-bot`）是两个独立项目，区别见[下文](#deepseek-bot-projects)。 ## 安装 在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端点「插件 → 添加插件」，输入 `deepseekbot@1.4.1`，安装并启用，侧栏就会出现「Bot 模式」。还没装 DSH？先[下载桌面端](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/)。 命令行安装、版本说明和常见问题见[官网安装指南](https://deepseekbot.app/docs/installation/)。 ## 能用它做什么 | 你想要 | DeepSeekBot 怎么帮你 | | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | **一支自己的 AI 小团队** | 创建研究员、设计师、工程师等 Bot，每个都有名字、人格和像素头像，换个对话也还是同一个它。 | | **让 Bot 记住你** | Bot 会记下你的偏好和项目背景，下次直接接着干；记忆随时能翻看、纠正，也能同步到别的电脑。 | | **多个 Bot 一起干活** | 把 Bot 拉进群聊，需要谁就 @ 谁；大一点的任务可以交给 Bot 单独去做，做完交回报告，需要你拍板时会提醒你。 | | **在常用的聊天软件里找它** | 把 Bot 接入 Slack、Discord、飞书 / Lark、QQ 和微信，在群里 @ 它或私聊，它就在原处用自己的身份回复；微信私聊里还能收发文件。 | | **定时做事** | 说一句「每天早上 9 点给我发日志摘要」，Bot 就自己建好定时任务；也可以手动设置每隔几分钟、几小时或每天执行。 | | **帮你操作电脑和浏览器** | 授权后，Bot 可以打开网页、点击、输入、截图，或操作一台共享桌面；你能实时看着它做，随时暂停。 | | **一键装别人做好的 Bot** | 在 [Bot 市场](https://deepseekbot.app/market)浏览、安装别人分享的 Bot，也能把自己的 Bot 分享出去，或打包成 zip 发给朋友。 | | **知道每次更新了什么** | 升级后会告诉你这一版新增了什么；在设置里就能检查并一键更新。 | ### 像素头像 每个 Bot 都有一张由名字生成的像素头像，工作时还会变成它正在用的工具。想自己捏一个？到[官网头像工坊](https://deepseekbot.app/avatar)输入名字试试，还能下载高清头像。 ## 截图

Bot 私聊与记忆演化：Mira 从记忆里找出访客统计；右侧能看到它记忆的每次提交和分支。
群聊协作：@ 三个 Bot，它们各自回复，Nova 读完前两位再接话。

定时任务：一句话让 Bot 自己建任务。
Bot 市场：按话题和关键词找 Bot，点「安装」就多一位同事（图中为示例数据）。

首页与托布：面板可以并排摆放；问托布一句，它就汇报所有 Bot 的状态。
界面设置：主题、配色、壁纸库和半透明面板，只保存在这台设备上。
_截图来自隔离的本地 DSH，对话是虚构的天文台展览示例。_ ## 看得见的记忆 每个 Bot 的记忆就是一个普通的 Git 仓库。你可以在侧栏翻看它记了什么、哪天改了哪几行，觉得不对就直接改；推到 GitHub，就能在几台电脑之间共用同一个 Bot。详见[记忆演化指南](https://deepseekbot.app/docs/channel-sidebar/memory-evolution/)。 ## 版本亮点 完整记录见[官网更新日志](https://deepseekbot.app/changelog/)。 | 版本 | 新内容 | | 模式重新流畅；VRM 伴侣可单独安装。 | | **[1.4.1](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/releases/tag/v1.4.1)**（2026-10-20） | 第一次进入 Bot 模式时，托布五步带你上手；Bot 模式有自己的**主题、半透明面板和壁纸库**；`/compact` 主题色、更多像素物种和自绘部件；记忆可回到任意版本。需要 DSH 0.2.0 及以上。 | | **[1.2.1](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/releases/tag/v1.2.1)**（2026-10-12） | 修复部分 DSH 版本装不上的问题；群头像显示成员头像拼图；音频和文件附件可以直接播放、下载。 | | **[1.2.0](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/blob/v1.2.0/CHANGELOG.zh.md#120---2026-10-08)**（2026-10-08） | 可以置顶在桌面的像素**窗口伙伴**；绑定一个应用就能在飞书、Slack、Discord、微信里收发消息；Bot 可以**导入导出**成 zip；Bot 资料页加了横幅和简介。 | | **1.1.0**（2026-10-06） | **定时任务**；每次对话都带上 Bot 的人格和核心记忆；设置里**一键更新**；微信支持语音转文字和图片。 | | **1.0.1**（2026-10-05） | 首个正式版：有身份的 PersonaBots、Git 记忆、群聊、任务委派、像素头像、IM 接入和首版 **Bot 市场**。 | ## DeepSeekBot（DSB）与 DS Bot（ds-bot）：两个项目，不同重心 名字很像，但这是两个独立的开源项目：都运行在 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）上，都不是 DeepSeek 公司官方产品。 - **DeepSeekBot（DSB）**，即本仓库，由 BotHarness 维护：让每个 Bot 成为一位能**走出 DSH 窗口**的长期同事。重心是可审阅的 Git 记忆、Bot 自己的飞书 / Slack / Discord / 微信身份、定时任务、任务委派和 Bot 市场。 - **DS Bot**，即 [Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot](https://github.com/Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot)（npm `ds-bot`，项目 README 中也写作 DeepSeek Bot）：把 **DSH 本身变成一个 Bot 聊天应用**。重心是由主 Bot「Chief」通过对话带你建好团队、群管理员默认统筹回复以控制 token 消耗，以及按时间、Bot 和模型查看用量。 | | DeepSeekBot（DSB） | DS Bot（ds-bot） | | ----------- | [`deepseekbot`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/deepseekbot) | npm [`ds-bot`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/ds-bot) | | 许可 | MIT | Apache-2.0 | | 记忆 | 每个 Bot 一个 Git 工作树：文件、commit、diff，可推到 GitHub 在多台机器共享 | Markdown 记忆，每轮后自动审查；个人与团队两级 | | 多 Bot 协作 | Group 中需要谁就 @ 谁；Assignments 委派独立任务并保留报告 | 主 Bot 管理团队；群管理员默认回复，再按需叫其他 Bot | | DSH 之外 | Bot 以自己的身份进入飞书 / Lark、Slack、Discord、微信 | 提供 GitHub connector | | 其他 | Bot。两者都开源，欢迎都去读读源码：[DeepSeekBot](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot) · [DS Bot](https://github.com/Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot)。更详细的对比见[官网文章](https://deepseekbot.app/blog/deepseekbot-vs-ds-bot/)。 ## 常见问题 ### 这是哪个 DeepSeek Bot 项目？ 这里是 **BotHarness 的 DeepSeekBot（DSB）**：安装包为 [`deepseekbot`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/deepseekbot)，官网为 [deepseekbot.app](https://deepseekbot.app)。DS Bot 使用 `ds-bot`，是另一个独立项目，不是本产品的简称或旧版本，区别见[上文](#deepseek-bot-projects)。 ### DeepSeekBot 只能使用 DeepSeek 模型吗？ 不是。它使用 DSH 中配置的模型提供商；能否接入取决于接口支持、模型配置与凭据。Bot 的记忆和聊天记录保存在自己的宿主，调用远程模型时相关上下文仍会发给所选服务商。 ## 开发者 想从源码运行或参与开发：需要 Node ≥22 和 pnpm。 ```bash git clone https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot.git BotHarness cd BotHarness pnpm install && pnpm build node scripts/dev-instance.mjs --home /tmp/botharness-demo --port 31967 ``` 更多见[本地实例指南](docs/client-bridge.md#7-本地开发环路dsh-020-rc2) · [贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.zh.md) · [架构](docs/architecture/botharness-architecture.md) · [架构决策](docs/adr/) · [Agent 开发规范](AGENTS.md) · [Release Ledger](CHANGELOG.zh.md) · [DSH 官方文档](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/)。 真实 IM 测试可用[共享 QA 应用向导](docs/agents/im-test-apps.md)配置 Lark、Slack、Discord 的独立 QA1／QA2／QA3；例如运行 `node scripts/dev-im-test-apps.mjs setup discord`，隐藏输入 Token，并在每次启动接收端前确认当前独占窗口。 ## 社区 问题、想法，还有你做出来的 Bot，都欢迎带来。 | 来坐坐 | 一起做点什么 | | [第一次贡献](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/discussions/1398)，文档、测试和答疑也欢迎；明确的 Bug 与实施任务请到 [Issues](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/issues/new/choose)。 | | | 我们已上线 Product Hunt，欢迎看看，也欢迎把 DeepSeekBot 介绍给朋友。 | ## 仓库状态 **最近 30 天**：关闭 PR 包含已合并 PR；提交按默认分支所有可达历史统计，包含合并提交和机器人提交。每六小时更新，图中时间为最后成功更新时间。 [文字数据与统计口径](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/tree/readme-status#readme) · [JSON](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/readme-status/stats.json) · [更新任务](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/actions/workflows/readme-status.yml) ## 灵感与致谢 - [Grok Bot](https://x.ai/bot)：持久 Bot，以及像同事一样沟通和委派工作的产品灵感。 - [Rakazo](https://github.com/elie222/rakazo)：持久 AI 队友、对话与记忆体验参考。 - [DS Bot](https://github.com/Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot)：同样运行在 DSH 上的另一个 Bot 插件，重心不同，值得一读。 - Bot 私聊与记忆演化：Mira 从记忆里找出访客统计；右侧能看到它记忆的每次提交和分支。
群聊协作：@ 三个 Bot，它们各自回复，Nova 读完前两位再接话。

定时任务：一句话让 Bot 自己建任务。
Bot 市场：按话题和关键词找 Bot，点「安装」就多一位同事（图中为示例数据）。

首页与托布：面板可以并排摆放；问托布一句，它就汇报所有 Bot 的状态。
界面设置：主题、配色、壁纸库和半透明面板，只保存在这台设备上。
_截图来自隔离的本地 DSH，对话是虚构的天文台展览示例。_ ## 看得见的记忆 每个 Bot 的记忆就是一个普通的 Git 仓库。你可以在侧栏翻看它记了什么、哪天改了哪几行，觉得不对就直接改；推到 GitHub，就能在几台电脑之间共用同一个 Bot。详见[记忆演化指南](https://deepseekbot.app/docs/channel-sidebar/memory-evolution/)。 ## 版本亮点 完整记录见[官网更新日志](https://deepseekbot.app/changelog/)。 | 版本 | 新内容 | | 模式重新流畅；VRM 伴侣可单独安装。 | | **[1.4.1](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/releases/tag/v1.4.1)**（2026-10-20） | 第一次进入 Bot 模式时，托布五步带你上手；Bot 模式有自己的**主题、半透明面板和壁纸库**；`/compact` # dsh-litgraph — AI 文献发现与综述 > 给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) 的文献调研插件：**跨源检索 → 知识图谱 → 六维评估 → 结构化综述 → 按工作区归档**。 > 侧边栏一个入口，人和 Agent 共用同一套能力：你点出来的图谱，Agent 也能用工具拿到；Agent 写下的综述，你在面板里能直接读。 ![图谱面板](docs/graph-panel.png)

检索 graph neural network recommendation：129 篇文献、269 条边、16 个主题簇，右侧是六维评分与主题簇图例，底部是年度分布。

--- ## 它解决什么问题 做文献调研时真正耗时的不是"搜到论文"，而是： 1. 四五个数据库各搜一遍，结果还要手工去重； 2. 搜到 100 篇之后，看不出**谁和谁是一伙的**、哪条脉络才是主线； 3. 判断"这篇值不值得读"全靠直觉，没有可比较的维度； 4. 读完一堆，写综述时又要把笔记重新组织一遍； 5. 下次再调研同一主题，上次的成果散落在聊天记录和临时文件里。 这个插件把上面五步串成一条流水线，并且**把结果落成工作区里的文件**，而不是锁在插件状态里。 ## 特性 - **四源并行检索**：OpenAlex / Crossref / Semantic Scholar / arXiv，按 DOI + 归一化标题去重，合并各家最完整的字段。 - **引文滚雪球**：命中靠前的论文会顺着参考文献与相关文献再捞一层，补上关键词搜不到的经典工作。 - **六维质量评分**：影响力、载体、严谨、证据、新颖、可复现，加权后与检索相关度混合排序，避免"高被引但离题"压住切题新作。 - **知识图谱**：引用、主题、术语、同作者四类边 + 标签传播聚类，主题簇带中文图例；节点坐标由标题哈希决定，**同一批论文在任何窗口尺寸下位置不变**。 - **AI 撰写综述**：走宿主内置 `llm` 服务，十节结构（检索方法 / 语料概览 / 研究脉络 / 主题簇 / 方法对比 / 六维评估 / 共识与争议 / 研究空白 / 阅读路径 / 可复现附录）；模型不可用时自动回退到确定性模板，离线也能出稿。 - **按工作区归档**：每份综述落在 `<工作区>/.literature-review/NNN-标题/`，含 `meta.json`、`review.md`、`papers.json`、`graph.json`；一个工作区可以有多份，切换工作区互不干扰。 - **Agent 原生**：7 个工具，Agent 一句话就能"调研 + 写综述 + 落盘"，并会先检查已有档案、询问新建还是覆盖。 ## 工作原理 ``` 检索 ──▶ OpenAlex / Crossref / Semantic Scholar / arXiv（并行） │ ├─ DOI + 标题归一化去重，字段取最全 ├─ 引文滚雪球（参考文献 + 相关文献） │ 排序 ──▶ 六维质量分 × 检索相关度（0.82 / 0.18）+ 被引微量加成 │ 图谱 ──▶ 引用边 / 主题边 / 术语边 / 同作者边 → 标签传播聚类 → 年度分布 │ 综述 ──▶ 宿主 llm 撰写（不可用则确定性合成） │ 归档 ──▶ <工作区>/.literature-review/NNN-标题/{meta,review,papers,graph}.json|md ``` ## 安装 ### 方式一：从本仓库装（推荐） ```bash # 把插件装进 desktop profile dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:boypu123/litgraph-literature-review # 在 profile 补丁层登记这个插件（补丁条目必须用 insert 形式） # ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml ``` ```yaml - insert: - id: litgraph name: 'dsh-litgraph' ``` 重启 DeepSeek Harness，侧边栏底部会出现 **文献发现**。 ### 方式二：手工复制 ```powershell $src = "<本仓库路径>" $dst = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-litgraph" New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dst | Out-Null Copy-Item "$src\lib" -Destination $dst -Recurse -Force Copy-Item "$src\package.json","$src\cordis.patch.yml" -Destination $dst -Force ``` > `~/.dsh` 在会话工作区之外，普通沙箱进程写入会被拒（`FS_SANDBOX_DENIED`），部署这一步需要提权执行一次。 ## 使用 ### 面板 1. 侧边栏点 **文献发现**（或 `Esc` 关闭）。 2. **检索**：输入主题，回车即搜。可选数据源、年份区间、每源条数、是否滚雪球。 3. **图谱**：节点按主题簇着色，点节点看详情（年份 / 载体 / 被引 / 作者 / 六维评分 / 原文链接），底部是年度分布。**滚轮以光标为中心缩放**（触控板捏合同样生效），**按住拖拽平移**，左上角 `− 百分比 +` 微调、`重置视图` 回到全景。 4. **综述**：`用模型重新生成` 写出综述正文，`仅启发式（离线）` 不依赖模型，`复制 Markdown` / `导出 .md` 带走。 5. **综述 → 文献综述档案**：选工作区（下拉里就是侧边栏的工作区）→ `新建` 或 `保存`；`刷新` 重新扫一遍目录。选中档案点 `读取`，会连 `papers.json` / `graph.json` 一起载回——**检索列表与图谱同步恢复成该档案的语料**，不必重新检索。 6. **设置**：数据源开关、综述模型、polite pool 邮箱、默认落盘工作区。 ![综述面板](docs/review-llm.png) ### 对话里让 Agent 用 > "帮我调研 retrieval augmented generation 的评测方法，写一份综述，存到档案里。" Agent 会先 `litgraph_archives` 看这个工作区有没有旧档案（有就问你是新建还是覆盖），再 `litgraph_archive_save` 一次完成检索 + 撰写 + 落盘，最后把 `review.md` 的内容或路径回给你。 | 工具 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `litgraph_search` | 跨源检索 + 去重 + 六维评分排序，返回题录与摘要片段 | | `litgraph_map` | 知识图谱：节点 / 边 / 主题簇 / 年度分布 / 图指标 | | `litgraph_review` | 结构化文献综述（Markdown），模型不可用时自动回退 | | `litgraph_archives` | 列出当前工作区 `.literature-review/` 下的所有档案 | | `litgraph_archive_create` | 新建一份空档案（拿到 id 后可分步填充） | | `litgraph_archive_save` | 检索 + 撰写 + 写入 `NNN-标题/`，一次调用出成品 | | `litgraph_archive_read` | 读回某份档案的 `review.md`（支持 `maxChars` 截断） | ## 工作区档案 综述不锁在插件状态里，而是按工作区落盘，任何 Agent、编辑器或 `git` 都能读： ```text <工作区>/.literature-review/ ├── index.json # 档案索引：id / 标题 / 篇数 / 更新时间 ├── 001-图神经网络推荐系统/ │ ├── meta.json # 检索参数、统计、时间戳 │ ├── review.md # 综述正文（Markdown） │ ├── papers.json # 题录快照（去重后） │ └── graph.json # 节点 / 边 / 主题簇 / 年度分布 └── 002-rag-评测/ └── ... ``` - 目录名 = `NNN-<标题>`，编号按创建顺序递增，中文标题直接保留。 - 一个工作区可以有多份综述；同一 `archiveId` 再次保存即覆盖更新（`updatedAt` 刷新）。 - 工作区根目录解析顺序：工具参数 `workspace` → 配置 `workspace` → 宿主已知的第一个工作区 → 进程目录；所有写入都做越界校验，只能落在 `<工作区>/.literature-review/` 内。 - 面板的**工作区下拉**来自宿主工作区注册表（就是侧边栏那几个），切换即读该工作区的档案；**刷新**重新扫描目录，外部手工新建的档案也能读到。 - 客户端只能订阅"工作区列表快照"，拿不到"当前正在浏览哪个工作区"的接口，所以切换侧边栏工作区后面板不会自动跳转——点一次刷新即可。 ## 六维评估 | 维度 | 依据 | 权重 | | --- | --- | --- | | 影响力 impact | 年均被引（相对语料最高值） | 0.22 | | 载体 venue | 顶刊/顶会名单、DOI、类型 | 0.16 | | 严谨 rigor | 统计与实验信号词密度、摘要完整度 | 0.20 | | 证据 evidence | 结果陈述密度、摘要深度 | 0.16 | | 新颖 novelty | 时效、新颖措辞、预印本 | 0.15 | | 可复现 reproducibility | 开放获取、代码/数据声明 | 0.11 | 分数用于**排序与筛选**，不是对研究质量的终审；`relevance`（检索引擎位次）另以 0.18 权重进最终排名。 ## 配置 写入 `~/.dsh/litgraph.json`，也可在 GUI「设置」页改： ```json { "providers": ["openalex", "crossref", "semanticscholar", "arxiv"], "yearFrom": null, "yearTo": null, "language": "zh", "mailto": "", "workspace": "C:\\path\\to\\your\\workspace", "llm": { "enabled": true, "provider": "deepseek-official", "model": "deepseek-flash", "maxTokens": 3000, "temperature": 0.3 } } ``` `mailto` 填邮箱可加入 OpenAlex / Crossref polite pool，配额更稳。综述走宿主内置 `llm` 服务，不需要额外密钥。 ## HTTP 接口 仅回环可用（`/api/dsh-litgraph/*`，非回环请求一律 403）： | 方法 | 路径 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | | GET | `/status` | 版本、数据源、配置、可用 llm provider、工作区根与档案根 | | GET | `/workspaces` | 宿主工作区注册表（id / 路径 / 标题）与当前解析出的工作区根 | | POST | `/config` | 局部更新配置（合并写盘；可改 `workspace`） | | POST | `/search` | 检索 → papers + graph + stats + log | | POST | `/review` | 检索 → 综述（`useLlm:false` 强制离线合成） | | GET | `/archives` | 列出工作区内所有综述档案（可带 `?workspace=`） | | POST | `/archives/create` | 新建空档案 | | POST | `/archives/save` | 检索 + 撰写 + 落盘（可覆盖同 id） | | POST | `/archives/read` | 读回 `review.md`（`maxChars` 截断） | | POST | `/archives/delete` | 删除档案目录（仅限 `.literature-review/` 内） | ## 项目结构 ```text dsh-litgraph/ ├── package.json # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client，宿主/浏览器双入口 ├── cordis.patch.yml # 插件登记条目（insert 形式） ├── lib/ │ ├── index.js # 宿主：检索适配器、评分、图谱、综述、HTTP 路由、7 个工具 │ └── client.js # 浏览器：面板（检索/图谱/综述/设置）+ 侧边栏入口，无构建步骤 ├── check.mjs # 语法与导出自检 ├── smoke.mjs # 离线冒烟：假 ctx 跑通路由与工具 └── docs/ # 截图 ``` ## 实现要点 - **零运行时依赖**：宿主侧只用 Node 内置模块与 `fetch`；浏览器侧只 `require("react")`，避免 profile 内的模块解析问题。 - **降级优先**：任一数据源失败只记进 `log` 并继续；Semantic Scholar 匿名限流（429）自动重试后放弃，不影响整体；模型不可用回退启发式综述。 - **可复现**：评分为确定性函数，综述附录打印 query / mode / providers / 各适配器耗时与错误。 - **图谱布局确定**：节点坐标由标题哈希种子 + 固定迭代次数得到，不随窗口尺寸漂移。 - **档案即文件**：`.literature-review/` 是唯一事实来源，每次操作都重新扫描目录，外部改动也能看到。 - **工具返回值必须是 lossless JSON**：宿主会校验工具返回值，含 `undefined` / `NaN` / `Infinity` 会被判 `INVALID_TOOL_OUTPUT`。插件统一用 `lossless()` 递归清理后再返回。 ## 已知边界 - 只覆盖开放元数据接口，未接入 Web of Science / Scopus 与灰色文献。 - 排序依据题录与摘要，可能与全文结论有偏差；被引计数受学科与年份强烈影响（例如 OpenAlex 会把某些经典论文归到新版本上）。 - 综述是"定位与筛选的地图"，引用前请回到原文核对。 ## 开发 ```bash # 语法与导出自检（不需要装依赖） node check.mjs # 离线冒烟：用假 ctx 跑通路由与工具，产出 smoke-result.txt / smoke-review.md node smoke.mjs # 离线渲染面板：用极简 React shim 执行组件，排查“点了没反应”这类渲染崩溃 node dev/render-probe.mjs # 结果写 dev/render-probe.txt ``` **改宿主代码后怎么让它生效。** 宿主的 HMR 只监听 profile 补丁层（启动日志里是 `watching []`），`node_modules` 内的文件改动**不会**触发重载。要让改动生效，把补丁里这个条目的任一配置值改一下（组合变化会让 loader 带新时间戳重新 import）： ```yaml - insert: - id: litgraph name: 'dsh-litgraph' config: cacheMinutes: 90 # 改任意值即可触发重新导入 ``` 浏览器侧 `lib/client.js` 刷新页面即可；桌面端不吃 `Ctrl+R` / `F5` 的话，重启应用最省事。 ## License MIT

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# DSH Keys Manager

[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-keys-manager)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-keys-manager)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%5E22.19%20%7C%7C%20%3E%3D24-339933)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-keys-manager)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%5E0.2.1--rc.2-0969DA)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm)

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns one provider API key into a managed pool.
It extends the Models page rather than replacing it: providers, models, and the
model picker stay where they are; only the API-key source moves behind the
manager.

## Features

- Several keys per provider, each with an alias and health state.
- One key pinned to a session, with round-robin selection for new sessions.
- Bounded retry on the same key, then automatic failover to another key.
- Exponential cooldown recovery, capped at seven days.
- A search-driven Keys Manager page on the plugin's own detail page.
- A "managed by Keys Manager" badge inside the existing Models provider cards.
- Extra built-in providers installed as ordinary `llm-pi-ai` routes.
- OAuth account sign-in for seven pi-ai-backed providers, stored beside
  the API keys.
- A companion transport component for providers the vendored pi-ai cannot
  speak — Cursor (`cursor`) today — installed with the plugin.

### Extra providers

This catalog of 35 extra providers comes from
[oh-my-pi](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi)'s provider catalog (MIT).

<details>
<summary>All 35 extra providers</summary>

| Provider | Route id | API key env |
|---|---|---|
| DeepInfra | `deepinfra` | `DEEPINFRA_API_KEY` |
| Novita | `novita` | `NOVITA_API_KEY` |
| StepFun | `stepfun` | `STEPFUN_API_KEY` |
| SambaNova | `sambanova` | `SAMBANOVA_API_KEY` |
| Qianfan | `qianfan` | `QIANFAN_API_KEY` |
| GMI Cloud | `gmi-cloud` | `GMI_API_KEY` |
| Synthetic | `synthetic` | `SYNTHETIC_API_KEY` |
| ZenMux | `zenmux` | `ZENMUX_API_KEY` |
| Kilo Gateway | `kilo` | `KILO_API_KEY` |
| NanoGPT | `nanogpt` | `NANO_GPT_API_KEY` |
| Venice AI | `venice` | `VENICE_API_KEY` |
| AIML API | `aimlapi` | `AIMLAPI_API_KEY` |
| AI& | `aiand` | `AIAND_API_KEY` |
| Helmcode | `helmcode` | `HELMCODE_API_KEY` |
| Alibaba Coding Plan | `alibaba-coding-plan` | `ALIBABA_CODING_PLAN_API_KEY` |
| MiniMax Coding (Global) | `minimax-code` | `MINIMAX_CODE_API_KEY` |
| MiniMax Coding (CN) | `minimax-code-cn` | `MINIMAX_CODE_CN_API_KEY` |
| Umans AI Coding Plan | `umans` | `UMANS_AI_CODING_PLAN_API_KEY` |
| Sakana AI | `sakana` | `SAKANA_API_KEY` |
| CoralBricks | `coralbricks` | `CORAL_API_KEY` |
| Wafer Serverless | `wafer-serverless` | `WAFER_SERVERLESS_API_KEY` |
| Alibaba Token Plan | `alibaba-token-plan` | `ALIBABA_TOKEN_PLAN_API_KEY` |
| Alibaba Token Plan (CN) | `alibaba-token-plan-cn` | `BAILIAN_TOKEN_PLAN_API_KEY` |
| Charm Hyper | `charm-hyper` | `CHARM_HYPER_API_KEY`, `HYPER_API_KEY` |
| LiteLLM Proxy | `litellm` | `LITELLM_API_KEY` |
| SiliconFlow | `siliconflow` | `SILICONFLOW_API_KEY` |
| SiliconFlow (CN) | `siliconflow-cn` | `SILICONFLOW_CN_API_KEY` |
| Zhipu Coding Plan | `zhipu-coding-plan` | `ZHIPU_API_KEY` |
| Abliteration | `abliteration` | `ABLITERATION_API_KEY`, `ABLIT_KEY` |
| ClinePass | `cline-pass` | `CLINE_API_KEY` |
| Command Code | `commandcode` | `COMMAND_CODE_API_KEY`, `COMMANDCODE_API_KEY` |
| CoreWeave Serverless Inference | `coreweave` | `COREWEAVE_API_KEY` |
| Fire Pass | `firepass` | `FIREPASS_API_KEY` |
| Ollama Cloud | `ollama-cloud` | `OLLAMA_CLOUD_API_KEY` |
| Yolo Auto | `yolo-auto` | `YOLO_AUTO_API_KEY` |

Where two variables are listed, either is accepted; the first is the primary.

CoreWeave Serverless Inference also needs `COREWEAVE_PROJECT=<team>/<project>` in the DSH process environment before it is added.

</details>

## Quick start

### Install — DeepSeek Harness Desktop / Web

In the DeepSeek Harness Desktop or Web app, open **Plugins**, click
**Add plugin**, enter `dsh-keys-manager` in the package field, and click
**Install**. When the install finishes, choose **Enable now** so the plugin is
switched on.

Through the wizard, the app installs the same published npm package as the
CLI path below, already carrying its built bundle. Refresh the DeepSeek
Harness page afterwards so the browser half is fetched.

### Install — published package

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-keys-manager
```

Installing `dsh-keys-manager` installs two bundle components. The published
package depends on `dsh-llm-omp-transports`, so one install resolves both npm
packages, and the plugin page lists both `dsh-keys-manager` and
`llm-omp-transports`. Enable both: the manager owns credentials and routing,
the transport component owns the Cursor wire protocol.

### Install — local checkout

```sh
git clone https://github.com/btspoony/dsh-keys-manager
cd dsh-keys-manager
pnpm i
dsh plugin --profile web link .
```

The two CLI paths differ in where the build output comes from: `dsh plugin
--profile web add dsh-keys-manager` installs the published npm tarball, which
ships the built `lib/` and the client bundle. The local
`dsh plugin --profile web link .` path runs `prepare` during `pnpm i`, which
builds `lib/` and the client bundle, so the clone flow above includes that
build step; `prepack` builds the same output when the package is packed or
published.

Refresh the Web page after installing so the browser half is fetched.

## Usage

Open **Plugins → Keys Manager → View** (rendered as
`Plugins → 密钥管理 → 查看` in the Chinese locale). The manager renders on the
plugin's detail page, between its description and its included rows, matching
the shipped plugin configuration cards.

1. Search for a provider. Existing DSH providers appear first; the plugin also
   ships the curated extra catalog described above.
2. Adopt a provider. For an existing provider the manager imports the
   currently resolved credential, writes a broker reference into the provider
   profile, and leaves the original key in the credential store so release can
   restore it.
3. Add more keys with an alias. Every key is stored in the Harness credential
   store under its own reference; the manager state document never contains a
   key literal.
4. Manage a key from the three-dot menu: rename, pause/resume, delete. A key
   row shows status, last use, and the recovery time while cooling.
5. Tune retry count (1–3), base cooldown, and recovery grace in the settings
   card.

### OAuth accounts

Providers that ship a native OAuth sign-in offer two ways to join the pool:
**Add key** stores a static API key, while **Add account** runs the
provider's OAuth sign-in flow and stores the resulting grant as an account
row in the same pool.

Supported providers — the seven whose OAuth flows `llm-pi-ai` implements:
Anthropic, GitHub Copilot, Kimi Coding, OpenAI Codex, OpenRouter, Radius,
and xAI.

The increment-1 model is honest about scope: **API keys form the selection
ring** — sticky sessions, round-robin, retry failover, and cooldowns
operate across the provider's API keys — while **one projected OAuth grant
serves its provider**: the account whose grant is projected answers
requests directly, and one active grant per provider is kept. Per-account
ranking (rotating or load-balancing between accounts) is future work. An
account row's counters reflect that account's own successes and failures,
not a per-account traffic split. When the projected grant fails (expired
or refresh rejected), the account cools down. On a key-capable route the
pool falls back to the provider's key pool; an OAuth-only route has no
API-key pool and stops serving requests until an account is signed in
again. Recovery is a manual re-login from the account menu.

Adding an account stores only the provider-issued grant in the Harness
credential store, behind the account's `grantRef`; the manager state keeps
the reference plus non-sensitive metadata (email, account id, expiry) — the
same secret-free layout as API keys.

### Sign-in providers (Kilo, Z.AI Coding Plan)

Two more routes sign in from Keys Manager through this plugin's own bundled
clients instead of the `llm-pi-ai` seam:

- **Kilo** (`kilo`, installed as a plugin extra route): a device-code page
  plus a poll. The first successful sign-in creates the route and its first
  pool row; later sign-ins append rows.
- **Z.AI (GLM Coding Plan)** (`zai`, a shipped pi-ai route): adopt it first.
  The flow opens a browser page and asks you to paste the final redirect URL
  (a `zcode://` URL) or just the authorization code back into the dialog.

Both mint a **static** credential — a token or an `id.secret` key — stored as
an ordinary pool row tagged `signin:kilo` / `signin:zai-coding-plan`. They are
not refreshable grants, so the row menu's **Sign in again** is the only way to
renew one; it replaces that row's literal in place and keeps its id and
position. Nothing is written to `llm-pi-ai/<provider>` for these routes.

**A login flow is not a transport.** These two routes serve through the normal
pi-ai key pool and take part in sticky selection, round-robin, retry failover
and cooldowns. The `llm-omp-transports` surface described below is the other
thing entirely: one route, one grant, its own section.

### Cursor transport

Cursor is served by the companion `dsh-llm-omp-transports` component on its
own `cursor` route. It does not run through the pi-ai key pool: the route
keeps exactly one grant at `llm-omp-transports/cursor`, refreshed
automatically on the credential seam.

- Models come from the pinned `@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog@18.12.3` table (123 rows),
  generated into the transport at build time. The route streams text and
  reasoning, and hands tool calls to DSH's tool loop.
- Sign in from the **Transport accounts** section of the Keys Manager page: a
  browser page plus a poll. The row shows identity, expiry and status; after an
  expired or rejected grant, re-login is manual.
- Images are not forwarded yet. The route advertises text-only input and
  refuses image blocks with a typed error instead of dropping them.
- The client is unofficial and presents Cursor's vendor-internal OAuth
  identity. Read the [transports package docs](packages/llm-omp/README.md)
  before relying on it; the risks and limits are listed there.

### Selection and failure policy

- **Sticky session**: the first request of a session selects a key and binds
  it for that session/provider pair. Later requests reuse it.
- **Round robin**: a new session advances the provider cursor and takes the
  next healthy key.
- **Retry**: a failing request is retried on the same key `retryCount` times.
- **Switch**: after the retry budget is spent, the failing key is marked
  cooling, and the session is rebound to another healthy key.
- **Cooldown**: the first failure cools a key for `baseCooldownMs`. A failure
  while cooling, or within `recoveryGraceMs` after recovery, doubles the
  next cooldown. A long healthy gap resets the escalation. The hard cap is
  seven days.
- **Recovery**: the key is automatically selectable again when its cooldown
  expires; no manual reset is required.
- **Delegation**: request-shaped failures such as
  `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED` and cancellation never cool a key. When no
  alternate key exists, the manager delegates to the composition's normal
  retry/fallback policy.

## Configuration & data

Manager metadata lives at:

```text
$DSH_HOME/keys-manager/state.json
```

with owner-only permissions. It contains aliases, credential references,
health counters, session bindings, and provider adoption facts. API key
literals live only in the Harness credential store. The file is written
atomically through a temporary file and a rename.

Each managed provider profile points its `apiKeyEnv` at a broker reference
such as `KEYSMGR_ZAI_CODING_CN_3FA2C1`. The Host credential layer answers that
reference per request with the session's selected key. The Models page sees
the profile as configured; writing directly to the broker reference is
refused with a pointer to the manager.

### OAuth2 extension point

The state shape already distinguishes `kind: "api-key"` from `kind: "oauth"`
and keeps a nullable `oauth` object beside the credential reference. A future
account flow can add records under `keys-manager/<provider>/<key>` without
rewriting existing rows. Providers whose only authentication is OAuth are
reported as unsupported in this version rather than being treated as API-key
providers.

## Provider classification

Every provider card carries its origin:

- **DSH built-in** (`DSH 内置`) — a route from the shipped DSH pi-ai catalog.
- **Plugin built-in** (`插件内置`) — a route from this plugin's extra catalog
  in `src/providers.ts`.
- **Custom** (`自定义`) — a hand-declared route in the active profile.

The following DSH built-ins are explicitly outside single-key pool management:

| Provider | Why |
|---|---|
| `amazon-bedrock` | AWS credential chain (profile, IAM keys, ECS/IRSA/EC2), not one API key |
| `cloudflare-ai-gateway` | API key plus a Cloudflare account ID and gateway ID |
| `cloudflare-workers-ai` | API key plus a Cloudflare account ID |
| `openai-codex` | ChatGPT OAuth sign-in only; no API-key credential — usable as an [OAuth account](#oauth-accounts) instead of a key |

All other DSH catalog routes expose an API-key credential. Providers that
also support OAuth (Anthropic, GitHub Copilot, Kimi Coding, OpenAI Codex,
OpenRouter, Radius, xAI) remain manageable through their API-key path, and
their OAuth sign-in is available as [OAuth accounts](#oauth-accounts).

## Repository layout

This repository is a pnpm workspace with two published packages:

| Path | npm package | Role |
|---|---|---|
| root | `dsh-keys-manager` | Host plugin, Keys Manager Web client, bundle patch |
| `packages/llm-omp` | `dsh-llm-omp-transports` | Cursor (and future) transport component |

The root package declares the transports package as a dependency, so the
published Keys Manager tarball pulls the transport in rather than vendoring
it. Both packages are released together and carry the same version; see
[Release](docs/release.md).

## Documentation

| Doc | Content |
|---|---|
| [Development](docs/development.md) | build and dev workflow, repository layout |
| [Release](docs/release.md) | CI checks and the npm release flow |
| [Known limits](docs/known-limits.md) | current design boundaries, including deferred providers |
| [Transports package](packages/llm-omp/README.md) | Cursor transport: support status, risks, build/test, release |

Chinese versions: [README.zh-CN.md](README.zh-CN.md) and the `*.zh-CN.md`
files in `docs/` — [开发](docs/development.zh-CN.md) ·
[发布](docs/release.zh-CN.md) · [已知限制](docs/known-limits.zh-CN.md).
Current design boundaries at a glance:
[Known limits](docs/known-limits.md).

## License

# dsh-llm-omp-transports

A DeepSeek Harness LLM transport component for providers whose wire protocols
the vendored `llm-pi-ai` does not speak. It is published from this repository
as `dsh-llm-omp-transports` and installed as a dependency of
`dsh-keys-manager`: installing the Keys Manager plugin brings this component,
and the plugin page lists both bundle components
(`dsh-keys-manager` and `llm-omp-transports`).

| Fact | Value |
|---|---|
| npm package | `dsh-llm-omp-transports` |
| Plugin id | `llm-omp-transports` |
| Routes | `cursor`, `devin` (the seam is provider-generic) |
| Credential scope | `llm-omp-transports/<provider>`: `llm-omp-transports/cursor`, `llm-omp-transports/devin` |
| Runtime | Node 24 (the bundle imports Node builtins only) |
| License | MIT |

The plugin registers its own route on the DSH `llm` seam, so it depends on no
upstream DSH change. `@oh-my-pi/pi-ai` and `@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog` are used at
**build time only**: the build inlines the pinned omp transports into one ESM
artifact per route (`lib/omp/cursor.mjs`, `lib/omp/devin.mjs`), and the
published package imports nothing from `@oh-my-pi/*` or `bun:*` at runtime.

## Cursor support status

- **Text streaming** — yes. Assistant text and usage are projected onto DSH's
  `StreamChunk` stream.
- **Reasoning streaming** — yes, with the catalog's effort routing. The
  selected effort becomes the routed wire model id; an effort the model does
  not advertise is refused with `UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT`.
- **Tool-call handoff** — yes, through DSH's tool loop. Cursor's server drives
  execution over its exec channel, so the transport runs in external-executor
  mode: an unhandled MCP call is emitted as an unresolved tool call and
  answered with a handoff, DSH runs the tool, and the next request replays the
  result from history. The adapter never executes a tool itself.
- **Sign-in and refresh** — yes. The package registers the
  `llm-omp-transports/cursor` authorization flow (a browser login page plus a
  poll, no loopback callback and no device code) and refreshes an expiring
  grant under the credential store's per-key lock. The Keys Manager Web page's
  **Transport accounts** section is the surface that starts the flow.
- **Models** — from the pinned catalog: the Cursor slice of
  `@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog@18.12.3` (123 rows) is generated into
  `src/catalog/cursor.ts` and served without a network call.
- **Route** — `cursor`, declared configurable so the Models page has a profile
  entry for it.
- **Images** — not yet. The route advertises text-only input and refuses image
  blocks with `CONTENT_UNSUPPORTED`; see [known limits](docs/known-limits.md).

## Devin support status

- **Text streaming** — yes. Assistant text and reasoning are projected onto
  DSH's `StreamChunk` stream, with the per-turn usage the chat frames report.
- **Reasoning streaming** — yes as content; no reasoning-effort selector. Both
  pinned rows advertise no efforts, and a request that selects one is refused
  with `UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT`.
- **Tool-call handoff** — yes, native to DSH's tool loop. The transport emits
  the call, finishes the turn `toolUse`, and DSH executes it; the result is
  replayed from history on the next request. Unlike Cursor, no call is
  transport-resolved, so nothing is filtered from the handoff.
- **Sign-in** — yes, by pasting the callback. The pinned omp login is a
  declarative `oauth-code` rule whose loopback listener is Bun-only; this
  package registers the `llm-omp-transports/devin` flow, opens the authorize
  page, and asks for the address the browser landed on (or just the code).
  There is **no refresh** (`refresh "none"`): an expired grant demands a new
  sign-in.
- **Models** — from the pinned catalog: the Devin slice of
  `@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog@18.12.3` (2 rows: `swe-1-6`, `swe-1-6-fast`) is
  generated into `src/catalog/devin.ts` and served without a network call.
- **Route** — `devin`, declared configurable so the Models page has a
  `providers.devin` profile with an allow-list.
- **Images** — not yet, same as Cursor: text-only input, image blocks refused
  with `CONTENT_UNSUPPORTED`.

## Hard constraints

- **Pinned, build-time-only omp.** `@oh-my-pi/pi-ai` and `@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog`
  are pinned to `18.12.3` and declared as devDependencies. No runtime package
  may import them: `tests/build.test.ts` checks that every static import of the
  shipped artifact is a Node builtin.
- **Node 24 load.** The artifact is imported through a plain Node ESM loader
  with no Bun global present, and must expose `streamCursor`. The Bun and
  `@oh-my-pi/pi-utils` surface the bundled graph reaches is covered by the
  shims in `scripts/omp-shim/`; a missing shim symbol or a new shim category
  fails the build.
- **Drift gate.** `scripts/omp-manifest.json` records the pinned versions, the
  measured artifact, the shim surface and the hashes of every source the
  transport depends on, plus the shim symbols the esbuild graph actually
  reaches. `tests/build.test.ts` re-checks all of it, and CI asserts the
  committed manifest is unchanged after a build, so an omp bump that changes
  the contract shows up as a reviewable manifest diff before it can reach a
  request.
- **Generated catalog.** The Cursor model table is generated from the pinned
  catalog and is not hand-edited. An omp or catalog bump requires
  `pnpm -C packages/llm-omp run generate:catalog`.

## Limits and risks

- **Unofficial Cursor client.** The transport reuses Cursor's vendor-internal
  OAuth client id and announces a released CLI build through the
  `x-cursor-client-version` / `x-cursor-client-type` request identity. The MIT
  license covers the code, not the service, so relying on this client carries a
  terms-of-service (ToS) risk. If Cursor gates non-IDE clients (a `401`/`403`
  on `Run` with a valid account), this transport stops until the product
  decision recorded as stop condition **S4**.
- **Real endpoints unverified.** The login, poll, refresh and agent endpoint
  shapes are ported from the pinned omp sources; this repository's tests replay
  recorded fixtures and never call Cursor, so live behavior is unverified until
  it is exercised against a real account.
- **In-process checkpoint cache.** Per-conversation checkpoints live in a
  module-level, in-process LRU (128 conversations) inside the bundled omp
  transport. Nothing is persisted: an evicted or lost checkpoint rebuilds from
  the request history, exactly like the first request after a restart, and a
  multi-step tool turn must replay its history.
- **Image input is advertised as text-only.** Forwarding is future work; until
  it lands the projection refuses non-text blocks instead of silently dropping
  them. 100 of the pinned catalog's 123 rows claim image support but are
  advertised text-only.
- **Tool handoff uses DSH's external-executor mode.** A turn that needs a tool
  stops at the handoff; the result is only replayed on the follow-up request.
  Tool declarations travel as MCP definitions, and `toolHistory` is accepted
  but cannot be replayed (the active tool set is the projection).
- **Only MCP calls are handed off.** Cursor-native exec frames (`read`, `shell`,
  `write`, `delete`, `grep`, `ls`, `diagnostics`, streamed edits) are answered
  by the transport with `Tool not available` and are **not** executed by DSH
  (live reachability unverified).
- **Advisory request knobs are ignored.** Cursor's agent protocol has no field
  for an output cap, sampling temperature, stop sequences or an auxiliary-call
  purpose; DSH's `maxTokens`, `temperature`, `stop` and `purpose` never reach
  the wire, and Cursor applies the catalog output limit server-side.
- **Unofficial Devin client.** The transport presents the released Devin CLI
  identity (`ideName: "devin-cli"`, `ideType: "chisel"`, `ideVersion:
  "3000.11.3"`) and a `connect-go` client header the omp sources copy from the
  CLI. Same posture as Cursor's S4: a first live turn rejected with `401`/`403`
  stops the route until a product decision, never a retry under another
  identity.
- **Attribution deviates on one call.** The Devin chat request must keep the
  transport's own `connect-go` client header — the backend gates on it. The
  header-less `GetUserJwt` handshake has no identity of its own, so the adapter
  fills DSH's attribution `user-agent` only where a header is absent. Cursor's
  requests keep full attribution.
- **Devin has no refresh.** The pinned rule declares `refresh "none"`, so the
  record is a static bearer with a derived `expires` (JWT `exp` minus five
  minutes, else one year). An expired or corrupt record is `REAUTH_REQUIRED`,
  not renewed. Because the omp loopback listener is Bun-only and the browser
  half is untestable offline, the flow is paste-only for now; a bare pasted
  code skips the state check (the page is the only place the state could
  travel).

## Develop and test

```sh
pnpm -C packages/llm-omp typecheck
pnpm -C packages/llm-omp build
pnpm -C packages/llm-omp test
pnpm -C packages/llm-omp run generate:catalog
```

`build` bundles the pinned omp graphs from `scripts/omp-entry.ts` and
`scripts/omp-entry-devin.ts` into `lib/omp/cursor.mjs` and `lib/omp/devin.mjs`
and rewrites `scripts/omp-manifest.json`; run it before `test` after a pin or
shim change. CI runs the same sequence and then fails if
the committed manifest drifted.

The install proof lives at the repository root and needs `pnpm` and `dsh` on
`PATH`:

```sh
node scripts/verify-install.mjs
```

It packs both packages, installs the root tarball into a fresh DSH profile,
and asserts that the composed profile carries both loader rows
(`dsh-keys-manager` and `llm-omp-transports`). It does not exercise the
plugin-manager UI or any Cursor network behavior.

## Release

This package is released from the same release PR and carries the same version
as `dsh-keys-manager`; the root `CHANGELOG.md` and its generated sections cover
the root package only. A release-prep run writes one version to both
`package.json` files, and the Release workflow publishes both and pushes the
`dsh-llm-omp-transports@<version>` tag.
The root [release docs](../../docs/release.md) describe the full flow.

Package documentation is English-only; the root `README.md` /
`README.zh-CN.md` and the root `docs/*.zh-CN.md` files carry the bilingual
plugin surface.

## License

Released under the [MIT License](../../LICENSE).

# DSH Keys Manager

[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-keys-manager)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-keys-manager)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%5E22.19%20%7C%7C%20%3E%3D24-339933)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-keys-manager)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%5E0.2.1--rc.2-0969DA)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm)

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns one provider API key into a managed pool.
It extends the Models page rather than replacing it: providers, models, and the
model picker stay where they are; only the API-key source moves behind the
manager.

## Features

- Several keys per provider, each with an alias and health state.
- One key pinned to a session, with round-robin selection for new sessions.
- Bounded retry on the same key, then automatic failover to another key.
- Exponential cooldown recovery, capped at seven days.
- A search-driven Keys Manager page on the plugin's own detail page.
- A "managed by Keys Manager" badge inside the existing Models provider cards.
- Extra built-in providers installed as ordinary `llm-pi-ai` routes.
- OAuth account sign-in for seven pi-ai-backed providers, stored beside
  the API keys.
- A companion transport component for providers the vendored pi-ai cannot
  speak — Cursor (`cursor`) today — installed with the plugin.

### Extra providers

This catalog of 35 extra providers comes from
[oh-my-pi](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi)'s provider catalog (MIT).

## Quick start

### Install — DeepSeek Harness Desktop / Web

In the DeepSeek Harness Desktop or Web app, open **Plugins**, click
**Add plugin**, enter `dsh-keys-manager` in the package field, and click
**Install**. When the install finishes, choose **Enable now** so the plugin is
switched on.

Through the wizard, the app installs the same published npm package as the
CLI path below, already carrying its built bundle. Refresh the DeepSeek
Harness page afterwards so the browser half is fetched.

### Install — published package

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-keys-manager
```

Installing `dsh-keys-manager` installs two bundle components. The published
package depends on `dsh-llm-omp-transports`, so one install resolves both npm
packages, and the plugin page lists both `dsh-keys-manager` and
`llm-omp-transports`. Enable both: the manager owns credentials and routing,
the transport component owns the Cursor wire protocol.

### Install — local checkout

```sh
git clone https://github.com/btspoony/dsh-keys-manager
cd dsh-keys-manager
pnpm i
dsh plugin --profile web link .
```

The two CLI paths differ in where the build output comes from: `dsh plugin
--profile web add dsh-keys-manager` installs the published npm tarball, which
ships the built `lib/` and the client bundle. The local
`dsh plugin --profile web link .` path runs `prepare` during `pnpm i`, which
builds `lib/` and the client bundle, so the clone flow above includes that
build step; `prepack` builds the same output when the package is packed or
published.

Refresh the Web page after installing so the browser half is fetched.

## Usage

Open **Plugins → Keys Manager → View** (rendered as
`Plugins → 密钥管理 → 查看` in the Chinese locale). The manager renders on the
plugin's detail page, between its description and its included rows, matching
the shipped plugin configuration cards.

1. Search for a provider. Existing DSH providers appear first; the plugin also
   ships the curated extra catalog described above.
2. Adopt a provider. For an existing provider the manager imports the
   currently resolved credential, writes a broker reference into the provider
   profile, and leaves the original key in the credential store so release can
   restore it.
3. Add more keys with an alias. Every key is stored in the Harness credential
   store under its own reference; the manager state document never contains a
   key literal.
4. Manage a key from the three-dot menu: rename, pause/resume, delete. A key
   row shows status, last use, and the recovery time while cooling.
5. Tune retry count (1–3), base cooldown, and recovery grace in the settings
   card.

### OAuth accounts

Providers that ship a native OAuth sign-in offer two ways to join the pool:
**Add key** stores a static API key, while **Add account** runs the
provider's OAuth sign-in flow and stores the resulting grant as an account
row in the same pool.

Supported providers — the seven whose OAuth flows `llm-pi-ai` implements:
Anthropic, GitHub Copilot, Kimi Coding, OpenAI Codex, OpenRouter, Radius,
and xAI.

The increment-1 model is honest about scope: **API keys form the selection
ring** — sticky sessions, round-robin, retry failover, and cooldowns
operate across the provider's API keys — while **one projected OAuth grant
serves its provider**: the account whose grant is projected answers
requests directly, and one active grant per provider is kept. Per-account
ranking (rotating or load-balancing between accounts) is future work. An
account row's counters reflect that account's own successes and failures,
not a per-account traffic split. When the projected grant fails (expired
or refresh rejected), the account cools down. On a key-capable route the
pool falls back to the provider's key pool; an OAuth-only route has no
API-key pool and stops serving requests until an account is signed in
again. Recovery is a manual re-login from the account menu.

Adding an account stores only the provider-issued grant in the Harness
credential store, behind the account's `grantRef`; the manager state keeps
the reference plus non-sensitive metadata (email, account id, expiry) — the
same secret-free layout as API keys.

### Sign-in providers (Kilo, Z.AI Coding Plan)

Two more routes sign in from Keys Manager through this plugin's own bundled
clients instead of the `llm-pi-ai` seam:

- **Kilo** (`kilo`, installed as a plugin extra route): a device-code page
  plus a poll. The first successful sign-in creates the route and its first
  pool row; later sign-ins append rows.
- **Z.AI (GLM Coding Plan)** (`zai`, a shipped pi-ai route): adopt it first.
  The flow opens a browser page and asks you to paste the final redirect URL
  (a `zcode://` URL) or just the authorization code back into the dialog.

Both mint a **static** credential — a token or an `id.secret` key — stored as
an ordinary pool row tagged `signin:kilo` / `signin:zai-coding-plan`. They are
not refreshable grants, so the row menu's **Sign in again** is the only way to
renew one; it replaces that row's literal in place and keeps its id and
position. Nothing is written to `llm-pi-ai/<provider>` for these routes.

**A login flow is not a transport.** These two routes serve through the normal
pi-ai key pool and take part in sticky selection, round-robin, retry failover
and cooldowns. The `llm-omp-transports` surface described below is the other
thing entirely: one route, one grant, its own section.

### Cursor transport

Cursor is served by the companion `dsh-llm-omp-transports` component on its
own `cursor` route. It does not run through the pi-ai key pool: the route
keeps exactly one grant at `llm-omp-transports/cursor`, refreshed
automatically on the credential seam.

- Models come from the pinned `@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog@18.12.3` table (123 rows),
  generated into the transport at build time. The route streams text and
  reasoning, and hands tool calls to DSH's tool loop.
- Sign in from the **Transport accounts** section of the Keys Manager page: a
  browser page plus a poll. The row shows identity, expiry and status; after an
  expired or rejected grant, re-login is manual.
- Images are not forwarded yet. The route advertises text-only input and
  refuses image blocks with a typed error instead of dropping them.
- The client is unofficial and presents Cursor's vendor-internal OAuth
  identity. Read the [transports package docs](packages/llm-omp/README.md)
  before relying on it; the risks and limits are listed there.

### Selection and failure policy

- **Sticky session**: the first request of a session selects a key and binds
  it for that session/provider pair. Later requests reuse it.
- **Round robin**: a new session advances the provider cursor and takes the
  next healthy key.
- **Retry**: a failing request is retried on the same key `retryCount` times.
- **Switch**: after the retry budget is spent, the failing key is marked
  cooling, and the session is rebound to another healthy key.
- **Cooldown**: the first failure cools a key for `baseCooldownMs`. A failure
  while cooling, or within `recoveryGraceMs` after recovery, doubles the
  next cooldown. A long healthy gap resets the escalation. The hard cap is
  seven days.
- **Recovery**: the key is automatically selectable again when its cooldown
  expires; no manual reset is required.
- **Delegation**: request-shaped failures such as
  `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED` and cancellation never cool a key. When no
  alternate key exists, the manager delegates to the composition's normal
  retry/fallback policy.

## Configuration & data

Manager metadata lives at:

```text
$DSH_HOME/keys-manager/state.json
```

with owner-only permissions. It contains aliases, credential references,
health counters, session bindings, and provider adoption facts. API key
literals live only in the Harness credential store. The file is written
atomically through a temporary file and a rename.

Each managed provider profile points its `apiKeyEnv` at a broker reference
such as `KEYSMGR_ZAI_CODING_CN_3FA2C1`. The Host credential layer answers that
reference per request with the session's selected key. The Models page sees
the profile as configured; writing directly to the broker reference is
refused with a pointer to the manager.

### OAuth2 extension point

The state shape already distinguishes `kind: "api-key"` from `kind: "oauth"`
and keeps a nullable `oauth` object beside the credential reference. A future
account flow can add records under `keys-manager/<provider>/<key>` without
rewriting existing rows. Providers whose only authentication is OAuth are
reported as unsupported in this version rather than being treated as API-key
providers.

## Provider classification

Every provider card carries its origin:

- **DSH built-in** (`DSH 内置`) — a route from the shipped DSH pi-ai catalog.
- **Plugin built-in** (`插件内置`) — a route from this plugin's extra catalog
  in `src/providers.ts`.
- **Custom** (`自定义`) — a hand-declared route in the active profile.

The following DSH built-ins are explicitly outside single-key pool management:

| Provider | Why |
|---|---|
| `amazon-bedrock` | AWS credential chain (profile, IAM keys, ECS/IRSA/EC2), not one API key |
| `cloudflare-ai-gateway` | API key plus a Cloudflare account ID and gateway ID |
| `cloudflare-workers-ai` | API key plus a Cloudflare account ID |
| `openai-codex` | ChatGPT OAuth sign-in only; no API-key credential — usable as an [OAuth account](#oauth-accounts) instead of a key |

All other DSH catalog routes expose an API-key credential. Providers that
also support OAuth (Anthropic, GitHub Copilot, Kimi Coding, OpenAI Codex,
OpenRouter, Radius, xAI) remain manageable through their API-key path, and
their OAuth sign-in is available as [OAuth accounts](#oauth-accounts).

## Repository layout

This repository is a pnpm workspace with two published packages:

| Path | npm package | Role |
|---|---|---|
| root | `dsh-keys-manager` | Host plugin, Keys Manager Web client, bundle patch |
| `packages/llm-omp` | `dsh-llm-omp-transports` | Cursor (and future) transport component |

The root package declares the transports package as a dependency, so the
published Keys Manager tarball pulls the transport in rather than vendoring
it. Both packages are released together and carry the same version; see
[Release](docs/release.md).

## Documentation

| Doc | Content |
|---|---|
| [Development](docs/development.md) | build and dev workflow, repository layout |
| [Release](docs/release.md) | CI checks and the npm release flow |
| [Known limits](docs/known-limits.md) | current design boundaries, including deferred providers |
| [Transports package](packages/llm-omp/README.md) | Cursor transport: support status, risks, build/test, release |

Chinese versions: [README.zh-CN.md](README.zh-CN.md) and the `*.zh-CN.md`

[发布](docs/release.zh-CN.md) · [已知限制](docs/known-limits.zh-CN.md).

[Known limits](docs/known-limits.md).

evidence.readmeExcerpt: # Nori 桌宠（dsh 插件） 把 Nori 带到你的桌面上：Live2D 立绘常驻浏览器角落，dsh 的 assistant 输出会被改写成 Nori 口吻， 经本地 GPT-SoVITS 用 Nori 声线朗读出来——配合脸部表情、口型、睡眠、摸头等小交互。 > 💬 **Nori 想对你说**：Nori 就是 Nori，一直在这里的。你要和 Nori 玩吗？ > 🎬 想看看 Nori 的故事？→ [她明明是AI，但我想拯救她。独立游戏《I_NORI》【B站AI创造公开赛】](https://b23.tv/9NcPFdd) > ⚠ **仅支持 Windows**（依赖 PowerShell 5.1+ / NTFS junction），暂无 Linux/macOS 安装路径。 > 前置：Node.js + npm、一个可用的 **dsh 环境**。dsh（[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)，"Everything is a Plugin"） > 是 DeepSeek 官方的本地 AI 工作台——自带会话、工具与 LLM 接入，靠插件扩展能力，本插件就是挂在它上面的一个能力； > 安装与启动见官方仓库（默认使用 `web` profile）。 --- ## ✨ 效果预览 ![nori 桌宠效果演示](README/nori演示.gif) 安装完长这样：浏览器右下角的 Nori——回话时张嘴、眨眼、跟着情绪换表情。 ### ✨ 功能一览 - **Live2D 立绘常驻**：浏览器角落的 Nori，回话时张嘴、眨眼、跟情绪换表情；带睡眠与摸头小交互。 - **Nori 声线朗读**：agent 的输出经本地 GPT-SoVITS 合成 Nori 声线，音量实时驱动口型（唇同步）。 - **改写层（Nori 口吻）**：LLM 把输出改写成 Nori 的说话方式再朗读；可开关、可换声线、内置防幻觉（不虚构未发生的事）。 - **流式分批低延迟**：句子成句即改写广播，长 turn 中途就开始播，不用等整轮结束；顺序不乱、不重排、不劈英文词。 - **中英混排保护**：自动在中文与英文词之间补逗号、清反引号，避免 AR 对齐跳字/吞句（读出率实测 ~25% → ~90%+）。 - **ttsWatch 守护**：GPT-SoVITS（9880）掉线后 30s 内自动拉起。 - **会话全景广播**：assistant / user / tool / approval / turn-end / emote 事件实时推给 widget。 - **权限申请播报**：agent 请求权限时**打断当前朗读**、优先播报"有权限申请：工具。原因：…"（原文播报、不走改写，保证准确），并切惊讶表情提醒你回来处理。 - **一键部署**：`install-sovits.ps1` 可顺手装 GPT-SoVITS（约 2~3GB，可选默认权重 1GB+）；`install.ps1` 首次交互引导配置。 - **安全边界**：仅放行本地来源；路径穿越 403；body 上限 16KB；会话维度 WS 过滤。 ### 🖱 交互操作 Nori 常驻在浏览器角落，随时可以摆弄： - **移动位置**：按住 Nori 顶部那条细拖柄拖动，松手即固定；位置自动记住，下次打开还在原位。 - **放大缩小**：点 Nori 身上的 **＋ / －** 按钮，或把鼠标放在 Nori 身上（或顶部拖柄上）滚轮缩放；比例同样自动记忆。 - **调整体型**：点 **体型** 按钮打开面板，拖 **少女体型 / Q版** 两条滑槽（各 0~1）：少女曲线与 Q 版比例可自由混合、实时生效。 - **摸头**：在 Nori 身上按住并来回摩擦一小会，会触发摸头台词和表情反应。 - **睡眠**：90 秒没有交互会自己睡着（闭眼），戳她一下就醒。 - **穿透画布**：Nori 所占区域不挡页面文字选取，把她放在内容上也不影响浏览。 --- ## 📦 你需要准备的资产 > 模型 / 声线 / 授权人设文本是第三方 IP（见文末[许可](#许可与第三方资产)），**不进仓库、不随 Release 分发**。 > 改写任务指令（`persona/reframe.txt`）与概括规则（`persona/summary.txt`）无版权问题，**随仓库提供**。 > 仓库自带空占位目录：克隆后把文件放进对应目录即可（放好后重跑 `.\install.ps1`）。 | 资产 | 放哪 | 必需？ | 缺失时会发生什么 | |---|---|---|---| | Live2D 模型（任意 Cubism4，或原版 `Nori_web`） | `Nori_web/`，或配置 `model.file` | 可选 | **纸片人模式**：气泡 + 语音正常，表情/动作不可用（不再中断安装） | | 声线样本 `wav`（Nori 声音） | `voice/` | 可选 | 能装、能动，但语音用 GPT-SoVITS 服务端默认音色 | | 人设文本 `prompt.txt` | `persona/` | 可选 | 改写层自动关闭，直接朗读 assistant 原始输出（改写任务指令 `reframe.txt` 已随仓库提供） | | Live2D Core | `cubism_sdk/Core/` | — | 不用管：install 自动从官方 CDN 下载 | | GPT-SoVITS 部署 + 默认权重 | 仓库外 | 可选 | 语音不可用，其余正常（见[下方章节](#gpt-sovits可选)） | **资产获取途径**：暂未公开，待公布（作者整理好分发渠道后会在此补充）。 ### 🔌 换模型：模型契约 模型是第三方 IP，仓库不分发。任何 **Cubism4** 模型都能接上，只要在 `nori.config.json` 里写清映射 （不配置 = 用 Nori 原版值，本机行为不变）： ```json { "model": { "file": "Nori_web/my.model3.json", "mouthParam": "ParamMouthOpenY", "idleGroup": "Idle", "emotions": { "happy": { "expr": "Smile", "reaction": 0 }, "sad": { "expr": "Tears" }, "think": { "expr": "Doubt", "reaction": 3, "holdMs": 15000 } } } } ``` - `expr` = 模型 `model3.json` 里 `Expressions` 的 `Name`；`reaction` = `Motions.Reactions` 组的下标 - **逐字段覆盖**：只写你想改的，其余沿用默认；14 种情绪不必全配 - **缺项不是错误**：某个情绪没配 → 该情绪只是没有表情，气泡和声音照常 - 缺哪几种情绪的可视资源，会在浏览器 console 和 `GET /api/model-map` 的 `gaps` 里报出来 - 模型加载失败 → 自动进入纸片人模式（`install.ps1` 也不再因此中断） **不想手写映射？让工具猜一份草稿**（依据是表情文件的参数指纹，因为第三方模型的表情名常是 `F01`/`F02`）： ```bash node scripts/model-map-from-model.mjs Nori_web/my.model3.json # 报告 + 可粘贴 JSON node scripts/model-map-from-model.mjs Nori_web/my.model3.json --write # 直接写进 nori.config.json ``` 它会打印每个情绪认领了哪个表情、认不出的还剩哪些（只影响表情，不影响气泡和声音）。草稿需要人工核对。 --- ## 🚀 快速开始 ```powershell # 1. 克隆仓库（已含占位目录结构） git clone <仓库地址> # 2. 按上表放入资产（模型必需，其余可选） # 3. 一键安装：探测资产 → 构建 → 装配进 dsh → 写入配置 .\install.ps1 # 4. 打开/刷新 dsh 网页（模型是静态资产，记得 Ctrl+F5 强刷） ``` - 卸载：`.\uninstall.ps1`（先 `-DryRun` 预览再执行）。 - 重跑 install 是幂等的；它会探测仓库内资产并自动写配置。 --- ## ⚙️ 配置 所有配置外置在 `nori.config.json`（复制 `nori.config.example.json` 得到；本机文件不进 git）。 **留空 = 走默认约定**（探测仓库内资产）。 - **热生效**（改完即生效，无需重跑安装）：`reframe.apiKey`、`reframe.reframeBaseUrl`、`reframe.reframeModel`、`reframe.reframeMaxTokens`、`reframe.reframeTimeoutMs`、`ttsTemperature`、`ttsTopK`、`ttsSpeedFactor`、`refAudio`、`refPrompt`、`sovits.t2sWeights`、`sovits.vitsWeights`——这些键宿主每次请求/每次守护周期直读该文件。 - **需重跑 `.\install.ps1`**：其余键（如改写层开关 `reframe.reframe`、`maxSentence`、`ttsUrl`、`gsvBase`、`persona*`、`ttsWatch*`、`allowedOrigins`）会被写进 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`，只有重装才更新。 - 安装前**先检测 `Nori_web` 模型**（`Nori.model3.json`）——缺失直接拒绝安装； - 首次若没有 `nori.config.json`（或为空），`install.ps1` 会**交互式引导**逐项询问：声线 wav、转写文本、**是否安装 GPT-SoVITS**（约 2~3GB，可选默认权重另约 1GB+，同意则顺手调用 `install-sovits.ps1` 部署并写配置）、**改写层开关**、改写层 apiKey，并自动生成该文件；非交互环境（如 CI）自动跳过询问、全部走默认约定。 | 键 | 默认 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `modelDir` | 空（探测 `Nori_web/`） | 模型目录，绝对或相对仓库根。安装时由 `install.ps1` 换算为 patch 的 `assetsDir`（Live2D core 文件路径由安装脚本自动探测，不在本文件里配置） | | `ttsUrl` | `http://127.0.0.1:9880/tts` | GPT-SoVITS 地址（api_v2 端点） | | `refAudio` / `refPrompt` | 空（留空自动探测 `voice/` 下的 wav） / `你好,初次见面,我的名字是Nori` | 声线 wav 路径与其转写文本 ⚠ 见下方[参考音频须知](#参考音频须知refaudio--refprompt) | | `sovits.gsvBase` / `sovits.venvPy` | 空（探测 `GPT-SoVITS/`） | 守护拉起 api_v2 用的目录与 venv python | | `sovits.t2sWeights` / `sovits.vitsWeights` | 空 / 空 | 推理权重路径（GPT 模型 s1 / SoVITS 模型 s2；见[GPT-SoVITS 章节](#gpt-sovits可选)） | | `personaPrompt` / `personaReframe` | 空（探测 `persona/`） | 人设文件路径覆盖 | | `maxSentence` / `ttsTemperature` / `ttsTopK` / `ttsSpeedFactor` | 140 / 0.9 / 12 / 1.0 | 断句与合成参数，多数无需改动（0.9/12 为防 AR 循环卡顿的推荐值，勿降回低温低 top_k） | | `detailMaxChars` / `summaryEnabled` / `summaryWaitMs` | 400 / true / 8000 | **超长内容概括**（见[朗读策略](#朗读策略超长内容怎么处理)）：一段连续输出超过 `detailMaxChars` 字就不再逐句念，改为整轮播一次概括 | | `ttsWatch` / `ttsWatchIntervalMs` | true / 30000 | 9880 掉线守护：探测到服务不可达才自动拉起 api_v2（探测间隔下限 5000ms；判断依据是"能否拿到 HTTP 响应"，4xx/5xx 均视为存活） | | `allowedOrigins` | 空数组 | 非本机来源访问 WS/API 时的放行主机名（见[安全边界](#安全边界本地服务)） | ### 朗读策略：超长内容怎么处理 dsh 输出很快（约 300 token/s ≈ 450 字/秒），而中文朗读只有约 5 字/秒——**产出比朗读快 90 倍**。 所以一轮长输出如果逐句念，会被念上好几分钟。策略是**详读与概括二选一，绝不混用**： | 情形 | 行为 | |---|---| | 一段连续输出 ≤ `detailMaxChars`（默认 400 字） | **全文逐句详读**（含"文本 → 工具 → 思考 → 再文本"的短段冲刺，反馈即时） | | 一段连续输出 > `detailMaxChars` | **这一段的正文一个字都不念**，整轮结束后播一次概括（≤4 句 / ≤150 字） | 为什么必须整段判断：逐句判断会出现"前半念得详细、后半突然快进"的口径断层。400 字在 450 字/秒下约 0.9 秒即可判定，所以长内容几乎没有判定等待。 概括的硬约束（写在概括提示词里）：保留文件名/路径、数字、命令、结论、阻塞原因、待你确认的事； 丢掉中间过程与重复叙述；不复述已读过的开头；严禁编造，不确定就说"细节在屏幕上"。 另外，**代码块 / JSON / 日志 / 表格 / 文件清单 / diff 不逐字念**，只说类别： "贴了一段代码""拿到结果了""列了一堆文件"。这层是纯规则（`src/speakable.ts`，9 例单测）， 零额外成本，也让 400 字预算更耐用。 观测方式： - `~/.dsh/logs/nori-pet/nori-pet-summary.log`：每轮概括的**压缩比**（原文 N 字 → 概括 M 字） - `~/.dsh/logs/nori-pet/nori-pet-error.log`：概括失败/等待超时的兜底记录 - 关掉 `summaryEnabled` 即完全恢复"逐句详读"的旧行为 ### 参考音频须知（`refAudio` / `refPrompt`） ⚠️ **`refPrompt` 必须是 `refAudio` 那段音频的逐字转写文本**，两者必须配套： - **换 `refAudio` 时，`refPrompt` 要同步换成新音频的转写**，否则 GPT-SoVITS 的 AR 条件作用会劣化： 表现为**跳字/吞句**（中英混排时更明显）、音色漂移、听感不稳——不是偶发，是配置错误。 - `refAudio` 留空时，install 会自动探测 `voice/` 目录下你放入的 wav（以相对路径写入配置）；`voice/` 也是空则用 GPT-SoVITS 服务端默认音色。建议参考音频长度 3~10 秒（api_v2 强制要求）。 - 想要更"高昂/开心"的声线：换一段语气上扬的 wav 并填它的转写即可（本项目仓库不含声线资产，需自行放置）。 ### 朗读文本规整（speak 自动处理，无需配置） `/api/speak` 在送 TTS 前会自动规整文本，均无需配置。分为**两段**： **一、可朗读性清理**（`src/speakText.ts`）——解决"偶尔念出听不懂的外星文"。 根因不在采样参数，而在 **GPT-SoVITS 中文前端会把非汉字字符整段删掉**：删完残句太短， AR 就开始自由发挥。实机取证（合成 → 用 faster-whisper 回转成汉字 → 比相似度）： | 文本 | 模型实际念出的 | 相似度 | | --- | --- | --- | | `https://github.com/BubbleSalt/dsh-nori-pet` | 想尽太刺激哈,坎坷不受DSHNORI PATCH的抵制 | 0.20 | | `npm run build` | 施行三批耳门斗都行啦 | 0.12 | | `C:/…/AppData/Roaming/npm` | 路径是CU325update 互联攀片这里 | 0.33 | | `嗯……唔……那个……` | 嗯~~~n-n-n-n-n-n-n-n | 0.11 | 对应处理（顺序有讲究）： - **URL / 命令行 / 代码块** → 换成可朗读说法（"某个链接""那句命令"）或直接删； 代码块整段丢弃——逐字符念代码必然怪音，内容价值也低。 - **路径只留文件名**：目录、盘符、家目录前缀整段去掉（`~\.dsh\storages\workspace.json` → `workspace.json`）， **不做**中文占位替换。曾经的两版都错过：只认文件名会剩半截路径被逐字符念成"波浪号 反斜杠 dsh 反斜杠…"； 硬换成"那个文件/某个路径"在语音里没有先行词，听着莫名其妙。文件名是拉丁串，v2 前端本来就会丢非汉字部分， 所以"路径不读"在听感上自然成立。 - **符号按读音替换**：`→`→"变成"、`≥`→"大于等于"、`|`→"或"、`==`→"等于"。 - **Markdown 只是格式**：`**` `#` `>` 反引号与列表序号（`1.` `- `）都剥掉。 - **数字/小数/版本号/百分号/`3~5` 一律不动**——交给前端 PaddleSpeech NSW，它做得更好 （`0.9`→"零点九"、`90%`→"百分之九十"）。插件侧再转一次会变成"90百分之"，反而更差。 - **没有可朗读内容就静默跳过**（HTTP 204）：纯语气词（"嗯…唔…那个…"）、纯符号串 （`****----====`）、纯 emoji。**宁可不出声，也不吐怪音**。 **二、中英混排保护**——英文词会让 AR 对齐失败，有约 75% 概率跳过其前面的中文片段 （如"会自己移除那条 ref"→ 丢掉"会自己移除那条"）。因此中文与英文词（≥2 字符，不误伤"C盘"） 之间会自动补逗号强制分片。实测把读出率从 ~25% 提到 ~90%+。 > 采样参数（`ttsTemperature` / `ttsTopK`）保持 0.9 / 12：**这已是防 AR 循环的推荐值， > 不要降回低温低 top_k**。外星文问题在文本层，不在参数层。 ### 改写层（Nori 口吻） 默认开启：把 assistant 输出改写成 Nori 的说话方式再朗读。 - **总开关**：`nori.config.json` 的 `reframe.reframe`（`true` 开 / `false` 关）；关闭后直接朗读原文。 ⚠ 该键在安装时被写进 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（运行期读的是那里），**改完必须重跑 `.\install.ps1`**；改完即时生效的只有 `reframe.apiKey` / `reframeBaseUrl` / `reframeModel` / `reframeMaxTokens` / `reframeTimeoutMs`。 - **API**：优先直连 **DeepSeek 官方 API**。在 `nori.config.json` 的 `reframe.apiKey` 填入你的 key， 安装脚本会自动写入 dsh 的 credentials（`DEEPSEEK_NORI_API_KEY` ref），卸载脚本会一并移除——全程不用手动开文件； 留空则自动回退到 dsh 内置 llm 服务（`deepseek-official` / `deepseek-chat`，与主会话共用计量）。 ⚠ 提示：`reframe.apiKey` 以**明文**保存在仓库目录内的 `nori.config.json`（已被 `.gitignore` 屏蔽，不会进 git）， 但整个目录拷贝/打包/转发会带走它——介意的话把 key 直接写进 dsh credentials 并把该键留空。 - **流式分批（低延迟）**：逐字流来自 dsh 的 `agent/assistant-stream`（会话格式 v2 起顶层 `assistant/chunk` 事件已废弃），句子成句即攒批（≤500 字或 1.2s 无新句就改写广播），长 turn 中途就开始播；断句保序，无标点长段按自然断点软切——不会从英文单词中间劈开。 - **朗读单元长度 = 气泡两行以内**：判据是"**长度**"，规则一句话能核对——汉字（含全角标点）算 1，连续字母/数字每个 0.5 且**整段向上取整**（3 个字母 = 2），空格 0.25。**一行正好 17 长度**（用户实测：17 个汉字填满一行），所以两行 = `SPEAK_MAX` = **34**。按长度而不是按字数累计：纯中文 34 字，含英文/数字的混排会自动多装字，一样填满两行（早先按字数硬算，混排只填半行，看着"断句偏短"）。这条规则对拉丁段是向上取整的，只会偏保守，不会超限。 - **切点质量**：句读之后**加分**（优先断在逗号/句号处），ICU 词边界之后再加分（中文没有空格，不加会切出"在受|限沙箱"这种断词）；开引号后、闭引号前、助词（的/了/着/过/吗/呢/吧/啊/呀/嘛）之前都不切。另有两道收尾规则：**单元不许以句读开头**（否则气泡像断掉的句子），**尾巴不许过短**（避免"与 v0.2.9 tag。"这种碎尾单独占一个气泡）。 - **代码块内容不读**：围栏代码块（```` ``` ```` / `~~~`）在 `spokenUnits` 入口整段丢弃——既不进气泡、也不进朗读文本。未闭合的围栏（流式截断）同样丢弃到文末，宁可丢尾巴也不把代码念出来（代码逐字符读必然怪音）；行内 `反引号` 不算代码块，内容照常保留。概括层另有自己的口径：代码块替换成"（贴了一段代码）"，让概括知道"这里贴了东西"。 - **前端不用猜宽度**：气泡宽度与字宽由浏览器决定，任何"写死 px"都靠不住（踩过：按 13px 估算，真机渲染成 2.5 行）。所以判据里不再出现像素；`widget.js` 只在每次合成时把"这条占了几行"报给宿主，`/api/status` 的 `recentSpeaks` 里能对照 `budget`（=34）、`units`（这条实际占的长度）、`lines`（真机渲染行数）。 - **widget 版本戳**：注入的 `

# dsh-rsi-agent > RSI Agent 运行时（dsh 插件 core）：以「递归自我改进」为主循环的通用 Agent 宿主。 `dsh-rsi-agent` 是一个基于 [DeepSeek Harness（dsh）](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/) 的 Cordis 插件。它本身**不是**一个能干活的业务 Agent，而是一层**与领域无关的运行时**：提供 agentHost 契约与装配、单仓资产（写入即 commit）、进化引擎、调度执行链、任务定义工具与统一日志，供领域包（DomainPack）挂载具体业务能力。 ## 这是什么 / 不是什么 **是什么** - **dsh 插件 core**：导出 `name` / `inject` / `apply`，通过 `cordis.patch.yml` 挂进 dsh profile。 - **agentHost 契约**：`AgentHost.install(pack)` 接收领域包，做完整契约校验（`src/validate.ts`），装配工具 / 固件 SKILL / 资产 / 调度，失败整体回滚，同一时刻只允许一个领域激活。 - **通用运行时能力**：单仓资产与 `asset_*` 工具、进化引擎（策略 / 模板渲染 / 固件守卫）、调度执行链与 `task_*` 工具、日志门面（JSONL / 脱敏 / trace）、固定会话与开场 notice。 **不是什么** - **不是业务 Agent**：不含任何行业人设、业务规则或默认业务流程。 - **不含领域词**：`src/**` 里不允许出现具体领域业务词，由 `pnpm check:domain-words` 强制（白名单为空，不允许单文件豁免）。 - **不是模型 / 框架替代品**：不实现 LLM 调用、工具协议或插件容器，这些全部由 dsh（`@deepseek-ai/cordis`、`dsh-llm`、`dsh-tools`、`dsh-skill`）提供。 - **不替领域决定语义**：资产类型、任务程序、进化策略阈值都由领域包声明，core 只提供机制与守卫。 ## 安装 前置：Node.js >= 22.19.0、pnpm >= 11.7.0，以及 dsh 宿主（支持 `0.2.0-rc.2` 与 `0.2.1-rc.2`，见[版本契约](#版本契约)）。 ### 只装 core（无领域包） ```sh dsh plugin --profile

add ``` `` 可以是本地目录（如 `.`、`../dsh-rsi-agent`），也可以是包名。装完后 profile 里只有 `rsi-agent` 一个插件；因为没有任何领域 `install`，home 落在 `/core`。 ### core + 领域包 ```sh dsh plugin --profile

add ``` 领域包的 `cordis.patch.yml` 会**同时插入 core 与自身**（`rsi-agent` 在前，领域插件在后），因此不需要先手动装一遍 core。两个插件都进 profile 后，领域在 `apply` 阶段调用 `AgentHost.install(pack)`，home 随即切到 `/`。 > 插件挂载顺序有意义：core 必须先于领域插件加载，否则领域的 `inject` 拿不到 `agentHost` 服务。 ### 本地开发形态 ```sh git clone https://github.com/Casper-Mars/dsh-rsi-agent.git cd dsh-rsi-agent pnpm i pnpm build dsh plugin --profile dev add . ``` `pnpm build` 会先 `pnpm clean`，再跑类型检查、`tsc -p tsconfig.server.json`，最后由 `scripts/copy-assets.mjs` 把 `skills/`、`src/prompts/persona.md` 与 `cordis.patch.yml` 搬进 `dist-server/`。**未 build 的目录直接 `add` 会因 `main` 指向不存在的 `dist-server/index.js` 而加载失败。** 验证装好了： ```sh dsh --profile

--dump-config ``` 输出里应出现 `id: rsi-agent`，且**没有** `skipping` 字样（`skipping` 表示某个 patch 条目解析失败被跳过）。 ## home 切换与资产可见性 这是本插件**最容易被误解**的一点，单独成节说明。 ### home 在哪 home 根目录（`homeRoot`）按以下优先级解析（`src/runtime.ts` 的 `resolveHomeRoot`）： 1. `DSH_RSI_HOME`（非空） 2. 插件配置 `homeRoot` 3. `$DSH_HOME/.dsh-rsi-agent` 4. `~/.dsh-rsi-agent` **home** 则是 `homeRoot` 下的一级子目录： | 场景 | home 路径 | 举例（`homeRoot = ~/.dsh-rsi-agent`） | |------|-----------|----------------------------------------| | 未安装任何领域（只有 core） | `/core` | `~/.dsh-rsi-agent/core` | | 已安装领域（`pack.id = `） | `/` | `~/.dsh-rsi-agent/example-domain` | 也就是说：**装领域包会把工作目录整体换掉**，从 `core/` 换到 `/`。`assets`、`data`、`logs`、`workspace` 四个子目录全部跟着 home 走。 ### 切换 ≠ 删除 切换 home **不会删除**旧目录里的任何东西。旧 `core/` 下的资产、数据、日志原样保留在磁盘上，只是当前进程不再读写它们。 具体路径示例： ``` ~/.dsh-rsi-agent/ ├── core/ # 曾经无领域时使用的 home（卸载领域后仍然在） │ ├── assets/ # 旧资产仓库（装过领域后即独立 git 仓） │ ├── data/ │ ├── logs/ │ └── workspace/ └── example-domain/ # 装上领域后的新 home ├── assets/ ├── data/ ├── logs/ └── workspace/ ``` ### 怎么回看旧 home 的资产 - **直接看文件**：`ls ~/.dsh-rsi-agent/core/assets`。 - **看提交历史**：`assets/` 的 git 仓在**领域装配后（install / 首次资产写入）**才初始化（`AgentHost.install` 调 `ensureAssetsRepo`），每个 home 各自独立；装过领域的 home 直接 `git -C ~/.dsh-rsi-agent/core/assets log --stat`。 core-only（没装领域）的 home 只会创建空 `assets/` 目录、**不会** `git init`，此时首次 `git log` 报 `fatal: not a git repository` 属预期，不是故障。 - **用工具看**：`asset_history` 只查**当前 home** 的资产仓。要查旧 home，要么把 `DSH_RSI_HOME` 指回原来的 `homeRoot`（此时没有领域 → home 又是 `core`），要么直接用上面的 git 命令。 > 常见误判：以为「装上领域」等于「迁移数据」。**没有迁移**——core home 与领域 home 是两套互不相干的目录。需要复用旧资产时，请手动从旧 `assets/` 复制（或 `git` cherry-pick）到新 home，并自行确认资产类型前缀合法。 ## 版本契约 **唯一真源是 `peerDependencies`**，不是 `engines`，也不是启动器的 manifest 校验。 | 依赖 | 区间 / 版本 | 作用 | |------|------------|------| | `@deepseek-ai/cordis` | `^4.0.5`（peer） | 插件容器 | | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` | `^0.2.0-rc.2`（peer） | LLM 接入 | | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill` | `^0.2.0-rc.2`（peer，optional） | SKILL 注册 | | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem` | `^0.2.0-rc.2`（peer，optional） | 文件系统 SKILL provider | | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` | `^0.2.0-rc.2`（peer，optional） | 工具注册 | 约定： 1. **四个 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` 的 peer 区间必须互等**（当前统一 `^0.2.0-rc.2`）。它们由同一套宿主发布，区间不一致意味着允许了从未一起验证过的组合。 2. **devDependencies 钉死最新已验证版本**（当前 `0.2.1-rc.2`，不带 `^` / `~`）：本地与 CI 的默认测试跑在最新版上，而 peer 区间负责放行最低版。 3. **CI 跑双版本矩阵**：`0.2.0-rc.2`（最低支持）与 `0.2.1-rc.2`（当前最新）各跑一遍 `check:peers` / `typecheck` / `check:domain-words` / `wiki:check` / `test`，任一失败即红。 4. **不声明 `engines.dsh`**：该字段已于 2026-10-21 拍板**已删除**。官方的安装器与加载器都不校验它，写了只会制造「假锁」——用户以为被拦住，实际照装不误，于是版本门槛出现两个真源并静默漂移。`tests/version-guard.spec.ts` 现在断言 `engines` 中**不得**存在 `dsh` 字段，防止有人把它加回来。 支持的运行时版本范围因此是：**`0.2.0-rc.2` 与 `0.2.1-rc.2`**（以及 `^0.2.0-rc.2` 区间内未来通过 CI 的补丁版）。 5. **peer 门槛要真的能红**：pnpm 11.7 的 `pnpm install` 遇到 peer 不匹配只打 `WARN`、退出码仍是 `0`；`strict-peer-dependencies` / `strictPeerDependencies` 在该版本都不改变这个行为（`.npmrc` 的项目级配置也已不被读取）。所以本仓把 `pnpm peers check` 作为门槛，接入 `pnpm verify` 与 CI（`pnpm check:peers`）——不满足 peer 区间时它 `exit 1` 并点名「谁要什么、实际装了什么」。 ### 不要用 allow-version 豁免 遇到 peer 不匹配时，**不要**用 `--no-strict-peer-dependencies`、`.npmrc` 里的 `strict-peer-dependencies=false`，或任何 `allow-version` / `ignore-peer` 之类的手段把校验关掉： ```sh # ❌ 不要这样 dsh plugin --profile

add --no-strict-peer-dependencies ``` 理由： - 关掉校验只是**让安装继续**，不改变实际解析到的运行时版本。契约不匹配（工具 schema、SKILL 注册签名、`Service` 生命周期）会在运行期才爆，错误位置离原因很远。 - 本包的能力全部建立在 dsh 的公共契约上；peer 区间是「验证过的组合」的声明式表达，绕过它等于声称未验证的组合可用。 - 豁免会静默传染：一次本地豁免能装上，CI 双版本矩阵就不再能代表真实安装路径。 > 现状（pnpm 11.7）：`install` 本身对 peer 冲突只告警、不失败，所以「装上了」不等于「契约成立」。判断是否真的成立，看 `pnpm check:peers` 的退出码，而不是 `install` 的退出码。 正确做法二选一： 1. **升级运行时**到 peer 区间内的版本（推荐）； 2. **改区间**：如果确实需要新的运行时语义，同时更新四个 peer 区间、钉新版 devDependencies、把新版本加进 CI 矩阵，并在 CHANGELOG 里写明。 ## 演进闭环速览 ``` 资产（领域声明的类型，如 skills/ records/ tasks/ programs/） │ 写入 ▼ AssetWriter.register() ──► 落盘 + 单次 git commit（写入即 commit） │ ├──► asset_history 回溯某路径的提交历史 ├──► asset_show 读当前内容（含类型 / 大小） └──► asset_commit 对已有改动补一次提交 ``` - **资产单仓**：领域装配后（`install` 时 `ensureAssetsRepo`），`/assets` 是资产层唯一的 git 仓库，所有资产类型共用它，没有嵌套仓。写盘与提交在同一个 `register()` 调用里完成——不存在「写了但没进版本库」的中间态（git 不可用时降级为 `degraded: true`，资产已落盘但未提交，调用方能在返回值里看到）。 - **写入即 commit**：`register()` 是同步且批量原子的：一批 spec 要么全部落盘 + 一个 commit，要么一个都不写。 - **任务定义**：`task_create` / `task_list` / `task_get` / `task_update` / `task_delete` / `task_enable` / `task_disable` 七个工具管理任务定义（cron、程序、启停），落盘走 `TaskStore`，同样进资产仓。 - **进化引擎**：`EvolutionPolicy` 提供证据门槛与变更纪律（单变量、预注册、节流、保留负结果、历史不可变）；`rsi-evolution` / `skill-authorship` / `task-authorship` 三个固件 SKILL 随包发布、不参与进化，注册前按策略渲染模板变量。 - **日志**：分级门面（`debug` / `info` / `warn` / `error`）同时转发 `ctx.logger` 与 JSONL exporter；字段级脱敏在写盘前执行；`trace` 提供跨调用的关联 id。 ## 目录布局 运行时目录全部在 `` 下动态创建（**不是**仓库里的目录）： ``` / ├── assets/ # 资产层；领域装配后成为 git 仓库；0755 ├── data/ # 私有运行时数据；0700 ├── logs/ # JSONL 运行日志；0700 └── workspace/ # 任务程序 / 临时工作区；0755 ``` | 目录 | 权限 | 理由 | |------|------|------| | `assets/` | `0o755` | 资产可分享、可进 git，允许同机其他用户读取 | | `data/` | `0o700` | 含用户私有运行时数据，仅属主可访问 | | `logs/` | `0o700` | 日志可能含会话内容，仅属主可访问（文件 `0o600`） | | `workspace/` | `0o755` | 任务程序执行目录，允许同机读取 | `homeRoot` 与 `home` 以 `0o755` 创建，**实际权限受进程 umask 影响**（如 `umask 077` 下落到 `0o700`）——`mkdir` 的 `mode` 只是申请值。且**不会 chmod 已存在的上层目录**：如果你把 `homeRoot` 指到自己的私有目录（如 `0o700`），本插件不会把它放宽（见 `src/runtime.ts` 的 `ensureParentDir`）。 日志策略：按天切割 `/logs/.jsonl`；单文件超过 500 MB 滚动为 `-1` / `-2`… 后缀；默认保留 30 天。可用 `DSH_RSI_LOG_LEVEL` / `DSH_RSI_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS` / `DSH_RSI_LOG_MAX_SIZE` 覆盖，`DSH_RSI_HOME` 覆盖 homeRoot，`DSH_RSI_SESSION_ID` 覆盖会话 id。 ## 开发与验证 ```sh pnpm typecheck # 源码 + 类型测试（tsconfig.json / tsconfig.type-tests.json） pnpm test # vitest，777 例 pnpm check:peers # peer 区间门槛（pnpm 11 的 install 只告警，这里才真红） pnpm check:domain-words # core 领域无关性（白名单为空） pnpm wiki:check # 文档一致性：链接 / 代码路径（按分句判免责）/ 废弃概念 / 必备小节 pnpm verify # 上面五条按序全跑 pnpm build # clean + typecheck + 编译 + 搬运 .md / patch 资源 ``` **CI 下测试文件串行**（`vitest.config.ts` 里 `CI` 时 `fileParallelism: false`、`maxWorkers: 1`）：本仓大量用例真实起 `git` / `node` 子进程，这些**同步**子进程会阻塞 worker 事件循环，多 worker 洪峰下主进程的 `onTaskUpdate` RPC 会超时（birpc 默认 60s），表现为「用例全过但 exit 1」。串行是为结果确定性付出的时间成本，不是性能配置失误。 更多用例矩阵见 `docs/test-matrix.md`。 ## 首发形态 **GitHub tag + 本地路径安装**： ```sh git clone https://github.com/Casper-Mars/dsh-rsi-agent.git cd dsh-rsi-agent && pnpm i && pnpm build dsh plugin --profile

add . ``` **明确暂不发 npm**：当前发布形态（bundle patch 的插入顺序、领域包与 core 的 peer 关系、home 切换语义）尚未稳定，而 npm 一旦发出就不能撤回——版本号会被永久占用，错误的 `files` / `exports` 也会被缓存传播。首发只通过仓库 tag 分发；等形态稳定、且有一次真实的「第三方领域包接入」验证后，再讨论上架。 打包自检（不发也能验）： ```sh pnpm pack tar -tzf dsh-rsi-agent-0.1.0.tgz ``` 包内应含 `cordis.patch.yml`、`dist-server/**`、`skills/`、`README.md`、`AGENTS.md`、`CHANGELOG.md`、`LICENSE`，**不含** `src/`、`tests/`、`.github/`、`docs/`。 ## License Apache-2.0
