# dsh-model-price — API pricing for DeepSeek Harness **English** | [Русский](README.ru.md) | [Website](https://itsbuyru-bit.github.io/dsh-model-price/) [![CI](https://github.com/itsbuyru-bit/dsh-model-price/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/itsbuyru-bit/dsh-model-price/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Platform: Web / Desktop](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Web%20%2F%20Desktop-0078D4.svg)](#requirements) [![DeepSeek Harness: 0.2.x](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-0.2.x-6f42c1.svg)](#supported-versions) [![Languages: 9](https://img.shields.io/badge/languages-9-2ea44f.svg)](#languages) Per-model API prices, wallet balance and live session spend for **DeepSeek Harness**. The plugin adds a compact line under the chat composer — `Session: $0.0123 · Wallet: $12.34 · Peak` — and a **Models & prices** section in Settings where you enter what each model costs per million tokens, in USD or CNY, separately for Peak and Off-Peak hours. The plugin is a Host + Client bundle. It does not patch Harness, does not modify session logs, and keeps all of its data in `~/.dsh/api-spend/`. > **Unofficial.** This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored > by DeepSeek. “DeepSeek” and “DeepSeek Harness” belong to their respective > authors. See [Non-affiliation](#non-affiliation). --- ## Screenshots

| Settings — Display | Settings — Models | |:---:|:---:| | | | --- ## Table of contents - [Screenshots](#screenshots) - [What this plugin does](#what-this-plugin-does) - [Features](#features) - [Supported versions](#supported-versions) - [Requirements](#requirements) - [Quick start](#quick-start) - [Usage](#usage) - [How it works](#how-it-works) - [Price model](#price-model) - [Languages](#languages) - [Data and privacy](#data-and-privacy) - [Project structure](#project-structure) - [Testing](#testing) - [Updating](#updating) - [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting) - [Limitations](#limitations) - [Contributing](#contributing) - [Security](#security) - [License and credits](#license-and-credits) - [Non-affiliation](#non-affiliation) --- ## What this plugin does DeepSeek Harness reports token usage per step but has no per-model price table and no wallet display. This plugin adds both: | Surface | What it shows | Where it lives | |---|---|---| | Composer line | Session spend, wallet balance, Peak / Off-Peak badge, live indicator | `conversation.composer.dock`, order 2 | | Popover | Token composition, per-model cost, wallet split, child sessions, all-time total | Click the line | | Settings section | Price table per model, currency, manual FX rate, Off-Peak window, language | `settings.section`, order 30 | | Host API | Prices, wallet and session aggregation | `/api-spend/api/*` | The plugin works from the durable session log: it folds `assistant/message` usage into a session projection and prices it on read. It does not estimate tokens, does not rewrite logs, and does not block requests. --- ## Features - **Per-model price table** — input (cache miss), output, cache hit and cache write, each with a Peak and an Off-Peak rate. - **Two currencies** — enter prices in USD or CNY, display in one currency and convert with a manual rate stored in the settings. - **Wallet** — real DeepSeek account balance plus bonus wallets; a local budget can stand in when the account is unavailable. - **Live session cost** — updates while the model works; retries are de-duplicated and aborted steps without usage are reported, not guessed. - **Peak / Off-Peak** — editable UTC window, orange Peak badge, green Off-Peak badge, and the matching price column is used for each settlement. - **Model sync** — one click mirrors the models bound in **Settings → Models**. Providers with an empty model list contribute nothing, and models removed from that list disappear from the price table with their prices. - **Localized** — 9 bundled languages with automatic discovery of new locale files. - **Best time** — the popover shows the current or next Off-Peak block in local time and a countdown until it starts (or until it ends, when already active). - **Search & Fetch costs** — successful `web_search` / `web_fetch` calls are counted and shown separately; they are free until 2026-10-31 16:00 UTC and billed at $0.75 per 1,000 requests afterwards. - **Update indicator** — optional check of the latest GitHub release (at most once every 6 hours), a **Check now** button and a link to the newer release in the About block. - **Dependency-free, build-free** — plain JavaScript, no runtime packages. --- ## Supported versions | Component | Value | |---|---| | DeepSeek Harness | **0.2.x** — tested on **0.2.1-rc.2** (Desktop, Windows) | | Profile | `desktop` (Web/Desktop); any profile that mounts the Web UI | | Node.js | bundled with DSH, **22.5+** | | Plugin version | **1.8.0** | The plugin is not gated on an exact Harness version. If a future release renames a slot, a projection key or a service, the affected part degrades to “no line”/“no wallet” instead of crashing the page; the Host API keeps working. --- ## Requirements | Need | Why | |---|---| | **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x** | Provides the Web UI, session projections and the account service | | **A Web/Desktop profile** | The composer line and the settings section are Web-UI slots | | **DeepSeek account (optional)** | Only for the wallet balance; without it use the local-budget fallback | | **No build tools** | The bundle ships `index.js` and `client.js` as-is | Works on Windows, macOS and Linux; the UI uses Harness theme tokens and follows the active theme automatically. --- ## Quick start ### Option 1 — Add Plugin (recommended) 1. Open **Settings → Plugins → Add plugin**. 2. Paste one of: ``` github:itsbuyru-bit/dsh-model-price ``` ``` https://github.com/itsbuyru-bit/dsh-model-price ``` ``` /path/to/dsh-model-price ``` 3. Install, restart DeepSeek Harness and refresh the page. The plugin is distributed from GitHub; there is no npm registry package. ### Option 2 — CLI ```sh dsh plugin --profile add github:itsbuyru-bit/dsh-model-price ``` The `desktop` profile is owned by the Electron application and the CLI refuses to write to it; use **Add Plugin** in the UI for that profile. ### Option 3 — local development ```sh git clone https://github.com/itsbuyru-bit/dsh-model-price.git dsh plugin --profile add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-model-price ``` Host changes require reinstalling the bundle; client changes only need a page refresh. --- ## Usage 1. Open **Settings → Models & prices**. 2. In **Discounts & time** set the shared Peak windows, Peak days, holiday days and the Search & Fetch billing. The block sits right under **Display** and applies to every model that has no schedule of its own. 3. Press **Load models from Models** to import the models configured in the harness, or add one manually by provider and model id. 4. Expand a model row and fill the Peak / Off-Peak prices per 1M tokens. The same card records where the numbers came from: open **Source and check date**, paste the pricing-page URL and the check date, and the collapsed row keeps showing the domain, `Checked YYYY-MM-DD (UTC)` and an **Open** button. 5. Optional: tick **Own Peak schedule for this model** in a model card and give that model its own windows, weekdays and holidays. Overrides are merged field by field with the shared schedule, so leaving the windows blank keeps the common ones. 6. Press **Apply** at the bottom of each block you changed. The composer line shows `Session: … · Wallet: … · Peak`. Click it for the token composition, per-model cost, wallet breakdown and the all-time total; the eye button masks the wallet. | Action | Result | |---|---| | Click the line | Opens the spend popover | | Eye button | Hides or shows the wallet amount (persisted) | | **Load models from Models** | Mirrors the models bound in Settings → Models; unbound rows are removed | | **Expand all / Collapse all** | Opens or closes every price row | | **Apply** (Display) | Saves currency, rate, language and visibility toggles | | **Apply** (Discounts & time) | Saves the shared Peak schedule and Search & Fetch billing | | **Apply** (Models) | Saves the price table and the per-model schedule overrides | | **Reset total** | Resets the all-time counter; session history is kept | Prices are applied retroactively: editing a rate recalculates the visible history, which the popover states explicitly. A model without a price shows `?` and is listed as unpriced instead of counting as zero. --- ## How it works ### Host half — `index.js` 1. Registers the `modelPrice` session projection, keyed by `provider/model` and split into Peak / Off-Peak token buckets. The tariff of an event is resolved against that model's own schedule when it has one, and against the shared schedule otherwise. 2. Folds `assistant/message` events only; a retried step at the same `turn/step` replaces its previous sample instead of double counting. 3. Keeps an all-time counter in `totals.json`, updated from `session/event`. 4. Prices tokens on read with the current table and converts the result to the display currency. 5. Reads the wallet from `deepseekAccount.getBalance` (45-second cache) and falls back to the local budget. 6. Serves `/api-spend/api/{state,config,save,wallet,reset,catalog,locales}`. ### Client half — `client.js` 1. Registers `conversation.composer.dock → spend` and `settings.section → model-price`. 2. Polls the Host state every 1–2.5 s (faster while a turn runs) and renders the line, the portaled popover and the settings form. 3. Loads locale files from `/api-spend/api/locales`, so the UI language is independent of the Harness language and can be overridden per plugin. ### What is counted | Token bucket | Source | Charged at | |---|---|---| | Input (cache miss) | `usage.inputTokens` | input price | | Cache read | `usage.cacheReadTokens` | cache-hit price, falls back to input | | Cache write | `usage.cacheWriteTokens` | cache-write price, empty = free | | Output | `usage.outputTokens` | output price | `reasoningTokens` is already inside `outputTokens` and is not charged twice. Child sessions are included while they are live and are shown separately. --- ## Price model | Rule | Behaviour | |---|---| | Empty cache-hit price | Charged at the input price | | Empty cache-write price | Free | | Empty Off-Peak column | Uses the Peak price | | Missing input or output price | Model is unpriced; session total shows `?` | | Price currency ≠ display currency | Converted with the manual rate | | Peak schedule | Editable UTC windows and weekdays; DeepSeek default 01:00–04:00 and 06:00–10:00, Monday–Friday, excluding holidays | | Price edits | Recalculate the visible history (retroactive) | | Budget | A display fallback only; no limits and no blocking | --- ## Languages Bundled locales are BCP 47 files with a region or script subtag: | File | Language | |---|---| | `locale/en-US.json` | English (US) | | `locale/ru-RU.json` | Русский | | `locale/zh-CN.json` | 简体中文 | | `locale/ja-JP.json` | 日本語 | | `locale/ko-KR.json` | 한국어 | | `locale/es-ES.json` | Español | | `locale/pt-BR.json` | Português (Brasil) | | `locale/de-DE.json` | Deutsch | | `locale/fr-FR.json` | Français | ### Adding a language 1. Copy `locale/en-US.json` to `locale/.json`, where `` includes a region or script subtag (`it-IT`, `nl-NL`, `tr-TR`, `zh-TW`). A file without a subtag (`en.json`) is ignored. 2. Translate every value in `strings` and `meta.description`. 3. Keep the keys and the `{n}` / `{rate}` placeholders; keep `Peak`, `Off-Peak`, `USD`, `CNY`, `DSH`, `DeepSeek`, `API`, `cache miss/hit/write` and `Model Price` (inventory name) in English. 4. Translate `settingsTitle` / `settingsNav` — they are the page title and the nav label. 5. Set `"locale"` to the file tag and `"name"` to the language name written in that language. The Host rescans `locale/` on every request: drop the file in, open **Settings → Models & prices** (the section forces a re-scan) or refresh the page. Missing keys fall back to `en-US`, then to the key name. Full guide: [docs/TRANSLATION.md](docs/TRANSLATION.md). --- ## Data and privacy | Data | Location | Notes | |---|---|---| | Prices, currency, rate, window, language | `~/.dsh/api-spend/config.json` | Plain JSON | | All-time token counters | `~/.dsh/api-spend/totals.json` | Token buckets only | | Wallet balance | DeepSeek account API | Cached 45 s in memory, never written to disk | | Session usage | Harness session log | Read through the projection, never modified | | Update check | `api.github.com` Releases API | Optional; one request per 6 h, no payload | There are no analytics and no telemetry. The only outbound requests are the account balance call made by the Harness itself and the optional update check; disable it in **Settings → Models & prices → About → Check for updates**. The FX rate is manual by design. --- ## Project website A static landing page lives in [`site/`](site/): dark hero, screenshots, feature grid, install command and an EN/RU switch. It is published with GitHub Pages: **https://itsbuyru-bit.github.io/dsh-model-price/** Deployment uses `.github/workflows/pages.yml`; enable it once in **Settings → Pages → Source → GitHub Actions**, then every push to `main` publishes `site/`. --- ## Project structure ```text dsh-model-price/ ├── index.js # Host half: projection, wallet, pricing API ├── client.js # Client half: composer line, popover, settings ├── lib/pricing.js # Pure pricing helpers (tested, shipped) ├── cordis.patch.yml # Inserts the plugin row ├── icon.svg # Plugin icon ├── locale/ # 9 BCP 47 locale files (111 keys each) ├── test/pricing.test.mjs # node:test unit suite ├── docs/ # Architecture, translation guide, images ├── site/ # Static landing page (GitHub Pages) ├── scripts/check.mjs # Manifest, syntax and locale-parity checks ├── .github/workflows/ # ci.yml, pages.yml, release.yml ├── README.md # English ├── README.ru.md # Russian ├── CHANGELOG.md ├── CONTRIBUTING.md ├── CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md ├── SECURITY.md ├── SUPPORT.md ├── LICENSE └── package.json ``` Further reading: [architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) and the [translation guide](docs/TRANSLATION.md). --- ## Testing ```sh node scripts/check.mjs node --test test/pricing.test.mjs ``` The check validates the manifest, runs `node --check` on the Host, Client and `lib/pricing.js`, and verifies every locale against `en-US.json`: file tag, `locale` field, key set, empty values and `{placeholder}` preservation. The unit suite covers the pure pricing layer: per-million costs, cache-hit and cache-write fallbacks, Peak-window and weekday maths, holiday exclusion, currency conversion, release comparison, and extraction of the model list the user bound in **Settings → Models**. CI runs both commands on every push and pull request. --- ## Updating - Distribution is GitHub-only. Re-installing the bundle from `github:itsbuyru-bit/dsh-model-price` picks up the default branch. - The About block shows **Update available** when a newer GitHub release exists. **Check now** opens the update dialog: running and latest versions, the target profile, **Check again**, a manual command with **Copy command**, and **Update automatically**, which installs the latest release through the profile's plugin manager. A local (`link:`) install is never overwritten — the dialog says so and offers the `git pull` + `link:` reinstall command instead. The toggle controls only the automatic 6-hour check. - Version lives in `package.json` and `CHANGELOG.md`; releases are tagged `vX.Y.Z`. - Pushing a `vX.Y.Z` tag runs `.github/workflows/release.yml` and publishes a GitHub Release with generated notes. - Host changes require reinstalling the bundle; client changes only need a page refresh. - Settings and totals survive updates; they are not part of the package. --- ## Troubleshooting ### The composer line is missing - Make sure a session is open — the dock is session-scoped. - Check **Settings → Models & prices → Hide the composer line**. - Refresh the page after installing or updating the client half. ### The settings section is not in the list - The Host must be restarted after installing the bundle. - Look for **Models & prices** near the bottom of the settings nav. ### The wallet shows “No balance available” - The DeepSeek account is not signed in, or the provider is not DeepSeek. - Set **Local budget fallback** to show a number instead. ### Cost shows `?` - The model route is not priced. Open the settings, expand that model and fill input/output prices, then press **Apply**. - The popover lists every unpriced route. ### The session total looks too low - A step without provider usage is counted as “steps without usage”, not estimated. - Completed child sessions are not part of the current session total; they are still included in the all-time total. ### Peak and Off-Peak look swapped - The window is in **UTC**. Set it in the settings; the badge follows the same window as the price choice. ### A new language does not appear - The file name must include a region/script subtag: `de-DE`, not `de`. - The file must be valid JSON with a non-empty `strings` object. - Open **Settings → Models & prices** to force a re-scan, then refresh. ### The line shows `••••` - The eye button is masked, or **Hide wallet amount** is on. Click the eye. --- ## Limitations - **Web UI only.** There is no TUI/CLI rendering of the spend line. - **Wallet is DeepSeek-specific.** Other providers show the local-budget fallback. - **Completed child sessions** are only in the all-time total, not in the current session line. - **Prices are retroactive.** Editing a rate recalculates history rather than freezing the rate at settlement time. - **No limits or blocking.** The plugin reports money; it never stops a request. - **FX is manual.** No exchange-rate service is called. - **Locale files ship as-is.** A partial translation falls back key by key. --- ## Contributing Issues and pull requests are welcome. Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). Translation fixes are especially useful: include the language, the English source, the current text and a suggested correction. This project follows the [Contributor Covenant](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). --- ## Security Do not paste account tokens, API keys or private session data into issues. Report security problems privately through GitHub Security Advisories; see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). --- ## License and credits - This project: **MIT**, © 2026 **Aleksey Zakurdaev**. See [LICENSE](LICENSE). - Built for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai); the plugin uses its slot, projection, settings and account services without bundling any Harness code. - The UI follows Harness theme tokens (`--dsw-alias-*`, `--dsw-specific-*`) and the native popover metrics so it matches the host in light and dark themes. --- ## Non-affiliation This is an independent, unofficial project. It is **not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by** DeepSeek or the DeepSeek Harness maintainers. It contains no DeepSeek source code or binaries; it only extends a local Harness installation through its public plugin APIs. “DeepSeek” and “DeepSeek Harness” belong to their respective authors.

# dsh-vehicle-watch

[![CI](https://github.com/judyding1121-web/dsh-vehicle-watch/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/judyding1121-web/dsh-vehicle-watch/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.1--rc.2-blue)](https://github.com/judyding1121-web/dsh-vehicle-watch)

> GitHub: https://github.com/judyding1121-web/dsh-vehicle-watch

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Host 插件 / Cordis bundle：监控**西安** **小米SU7 / 理想i6 / 问界M7 / 极氪001** 的**闲鱼**二手车，新上架或降价时推送到企业微信、飞书，并生成 Excel 报表。

- 每 2 小时按关键词搜索闲鱼（按发布时间倒序，第 1 页 30 条/关键词，可配多页）；
- 只保留**西安**、**二手车类目**、匹配关键词的车源，过滤配件/用品/租车/事故残值车；
- 与已见 `listing_id` 对比：**新上架**、**已跟踪车源降价**；
- 有新变化才推；企业微信用模板卡片，整卡可点跳**闲鱼商品页**；首次启动只发一条基线摘要；
- 生成 `二手车监控-最新.xlsx`（6 个 sheet）与 CSV；
- 可选企业微信「智能机器人」双向指令（查行情 / 最新 / 找车型 / 扫描）。

> 卖家报价 ≠ 成交价；闲鱼是 C2C 平台，同一台车可能重复挂牌或由车商发布；样本 = 每次搜索前 N 页过滤后的结果。仅个人低频自用，不商用、不公开分发数据。

---

## 环境要求

| 项 | 要求 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| DSH Desktop | **0.2.1-rc.2** | `peerDependencies` 钉死此版本；其他版本需版本豁免（见下） |
| Node.js | ≥ 24 | DSH 自带，无需另装 |
| Python 3 + `openpyxl` | 可选 | 仅生成 Excel 需要；不装可设 `report.enabled: false`，仍输出 CSV |
| 企业微信群机器人 webhook | 可选 | 不填则只落库/出表，不推送 |
| 飞书群机器人 webhook | 可选 | 同上 |
| 企业微信智能机器人 `botId`/`secret` | 可选 | 只有要双向指令时才需要 |
| 闲鱼登录 Cookie | 可选 | 匿名也能搜索；触发风控（RGV587）时填上更稳 |

---

## 安装

### 方式 A：从 GitHub 安装（推荐，另一台电脑最省事）

插件管理器直接把 GitHub 仓库当 npm spec 安装，依赖（`ws`）会自动装好。

1. DSH → Web 侧栏 → **插件** → **添加插件** → **安装第三方插件**；
2. 输入仓库 spec，二选一：
   - `github:judyding1121-web/dsh-vehicle-watch`
   - `https://github.com/judyding1121-web/dsh-vehicle-watch`
3. 安装完成后确认状态是 `applied`（若提示 `restart-required`，重启 DSH）；
4. 按下面「配置」填写 webhook / 车型；
5. 30 秒后自动首扫，或让 Agent 调用 `vehicle_usedcar_scan`。

> 也可以让 Agent 调用 `plugin_manager`：`action: install_bundle`、`target: 'github:judyding1121-web/dsh-vehicle-watch'`。该工具需要 `danger-full-access` 或本次调用审批。
>
> 私有仓库：需要本机 Git 凭据（SSH key 或 credential helper/token）。安装前管理器会用 `git ls-remote` 探活，认证失败会继续交给 pnpm，能凭据就绪即可。

### 方式 B：clone 后按本地目录安装

适合改代码 / 离线：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/judyding1121-web/dsh-vehicle-watch.git
cd dsh-vehicle-watch
pnpm install        # 本地 link 安装不会替你装 ws，必须手动执行一次
```

然后：插件 → 添加插件 → 安装第三方插件 → 选这个目录的**绝对路径**。

### 方式 C：离线 tarball

```bash
pnpm pack           # 生成 dsh-vehicle-watch-0.1.0.tgz
```

把 `.tgz` 拷到另一台电脑，安装时填 tarball 的绝对路径（同样支持）。

> ⚠️ Desktop 的 profile 由 Electron 独占管理：**不要**手改 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json` / `cordis.yml`，也**不要**用 `dsh plugin` CLI 改 desktop profile。只改 `cordis.patch.yml`。

---

## 配置

安装后编辑 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`，在 `- id: vehicle-watch` 下填配置（可复制本仓库 [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml) 的 `config` 再改）。

```yaml
- id: vehicle-watch
  config:
    city: 西安
    province: 陕西
    minPriceYuan: 30000          # 低于此价视为配件/租车/残值车
    carCategoryId: '127302001'   # 闲鱼「二手车」类目 id（一般不用改）
    scanIntervalHours: 2
    startupDelaySec: 30
    maxPushPerRun: 8
    notifyOnFirstRun: true
    priceDropAbs: 1000
    excludeKeywords: [租车, 日租, 床垫, 车模, 配件, 订单, 返现, 定金, 事故, 水淹, 残值, 批发]
    targets:
      - id: xiaomi-su7
        name: 小米SU7
        keyword: 小米SU7
        referenceOfficialLow: 219900
        referenceOfficialHigh: 303900
        enabled: true
      # 其余车型照抄 cordis.patch.yml
    xianyu:
      cookie: ''                 # 可选：填闲鱼网页登录 Cookie（document.cookie 整串）
      pages: 1                   # 每个关键词翻几页（每页 30 条）
      minGapMs: 3000             # 请求间隔，太低容易触发风控
      timeoutMs: 20000
    notify:
      wecomWebhook: 'https://qyapi.weixin.qq.com/cgi-bin/webhook/send?key=...'
      feishuWebhook: 'https://open.feishu.cn/open-apis/bot/v2/hook/...'
      feishuSecret: ''
      timeoutMs: 10000
    aibot:                       # 双向指令才需要；不需要就整段留空/删掉
      enabled: false
      botId: ''
      secret: ''
    report:
      enabled: true
      dir: ''                    # 空 = ~/.dsh/storages/vehicle-watch/reports
      pythonPath: python3        # 换机器一般不用改；Windows 填 python
      keepDays: 30
```

**注意：`config` 是整体替换，不是深合并。** 覆盖时必须重述 `targets`、`notify`、`report` 等所有字段（可整段复制仓库里的 `cordis.patch.yml` 再改）。webhook / bot secret / 闲鱼 Cookie 都是凭证，`cordis.patch.yml` 权限建议 `600`，**不要提交到仓库、不要贴进对话**。

常用字段：

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `city` / `province` | 西安 / 陕西 | 闲鱼搜索结果的城市过滤（division） |
| `minPriceYuan` | 30000 | 价格下限，过滤配件/租车/残值车 |
| `carCategoryId` | 127302001 | 闲鱼二手车类目 id；先按类目过滤再匹配关键词 |
| `excludeKeywords` | 见上 | 标题命中即剔除的非车/事故词 |
| `scanIntervalHours` | 2 | 扫描间隔（小时） |
| `startupDelaySec` | 30 | 启动后首扫延迟，避免抢启动 |
| `maxPushPerRun` | 8 | 单条消息最多列几台，超出提示看 Excel |
| `priceDropAbs` | 1000 | 降价超过多少元才推 |
| `notifyOnFirstRun` | true | 首次只建基线，不逐条推 |
| `xianyu.pages` | 1 | 每个关键词翻页数（每页 30 条） |
| `xianyu.cookie` | `''` | 可选登录 Cookie；触发风控时可提高稳定性 |
| `report.dir` | `''` | 空 = `~/.dsh/storages/vehicle-watch/reports`；可指向工作区 |
| `report.pythonPath` | `python3` | 换机器一般不用改 |

### 闲鱼 Cookie 怎么填（可选）

1. 浏览器登录 `https://www.goofish.com/`；
2. 打开开发者工具 → Console，执行 `document.cookie`，复制整串；
3. 填到 `xianyu.cookie: '...'`，重启插件生效。

Cookie 会过期，失效后插件会自动退回匿名搜索；若频繁被风控，重新取一次即可。

---

## 数据与状态

| 内容 | 位置 |
|---|---|
| 已见车源 / 去重状态 | `~/.dsh/storages/vehicle-watch/used-car-state.json` |
| 报表与明细 | `report.dir`（默认 `~/.dsh/storages/vehicle-watch/reports`） |
| 产物 | `二手车监控-最新.xlsx`、`latest.json`、`latest.csv`、`listings-latest.csv`、`scan-log.jsonl` |

状态与报表都**不在仓库里**，换电脑互不影响；首次运行会重新建立基线。**从瓜子版升级**时，第一次闲鱼扫描会自动按“基线”处理，不会把全量当新上架刷屏。

---

## 工具

| 工具 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `vehicle_usedcar_scan` | 立即搜索一次闲鱼（可指定 `targetId`）；返回新增/降价/消息/报表路径 |
| `vehicle_usedcar_status` | 上次扫描、各车型样本数/中位价/已见数、闲鱼关键词与搜索链接 |
| `vehicle_usedcar_bot_status` | 企微智能机器人连接状态、收发计数 |
| `vehicle_usedcar_report` | 用最近一次结果重新生成 Excel |

## 企业微信双向指令

在群里 **@机器人** 发送：

| 指令 | 回复 |
|---|---|
| `查` / `行情` / `状态` | 各车型样本数、中位价 |
| `小米SU7` / `理想i6` / `问界M7` / `极氪001` | 该车型行情 + 最低价 3 台 |
| `最新` / `新上架` | 本轮新增车源 |
| `扫描` / `刷新` | 立即抓取一次 |
| `找宋L` / `找理想L9` | 临时查询闲鱼，并问是否加入监控 |
| `取消` / `帮助` | 取消加入询问 / 指令列表 |

---

## 换电脑 / 升级 DSH 后

- **DSH 版本不同**：安装可能报 `incompatible-version`（peer 依赖钉 `0.2.1-rc.2`）。处理：插件页 → 版本豁免（或让 Agent 用 `plugin_manager` 的 `set_version_exemption`，需 `acceptRisk: true`），只对该 `包@版本 + DSH 版本` 组合生效。
- **升级插件**：可 HMR 的改动即时生效；替换已装包通常提示 `restart-required`，重启即可。
- **卸载**：插件页移除；状态文件保留在 `~/.dsh/storages/vehicle-watch/`，需要彻底清理时手动删。

## 常见问题

| 现象 | 处理 |
|---|---|
| 安装后工具不出现 | 看是否 `applied`；`restart-required` 就重启；日志找 `vehicle-watch mounted` |
| 报 `Cannot find package 'ws'` | 本地目录安装没跑 `pnpm install`；执行一次后重启 |
| 扫描报 `RGV587` / “被挤爆啦” | 触发闲鱼风控：调大 `xianyu.minGapMs`、减少 `pages`、稍后重试；长期需要可在 `xianyu.cookie` 填登录 Cookie |
| 样本数为 0 | 关键词无整车结果/被风控/类目或价格过滤太严；看日志与 `scan-log.jsonl` |
| 首轮没推送 | 首次只建基线；或 webhook 为空（日志 `notify skipped`） |
| 报表失败 `No module named openpyxl` | `python3 -m pip install --user openpyxl`，或 `report.enabled: false`（CSV 照常生成） |
| DSH 关闭后不跑 | 本插件随 DSH Host 生命周期；要 7×24 需另加 launchd / 常驻服务 |

---

## 开发

```bash
pnpm install                  # 只装 ws；@deepseek-ai/* 由 DSH 运行时提供
pnpm run check                # 所有入口语法检查
pnpm test                     # 自测：命令处理器 + 闲鱼解析/过滤，全部离线（fixture）
```

CI（GitHub Actions，`.github/workflows/ci.yml`）在每次 push / PR 时执行：
`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` → `pnpm run check` → `pnpm test` → `pnpm pack` 冒烟。

---

## 发布到 GitHub（维护者）

**本目录就是仓库根**：`package.json` 在根、声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch`，插件管理器才能把它当 bundle 安装。不要把整个 workspace 当仓库发（bundle 在子目录，安装时无法指向子目录）。

```bash
cd plugins/dsh-vehicle-watch
git init -b main
git add .
git commit -m "feat: dsh-vehicle-watch v0.1.0"

# 有 gh CLI：
gh repo create dsh-vehicle-watch --public --source=. --push
# 或网页建空仓库后：
git remote add origin https://github.com/judyding1121-web/dsh-vehicle-watch.git
git push -u origin main
```

发布前检查：

1. `pnpm run check`、`pnpm test` 通过；
2. 仓库里**没有** webhook、bot secret、闲鱼 Cookie、`node_modules/`、`data/`、`*.xlsx`、`*.csv`、`scan-log.jsonl`（`.gitignore` 已覆盖，仍建议 `git status` 过一眼）；
3. `cordis.patch.yml` 里没有绝对路径；
4. 只发布代码，不发布抓取到的车源数据。

## 合规

- 闲鱼卖家报价 ≠ 成交价；样本 = 搜索结果过滤后的车源，不承诺全量。
- 默认 2 小时 × 4 关键词 × 1 页 ≈ 48 请求/天；请保持低频，遵守目标站点条款，不商用、不公开分发数据。
- 闲鱼有登录/风控限制，本插件只做个人低频查询，不破解验证码、不绕过登录。
- 插件运行在 DSH Host 进程内、拥有宿主权限；安装第三方插件前先读代码。

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

# dsh-win-notify

在 Windows 通知栏提醒你 DSH 的状态变化，点击通知即可跳回对应对话。

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）桌面端的 Host + Web 双半插件，仅支持 Windows。

支持的通知：

| 时机 | 通知标题 | 点击后 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 一轮对话正常结束 | 对话已完成 | 跳回该对话 |
| 一轮对话异常结束（报错 / 被阻塞 / 超长截断） | 对话异常结束 | 跳回该对话 |
| 弹出需要你选择的问题 | 需要你的选择 | 跳回该对话 |
| 弹出需要你授权的操作 | 需要你的授权 | 跳回该对话 |
| 需要登录 DeepSeek 账号 / 登录过期 | 需要登录 DeepSeek 账号 | 打开 DSH |

通知以 **DeepSeek Harness** 的名义显示（Windows 应用 ID `com.deepseek.dsh`），带上应用图标，不经过 PowerShell 的身份。

## 安装

1. 克隆到任意本地目录（不必放进 DSH 工作区）：

   ```powershell
   git clone https://github.com/Jxxxxx729/dsh-win-notify.git "$env:USERPROFILE\dsh-win-notify"
   ```

2. 打开 DSH 的「插件」页，用**本地 bundle 目录**安装上一步的目录（目录里有 `package.json` 和 `cordis.patch.yml`）。安装后出现条目 `dsh-win-notify`，启用即生效：插件会自己注册 `dsh-win-notify:` 协议、创建 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-win-notify\` 状态目录。
3. 首次安装后刷新一次 GUI 页面，让 Web 客户端半加载；之后启停插件都不需要再刷新。

要求：Windows 10/11 + DSH 桌面版（通知身份依赖桌面应用的 AppUserModelID `com.deepseek.dsh`）。在非桌面版（纯 `dsh web`）里仍会发通知，但点通知只能打开 DSH 而无法靠应用标识显示图标。

## 工作原理

1. Host 半监听 `session/event` 的 `turn/end`、`user-questions/request`、`approval/request`、`deepseek-account/*` 事件。
2. 命中后渲染一条 Toast XML 并调用 `runtime/show-toast.ps1`（WinRT `ToastNotificationManager`）发出通知；Toast 的 `activationType="protocol"` 指向 `dsh-win-notify:open?s=<会话 id>&k=<类型>`。
3. 点击通知 → Windows 调 `runtime/activate.vbs`：把 `{sessionId, kind, at}` 写入 spool 目录，并启动 / 聚焦 DeepSeek Harness。
4. Web 客户端半每 1.2 秒 `GET /dsh-win-notify/next` 取走这条记录，调用官方 `uiWorkspace.openSession(sessionId)` 把界面切到该对话。

## 配置

在 profile 的 patch 里给 `dsh-win-notify` 条目加 `config`：

```yaml
- id: dsh-win-notify
  config:
    skipWhenFocused: false      # 窗口在前台时也提醒
    activationTtlMinutes: 120   # 超过这个时间的点击记录直接丢弃
    sessionSummaryLength: 140   # 通知正文里摘要的最大字符数
    notifyOnTurnComplete: true
    notifyOnTurnFailure: true
    notifyOnQuestion: true
    notifyOnApproval: true
    notifyOnSignIn: true
```

`appPath` 一般不用填：插件会自己找 `DeepSeek Harness.exe`。

## 状态与日志

- 目录：`%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-win-notify\`
  - `spool\` 点击记录（客户端取走即删）
  - `payload\` 已发送的 Toast XML（保留最近 80 个）
  - `notify.log` 日志
- 自检：`GET http://<GUI 地址>/dsh-win-notify/status` 返回当前配置、spool 待处理数与日志路径。

## 注册表

插件启动时会为当前用户注册 `dsh-win-notify:` 协议（`HKCU\Software\Classes\dsh-win-notify`），命令指向
`wscript.exe //nologo <插件目录>\runtime\activate.vbs "%1" <spool 目录> "<DeepSeek Harness.exe>"`。
这一步只写 HKCU，不需要管理员权限。

## 注意

- Windows「专注助手 / 勿扰模式」会压掉通知，需要允许 DeepSeek Harness 的通知。
- 只对用户会话提醒，子代理（subagent）会话结束不提醒。
- 如果 GUI 地址或端口变了无需改配置：客户端半用的是同源相对路径。
- `user-questions/request` / `approval/request` 是 waterfall 事件，内置 UI 应答者一旦认领就不会再往下走，所以本插件用 `{ prepend: true }` 抢在它之前**只观察并立刻 `return next()`**，不参与决策；这也是修改这两个监听器时最容易被忽略的一点。
- 改动 `client.js` 后需要刷新一次 GUI 页面才会生效（Host 半可以用插件启停热重载，浏览器半不会自动重载）。
- 浏览器半可以离线自测：`node test-client.mjs`（用假的 `window` / `fetch` / `uiWorkspace` 覆盖补前缀、解归档、dispose 停止轮询四种情况）。
- 通知与点击链路里的路由基名固定为 `/dsh-win-notify/*`；`protocol` 配置只影响 Windows 协议名，不会让已打开的页面失联。


## 许可

[MIT](LICENSE)

# @dsh-external/dsh-subagent-toolkit

[![version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-0.0.6-4d93f8)](https://github.com/Kadima-code/dsh-subagent-toolkit/releases) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-subagent-toolkit?color=cb3837&label=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-subagent-toolkit) [![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-subagent-toolkit?color=cb3837&label=npm%20downloads)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-subagent-toolkit) [![downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Kadima-code/dsh-subagent-toolkit/total?color=2f6feb&label=release%20downloads)](https://github.com/Kadima-code/dsh-subagent-toolkit/releases) [![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-BSD--3--Clause-8b5cf6)](https://github.com/Kadima-code/dsh-subagent-toolkit/blob/master/LICENSE) [![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.x-2f6feb)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）用的**子代理下拉折叠**：把子代理按「使用批次」收进 **历史 / 今日 / 上次 / 本次** 四组，**本次始终展开**，其余可折叠。

**不改原版头部、不新增入口**——只在官方「子代理」下拉里加分组，按钮和布局一个都没动。

## 怎么用

1. **打开**：点官方「子代理」按钮（原版也支持悬停展开，插件不干预）。
2. **看分组**：最下面是「本次 N」标签 + 本次批次（始终展开）；上面依次是「上次 N / 今日 N / 历史 N」。
3. **折叠**：点任一分组头即展开/收起，标题只显示「名称 + 条数」。
4. **子代理会话内同样生效**：打开某个子代理会话时，它头部的上级/目录下拉也按同一规则分组。
5. **删除子代理**：每行尾部有「⋯」→「删除子智能体」，二次确认后删除（运行中会先停止）。删除后该行隐藏，「N 个子智能体」计数同步减。
6. **整组删除**：各组标题（历史/今日/上次/本次）右侧的「⋯」→「删除本组（N 个）」，一次删掉整组；交互与行内删除一致。
7. **子代理模型同步**：`list_subagent_models` 返回**当前**模型目录（不受会话创建时的旧快照限制）；`subagent` 的显式 `provider/model` 按实时目录校验后生效——主对话可以每次任务换不同模型。

| 分组 | 含义 | 默认 |
|---|---|---|
| **本次** | 最近一次使用子代理产生的那一批（并行发起算同一批） | 始终展开 |
| **上次** | 上一次使用子代理产生的那一批 | 折叠 |
| **今日** | 今天其余批次 | 折叠 |
| **历史** | 今天之前 | 折叠 |

> 「批次」按子代理创建时间聚合，间隔 ≤ **120 秒**视为同一批。

## 效果示意

```
子代理下拉
├ 历史 12        ← 折叠（点开）
├ 今日 5         ← 折叠
├ 上次 2         ← 折叠
└ 本次 3         ← 标签 + 始终展开
   ├ 任务 A      运行中
   ├ 任务 B
   └ 任务 C
```

### 截图（前后对比）

| 之前（51 条平铺） | 之后（分组折叠） |
|---|---|
| ![之前：子代理下拉是 51 条平铺](docs/before.png) | ![之后：历史 13 / 上次 4 / 本次 4](docs/after.png) |

## 安装

### npm（推荐）

已发布到 npm，一条命令装进 profile（会写依赖与 bundles）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-subagent-toolkit
```

或手动：

```bash
cd "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop"
pnpm add dsh-subagent-toolkit
```

然后在 profile 的 `package.json` 登记：

```json
{
  "dependencies": { "dsh-subagent-toolkit": "^0.0.3" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["dsh-subagent-toolkit"] } }
}
```

完成后**完全退出并重开** DSH。

### 最快（离线包）：跑安装脚本

解压后运行（自动写 `dependencies` + `dsh.profile.bundles`，并备份 profile 的 `package.json`）：

```bash
node tools/install.cjs --profile desktop          # 安装
node tools/install.cjs --dry-run                  # 只预览
node tools/install.cjs --uninstall --profile desktop  # 卸载
```

然后**完全退出并重开** DSH。

### 方式一：标准 bundle（推荐）

把本包放进目标 profile 并登记，然后**完全退出并重开** DSH：

```powershell
cd "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\<profile>"
pnpm add "<本仓库路径或解压目录>"
```

在该 profile 的 `package.json` 登记：

```json
{
  "dependencies": { "@dsh-external/dsh-subagent-toolkit": "link:<本仓库路径>" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["@dsh-external/dsh-subagent-toolkit"] } }
}
```

### 方式二：手动解压

把 `package.json`、`cordis.patch.yml`、`lib/` 放到
`<profile>/node_modules/@dsh-external/dsh-subagent-toolkit/`，再按上面登记 `dependencies` 与 `dsh.profile.bundles`，重启。

### 卸载

从 `dependencies` 与 `dsh.profile.bundles` 移除本包，删除 `node_modules/@dsh-external/dsh-subagent-toolkit`，重启。

## 兼容性

- DSH 桌面版（Electron）0.2.x，实测 0.2.1-rc.2。
- 纯客户端插件，**不依赖 super-injector 等热加载工具**；标准 bundle 安装即可用全部功能。
- 不采集数据、不发起网络请求。

## 文件结构

```
package.json        # 插件声明（bundle patch + client）
cordis.patch.yml    # 装配补丁：向组合树插入一条插件条目
lib/index.js        # 宿主半（空实现）
lib/client.js       # 客户端半：菜单分组与折叠（手写，零构建）
```

## 开发

`lib/client.js` 为手写 CJS bundle（`window.__ModuleLoader__.load`），无构建步骤。改完保存后 **Ctrl+R** 刷新页面即可加载。

## 已知限制

- 依赖官方下拉的 `role="tree" / role="treeitem"` 语义锚点；官方若改结构需适配。
- 折叠条插在原生菜单内，极端重渲染/虚拟化可能短暂移除，插件有 1s 兜底重挂。
- 悬停展开是官方行为，插件不拦截；点击开/关由插件处理。

## 许可

BSD-3-Clause

# @dsh-external/dsh-subagent-toolkit (English)

[![version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-0.0.6-4d93f8)](https://github.com/Kadima-code/dsh-subagent-toolkit/releases) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-subagent-toolkit?color=cb3837&label=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-subagent-toolkit) [![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-subagent-toolkit?color=cb3837&label=npm%20downloads)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-subagent-toolkit) [![downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Kadima-code/dsh-subagent-toolkit/total?color=2f6feb&label=release%20downloads)](https://github.com/Kadima-code/dsh-subagent-toolkit/releases) [![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-BSD--3--Clause-8b5cf6)](https://github.com/Kadima-code/dsh-subagent-toolkit/blob/master/LICENSE) [![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.x-2f6feb)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

A **subagent-dropdown folding** plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH). Subagents are grouped by **usage batch** into **History / Today / Previous / Current**; **Current is always expanded**, the rest are collapsible.

**No header replacement, no new entry point** — it only adds grouping inside the built-in **Subagent** dropdown.

## Usage

1. Open the built-in **Subagent** button (native hover-open is untouched).
2. The bottom shows a **"Current N"** label plus the current batch (always expanded); above it are **Previous N / Today N / History N**.
3. Click any group header to expand/collapse; headers show only "name + count".
4. **Also works inside a subagent session**: its header (parent/directory dropdown) is grouped the same way.
5. **Delete a subagent**: the trailing **⋯** on each row opens "Delete subagent" (confirmed twice; a running one is stopped first). The row disappears and the "N subagents" count decreases accordingly.
6. **Delete a whole group**: the **⋯** on each group header (History/Today/Previous/This batch) opens "Delete group (N)" to remove the entire group at once — same interaction as the row menu.
7. **Live subagent models**: `list_subagent_models` reports the **current** catalog (not the stale per-session snapshot), and an explicit `provider/model` on `subagent` is validated against it — so the main agent can pick a different model for every task.

| Group | Meaning | Default |
|---|---|---|
| **Current** | the most recent batch of subagents (parallel spawns = one batch) | always expanded |
| **Previous** | the batch before that | collapsed |
| **Today** | other batches from today | collapsed |
| **History** | anything before today | collapsed |

> A "batch" is clustered by creation time; a gap of ≤ **120 s** counts as the same batch.

## Screenshots

| Before (51 flat rows) | After (grouped & folded) |
|---|---|
| ![Before: a flat list of 51 subagents](docs/before.png) | ![After: History 13 / Previous 4 / Current 4](docs/after.png) |

## Install

### npm (recommended)

Published to npm — one command installs it into the profile (writes dependency + bundles):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-subagent-toolkit
```

Or manually:

```bash
cd "$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop"
pnpm add dsh-subagent-toolkit
```

Then register in the profile's `package.json`:

```json
{
  "dependencies": { "dsh-subagent-toolkit": "^0.0.3" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["dsh-subagent-toolkit"] } }
}
```

Fully quit and reopen DSH.

### Fastest (offline package): run the installer

After extracting, run (it writes `dependencies` + `dsh.profile.bundles` and backs up the profile `package.json`):

```bash
node tools/install.cjs --profile desktop          # install
node tools/install.cjs --dry-run                  # preview only
node tools/install.cjs --uninstall --profile desktop  # uninstall
```

Then **fully quit and reopen** DSH.

### Standard bundle (recommended)

```bash
cd "$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>"
pnpm add "<path-or-extracted-dir>"
```

Then register in that profile's `package.json`:

```json
{
  "dependencies": { "@dsh-external/dsh-subagent-toolkit": "link:<path>" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["@dsh-external/dsh-subagent-toolkit"] } }
}
```

Fully quit and reopen DSH.

### Uninstall

Remove the package from `dependencies` and `dsh.profile.bundles`, delete `node_modules/@dsh-external/dsh-subagent-toolkit`, restart.

## Compatibility

- DSH desktop (Electron) 0.2.x (tested on 0.2.1-rc.2).
- Pure client plugin; **no hot-reload tool (super-injector) required**.
- No telemetry, no network requests.

## Layout

```
package.json        # manifest (bundle patch + client)
cordis.patch.yml    # assembly patch (inserts one entry)
lib/index.js        # host half (no-op)
lib/client.js       # client half: grouping & folding (hand-written, no build)
```

## Known limitations

- Relies on the built-in dropdown's `role="tree" / "treeitem"` semantics.
- The fold header is injected into the native menu; extreme re-renders may briefly remove it (1s re-assert fallback).
- Native hover-open is left as-is; click open/close is handled by the plugin.

## License

BSD-3-Clause

# Smoothly Kanban

[![license MIT](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-kanban.svg)](LICENSE)

Smoothly Kanban（**思磨力看板**）is an **external** DeepSeek Harness plugin: a cross-session, cross-branch, persistent **plan / todo kanban board**.

When you chat with an agent (in dsh, Codex, Claude Code, …) you produce lots of plans and todos — and the pain is that once you switch to another branch or open a new session, those plans and todos become invisible: they still live in the long conversation, but you can't find them or remember them.

`dsh-kanban` sinks plans and todos into a **`KANBAN.json` file at the workspace root** (git-trackable, human-editable, survives sessions) and gives you two ways to maintain it:

- **Model entry**: 4 model-facing tools (`board_list` / `board_add` / `board_update` / `board_remove`) so the model records plan steps and todos while talking.
- **Web entry**: a 「思磨力看板」 entry in the dsh Web GUI sidebar's **global panels** section that renders a **three-column board page** (To do / In progress / Done) in the centre column, with view, status move (incl. mark done), add, and delete.

The same `KANBAN.json` is shared by the model tools and the Web page, so **what the model writes, the page shows; what you check off on the page, the model reads next time.**

## What it adds

### Proactive model maintenance (host half, the core)

A **system-prompt guidance section** tells the model to actually use the board on
its own — record plans/todos as they appear, move cards as work progresses,
without waiting to be asked:

- When the user states a multi-step plan or task list → the model `board_add`s
  one card per step;
- As work progresses → the model `board_update`s cards to `in_progress` / `done`;
- Switching branches or opening a new session → the model `board_list`s first to
  pick up the durable record;
- Division of labor vs `todo_write`: `todo_write` is the transient in-turn task
  list; the board is the durable cross-session record — anything the user should
  still see after switching branches belongs on the board.

> Verified with a real model (user only said "build a Markdown-to-HTML tool and
> make a plan", no mention of the board): the model proactively `board_list`'d,
> `board_add`'d all 7 plan steps, then `board_update`'d each to done as it went.

### How it works & transparency

**What makes the model "proactively" use the board?** Two mechanisms, both in
dsh's **system prompt** and visible to the user:

1. **Board usage guidance** (`ctx.systemPrompt.section`): a fixed guidance
   section telling the model what the board is, when to record, and how it
   differs from `todo_write`. Updated with plugin releases.
2. **Session-start auto-injection** (`ctx.systemPrompt.context`): on every
   prompt assembly, the plugin reads the current session's workspace
   `KANBAN.json` and **injects an "open items" summary** (todo + in_progress)
   into the model's context — so the model sees the board immediately, without
   having to remember to `board_list`. With no session / no cwd / an empty
   board it contributes nothing.

**Trade-offs of the auto-injection (stated openly):**

| Aspect | Notes |
|---|---|
| ✅ Pro | The model **always sees** the current workspace's open items — no "remember to check"; cross-session continuity is guaranteed by the system, not the model's diligence |
| ⚠️ Cost 1 | Every request carries the board summary, adding **fixed token overhead** (grows with the board) |
| ⚠️ Cost 2 | Board changes **alter the request prefix**, which can affect **KV-cache reuse**. To limit this, **only open items are injected** (todo + in_progress) — done cards churn would worsen prefix instability |
| ⚠️ Trade-off | "System pushes" vs "model queries" — injection guarantees visibility at the price of per-request overhead |

**The full "make the model use it" mechanism:**
1. **Board usage guidance** (`ctx.systemPrompt.section`): what the board is,
   when to record, how it differs from `todo_write`, and the
   **card-completeness contract** — every card needs a rationale (why at
   creation); a done card must carry all three what/why/rejected fields.
2. **Session-start auto-injection** (`ctx.systemPrompt.context`): open items
   are pushed into the model's context (see above); cards missing fields are
   flagged `(缺:…)` so the model fills them when it picks the work up.
3. **Wrap-up discipline**: the guidance requires that at the end of every work
   session the model moves completed cards to done, adds follow-ups as todos,
   updates summaries, and **never leaves stale `in_progress` cards** — the
   board stays an honest cross-session hand-off.
4. **User-side visibility**: the sidebar's global-panels 「思磨力看板」 entry
   carries an **open-item count badge** on its glyph (backed by the
   `/kanban/counts` route; the workspace follows the current session, then the
   most recent one, and the badge subscribes to workspace-list changes so it
   appears as soon as data is ready); the board panel **auto-refreshes every
   15s** while shown, so model/other-session writes appear without a manual
   refresh.

**Data-safety commitment**: the plugin **only writes** board/note files (plus,
on a shell with no skill registry, the `~/.agents/skills/kanban-use/SKILL.md`
copy described below); there is no startup, scheduled, or install-time cleanup.
Cards are removed only by an explicit `board_remove` / the Web delete button
(which requires a confirmation Modal — no accidental one-click loss); excess
done cards (**beyond 100, oldest first**) are **archived** (moved to
`.agents/notes/archive.json`), never deleted. All board data lives inside your
**workspace directory** (git-trackable, hand-editable).

### Model tools

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `board_list` | Read the current workspace board (all cards with status, tags, timestamps). Call it before any update to get real ids. |
| `board_add` | Add a card (title + **rationale/why expected on every card** — a title-only card is incomplete and flagged 缺; rejected/gave-up when a decision was made; summary/what filled at completion; optional description, status, tags). |
| `board_update` | Update a card by id (status / title / summary / rationale / rejected / description / tags). |
| `board_remove` | Remove a card by id. |
| `note_add` | Write an Agent Note (full replication of the DSH repo discipline) to `.agents/notes/implemented/<class>/<date>-<topic>.md`. |
| `note_list` | List existing Agent Notes in the current workspace. |

The board is scoped to the **current session's working directory (cwd)**: every session under the same project directory shares one `KANBAN.json` — that's what makes it survive across sessions and branches.

### Editable Agent Note spec (reuse, not re-invention; synced via overrides)

`note_add`'s output format, classes, and "non-trivial change" definition are
**replicated from the deepseek-harness repo** (no re-inventing the wheel):

| Item | Upstream source |
|---|---|
| Note classes | `scripts/agent-note-tree.ts` → `AGENT_NOTE_CLASSES` |
| Note format | `scripts/verify-agent-note-format.ts` |
| Non-trivial definition | `.agents/notes/README.md` → "When to write one" (root `AGENTS.md` only points at it) |

- **Plugin ships defaults** (updated per release): `src/note-spec.ts` fixes the
  default classes, format template, and definition — works out of the box;
- **User overrides**: the Web board page's **Agent Note spec** section has three
  inputs to paste newer upstream content over the defaults; overrides are stored
  at the workspace's `.agents/notes/overrides.json`;
- **Source hints**: each input states which dsh source file to copy from;
- **Update warning**: when the plugin ships a newer spec version than a workspace
  with custom overrides, the page warns that updating the plugin resets overrides
  to the new defaults (custom content is lost). "Save overrides" acknowledges the
  current version; "Reset to defaults" clears them.

> Why not `import` dsh directly: `verify-agent-note-format.ts` is a dsh repo
> internal script — not published, not installable, unreachable from an external
> plugin. The spec is fixed as constants and synced via "input-box overrides +
> plugin releases".

#### Sync mechanism (dev-time check + releases)

- **Source anchor**: `src/note-spec.ts` states it is replicated from
  deepseek-harness (upstream commit `ddefc45fbc7f8e46dd73185e68295696d1297887`);
- **Dev-time check**: `pnpm check:spec` (`scripts/check-note-spec.mjs`) reads the
  local dsh checkout's spec constants (classes from `agent-note-tree.ts`, format
  from `verify-agent-note-format.ts`, note-scope rule from
  `.agents/notes/README.md` + the `AGENTS.md` pointer to it) and
  diffs them against the plugin defaults — when upstream changes, one run reports
  the difference and tells you to update `src/note-spec.ts` and bump
  `NOTE_SPEC_VERSION`;
- **Release sync**: the author updates the defaults and ships a new version;
  `dsh plugin update dsh-kanban` delivers the new defaults (if the user had
  custom overrides, the update warning explains they get reset).

`check:spec` needs the local dsh source path — it is a **dev-time tool** (not
shipped, not part of the user-facing `test` chain).

### `/kanban` command

`/kanban` shows the current workspace board; `/kanban done <card-id>` marks a card done quickly.

### Web board page (client half)

![The three-column board page (To do / In progress / Done)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/karoc/dsh-kanban/main/docs/screenshots/board-page.png)

- A 「思磨力看板」 entry in the sidebar's **global panels** section
  (`sidebar.panellist`) with an **open-item count badge** on the glyph (number
  when there are todo/in_progress cards, "99+" cap);
- The board is the `main` slot's occupant for that panel id: selecting the entry
  renders it in the centre column (the Conversation steps aside, exactly like
  the built-in Plugins page), and 「返回会话」/“Back to conversation” returns;
- A three-column board: **To do / In progress / Done**, each
  column with a card count;
- **Workspace switcher**: switch between any registered workspace at the top
  (each workspace owns its KANBAN.json); defaults to the current session's
  workspace;
- Per card: a status dropdown (including "done"), and **delete with a
  confirmation Modal** (no accidental one-click loss); cards show the
  what/why/rejected fields the model filled, and model-created cards carry an
  "Open source session" button (jump to the handling session);
- **Two-line clamped previews**: each of the three what/why/rejected fields on
  a card shows at most two lines, with an ellipsis (`...`) for the rest — cards
  stay compact and scannable;
- **Detail dialog**: clicking the card's title + what/why/rejected region
  (including the description) opens a detail Modal where the full content is
  laid out in labeled sections (icon + label + newline-preserving body), plus
  status, tags, source session and created/updated times — a comfortable
  reading view;
- An add form at the bottom: title + the three what/why/rejected inputs laid
  out in one row of three columns;
- **Silent auto-refresh**: while open, the page polls every 15s and diffs by a
  content signature — when nothing changed it leaves the card DOM completely
  untouched, so it never interrupts reading or drops the scroll position; the
  header shows "auto-refreshed at HH:mm:ss" so the poll's liveness is visible;
  a failed poll keeps the current view (no error flash);
- The page reads/writes the same `KANBAN.json` through the host-registered
  `/kanban/api` and `/kanban/counts` webServer routes (GET read, POST
  add/update/remove) — independent of built-in dsh RPC, so official upgrades
  don't touch it.

### Data file

```
<workspace root>/KANBAN.json
```

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "cards": [
    { "id": "card-xxxx", "title": "implement kanban tools", "description": "…", "status": "todo", "tags": ["dsh"], "createdAt": 1234567890, "updatedAt": 1234567890 }
  ]
}
```

The file shape is validated: a missing file reads as an empty board; a structurally broken file fails loud instead of being silently repaired (so a hand edit gone wrong never loses data quietly).

## Install

**Prereq:** a DeepSeek Harness with the `dsh` CLI, plus [pnpm](https://pnpm.io). This is an installable **bundle** — loaded by `dsh`, not imported as a library.

### From a local dev checkout

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /home/karoc/dsh-kanban
```

### From npm (after publishing)

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-kanban
```

### From git

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:karoc/dsh-kanban#<sha>
```

Git installs run the package `prepare` script to build the bundle; pnpm ≥ 10 asks you to allowlist the build once in the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` (`allowBuilds`), then re-run `add`.

**You must restart `dsh web` after installing** for both the host tools and the Web page to load.

### Update / remove

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-kanban
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-kanban   # removes dependency + bundle layer; entry disappears after restart
```

## Usage

1. Install, restart `dsh web`; the sidebar's global panels section shows the 「思磨力看板」 entry.
2. Ask the model to record plan steps with `board_add` (e.g. "put xxx on the board"); it writes the current workspace's `KANBAN.json`.
3. Open 「思磨力看板」 anytime for the three-column view; mark done / move / add / delete directly on the page.
4. After switching branches or opening new sessions the board is still there — it's just a file in the workspace.

## Card completeness & the kanban-use skill

Cards are the board's cross-session memory: the next session reads them **without asking you**. The plugin therefore enforces a completeness contract on every surface the model sees (same rule everywhere, `missingCardFields` in `board-core.ts`):

- **Every card needs `rationale` (为什么)** — why it exists and why now. A title-only card is incomplete and is flagged:
  - in **tool outputs** (`⚠️缺:…` after the card line, plus a summary line when any card is incomplete),
  - in the **session-start snapshot** (`(缺:…)` on open items, so a resuming session can fill them),
  - on the **Web board page** (a warning line under the card fields — `missing: …` in the English UI, `缺字段：…` in Chinese — humans see it too).
- **A `done` card must be self-explanatory**: `summary` (做了什么) + `rationale` + `rejected` (放弃了什么) all present, so the completed work is an honest hand-off.

**The kanban-use skill** (`skills/kanban-use/SKILL.md`) is the deep manual for this discipline — field semantics, good/bad card examples, the create → advance → close flow, a close checklist, and templates. The system-prompt guidance points the model at it. **Delivery has two paths, and neither asks the user for an extra step.** **Preferred (DSH ≥ 0.1.6, i.e. `ctx.skills` exists)**: the host half registers the packaged `skills/kanban-use/SKILL.md` straight into the shell's skill registry (`ctx.skills.register`, `source: 'runtime'`), so the skill version IS the plugin version — there is no stale copy, and a frontmatter DSH cannot parse cannot silently hide it; by DSH's precedence (project > runtime > user) a copy in `~/.agents/skills` **cannot** shadow it, while a project-level `.agents/skills` (or `.dsh/skills`) copy still wins — the documented way to customize. **Fallback (an older shell, or a profile without the skill service)**: copy install — the skill ships inside the npm package (the tarball includes `skills/kanban-use/SKILL.md` and `scripts/install-skill.mjs`) and the host half checks `~/.agents/skills/kanban-use/SKILL.md` on every `dsh web` start. A `skill-version` fingerprint in the skill's frontmatter (bumped on content changes) drives that copy policy: missing → copies the shipped file in; identical → no-op; **same or newer version but different content → your local copy is kept** (that is your own edit of the current version) with a hint; **older version (or a copy with no fingerprint) → synced over** (that is stale package content from a previous install, the upgrade path). So `dsh plugin add/update dsh-kanban` + the required restart is all it takes, on any machine. The manual commands still exist for repo checkouts and forced syncs:

```sh
pnpm install:skill            # symlinks skills/kanban-use → ~/.agents/skills/kanban-use
node scripts/install-skill.mjs --copy   # materialize/overwrite a copy (works inside the installed package too)
```

The skill is **maintained in this repository alongside the plugin** — the release/dev gates (`pnpm check:cards` → `scripts/check-card-discipline.mjs`) assert that the skill's field semantics and tool names stay consistent with the plugin's schema, and `scripts/audit-cards.mjs <workspace> [--fail]` reports incomplete cards in any workspace's `KANBAN.json`.

## Directory layout

```
cordis.patch.yml        # bundle layer: mounts this package (host tools + client half)
package.json            # dsh.bundle (patch) + dsh.client (web) + exports["./client"]
tsdown.config.ts        # self-contained build: node half + module-table client bundle
src/board-core.ts       # KANBAN.json domain: read/write, validation, card CRUD,
                        #   missingCardFields completeness rule (shared)
src/index.ts            # host half: 4 model tools + /kanban/api webServer route
src/client/index.ts     # client apply: global panel (sidebar glyph + 'main' occupant)
src/client/BoardPage.tsx       # three-column board component (+ missing-field hints)
src/client/KanbanSurface.tsx   # panel glyph + the 'main' panel wrapper
src/client/workspace-pick.ts   # current-session + most-recently-active workspace derivations (pure, unit-tested)
src/client/board-counts.ts     # /kanban/counts poll behind the glyph badge
src/client/locales.ts          # zh/en copy
src/client/styles.ts           # --dsw-alias-* design-token styles
src/skill-register.ts          # host half: kanban-use served through ctx.skills (DSH ≥ 0.1.6)
src/skill-sync.ts              # host half: copy fallback for shells without the skill service
skills/kanban-use/SKILL.md     # the kanban-use skill (ships in the npm tarball)
scripts/check-card-discipline.mjs # dev gate: guidance/schema/skill agree on completeness
scripts/check-tokens.mjs         # dev gate: every --dsw-alias-* token exists in the installed DSH theme
scripts/check-client-wiring.mjs  # dev gate: panel id/key wiring survived the edit
scripts/audit-cards.mjs          # KANBAN.json completeness audit ([workspace] [--fail])
scripts/install-skill.mjs        # symlink/copy the skill into ~/.agents/skills (shipped too)
scripts/verify-skill-sync.mjs    # copy-fallback three-state verification (part of pnpm test)
scripts/verify-skill-runtime.mjs # runtime skill registration vs a real registry (part of pnpm test)
docs/screenshots/board-page.png  # Web board page screenshot (README figure)
```

## Why an external plugin

dsh's official updates only touch the bundled in-repo packages. An **external bundle** is installed into the user profile via `dsh plugin` and is never touched by official upgrades (same pattern as `dsh-model-reasoning`). The plugin only uses dsh's externally stable capability surface: tool registration (`ctx.tools`), webServer route registration, system-prompt guidance (`ctx.systemPrompt.section` / `.context`), the command registry (`ctx.commands`), the skill registry (`ctx.skills`), and the Web global-panel slots (`sidebar.panellist` + `main`).

## Known limitations (v1)

- **dsh only**: aggregating Codex / Claude Code todos is future work (the `KANBAN.json` file is plain, so any tool can read it later).
- **No auto-extraction**: model-driven writes plus manual page maintenance keep the data clean and controllable.
- **One board per workspace**: a flat card list; plans are expressed via tags or card groups (no multi-board / nested columns).
- **JSON first**: machine-friendly and diff-friendly; a `KANBAN.md` render view can come later.

## Development

```sh
pnpm install   # build deps (tsdown, react)
pnpm bundle    # emits lib/index.js + lib/client.js
```

- `src/client/` is the browser plugin; the client bundle keeps `@deepseek-ai/*` + `react` external (resolved from the loader module table at runtime) and inlines everything else.
- UI uses `--dsw-alias-*` design tokens, namespaced with the `kb-` prefix; `pnpm check:tokens` fails on any token the installed DSH theme does not define (an unknown custom property renders as *nothing*, silently).
- The board is a DSH **global panel**: `sidebar.panellist` draws the sidebar row, the keyed `main` slot hosts the page. `pnpm check:wiring` pins that wiring; the live-GUI scripts verify it in a browser.

## Verification

```sh
pnpm test       # tsc --noEmit typecheck + 20 KANBAN.json domain unit tests
                #   + 13 workspace-pick/current-session derivation tests
                #   + token-drift gate (with negative control) + panel-wiring gate
                #   + host tool smoke + skill runtime registration vs a real registry
pnpm typecheck  # typecheck only (tsc --noEmit)
pnpm verify     # 4 board tools registered + board_add persisted end-to-end
pnpm accept     # GUI acceptance against a running dsh web (http://127.0.0.1:3080):
                #   sidebar global-panel row → board rendered in the centre column
                #   (opaque, row marked selected) → add / move / delete
node scripts/capture-board-page.mjs  # refresh the README figure from the live GUI
                #   (captures the board panel only — never the session sidebar)
```

Since DSH 0.1.2-alpha.2 the Web GUI protects its index with a browser-session
cookie ("dsh web authentication required"); the live-GUI scripts authenticate
themselves through the `/?token=` handshake. Point them at the token `dsh web`
printed on launch via `DSH_WEB_TOKEN`, or pass the full launch URL (including
`?token=...`) as `DSH_GUI_URL`; on instances where auth is off they run
unchanged.

Since DSH 0.1.3-alpha.1 the composer input is a contenteditable div (0.1.2 used
`<textarea>`); the live-GUI scripts match both (`textarea, [contenteditable="true"]`),
so the same scripts run against either version.

External plugins get no compile-time typechecking by default (tsdown only
transpiles); `tsc --noEmit` in `pnpm test` catches "used-but-not-imported"
mistakes that would otherwise crash at runtime (a missing `IconCheckOutline16`
import once took down the whole board page).

Since DSH 0.1.6-alpha.2 the client `SessionListState` no longer carries
`current`; the board derives the current session from main-view retention
(`retainedBy.mainView`), the same predicate the shell's own sidebar, session
binding, and Settings use — and still reads `current` when an older shell
provides it.

Since DSH 0.1.7-alpha.1 icons carry their stroke weight in the name
(`*Regular` = 1 px, `*Medium` = 1.3 px) and the size-suffixed names are gone;
the board imports the `*Regular` variants, with every rendered size unchanged
(the artwork defaults still carry the old sizes). **The client half therefore
requires DSH ≥ 0.1.7 since 0.2.9** — 0.2.8 is the release for 0.1.2–0.1.6. That
floor is also declared, since 0.2.10, as an optional
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots` peer dependency, range `>=0.1.7-rc.1` (the
prerelease floor is load-bearing: a plain `>=0.1.7` does not match a
`0.1.7-rc.N` runtime). The peer gate itself shipped with **DSH 0.1.7-rc.1**:
from there on the loader evaluates every `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peer against the
running runtime and skips an incompatible bundle with the exact
`dsh plugin allow-version` remedy (`dsh plugin add` refuses it outright) — so a
future plugin floor is enforced up front instead of failing later at render
time. Runtimes older than the gate — everything up to and including
0.1.7-alpha.2, hence all of 0.1.2–0.1.6 — do not evaluate peers at all: there
the plugin still loads and the client half is what breaks on render, which is
why 0.2.8 remains the release for those.

`scripts/verify-model-board.mjs` additionally verifies a **real model call**: it sends
the GUI agent an instruction to use `board_add`/`board_list`, then confirms the card
lands in `KANBAN.json` at the session cwd and is visible on the board page (the
model-writes ↔ Web-sees round trip).

# DSH Smoothly Desktop (DSH SD)

DSH Smoothly Desktop（**DSH SD**）把 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（`dsh`）打包成可独立运行的 Windows 桌面 App。

- **dsh 更新由你决定**：启动时只检查 npm 上 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 的稳定版（`latest` tag）与预发布（`next`/`alpha` tag），**不自动安装**。有新版时托盘菜单高亮「有更新 vX → 点击更新」，壳菜单「检查更新…」弹窗也能一键更新（含预发布，想升才升）；点一下即下载安装并自动重启。dsh 永远来自官方 npm 包（经内置 pnpm 安装），本地零改动。**唯一例外是版本地板**：壳要求 dsh ≥ `0.2.1-rc.2`（0.1.6-alpha.2 起 dsh 才自带插件管理；随壳分发的预装插件要能被 dsh 的插件兼容门禁放行；`0.2.0-rc.1` / `0.2.0-rc.2` / `0.2.1-alpha.2` 三版都做过全面回归——overlay 目标行 / CLI / 客户端 seam 与槽位均成立、四个预装插件实机渲染正常；`0.2.1-rc.2` 已完成静态契约核对与 dev 实机验证，**已随 v0.19.0 发布并核验**（`CHANGELOG.md` 的 0.19.0 条目 + 随包 `manager/server-manager.mjs` 同值）。见 `docs/2026-09-25-shell-improvement-plan.md` §15），低于地板的运行时会先自动升到地板，失败则如实提示并继续启动。
- **插件管理在 dsh 自己的页面里**：dsh 0.1.6-alpha.2 起自带插件管理（Web 侧边栏 **Plugins** 页：安装/卸载/启用/停用/行级开关/构建脚本审批/插件配置页）。壳内不再有自建的插件管理窗口——dsh 起不来时用壳菜单「停用全部第三方插件…」自救（会先备份 profile `package.json`）。
- **升级后自动清理残留嵌套包**：pnpm 的 hoisted 安装不清理上一版留下的嵌套目录，而 Node 解析嵌套副本优先于提升到根的新版 —— 实测 0.1.5-rc.2 → 0.1.6-alpha.2 后 `dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/*` 仍是旧版（不导出新版需要的 `./message-projections`）→ dsh 启动即崩。壳在**升级后与每次启动**都检查一次，只删版本与父包不一致的嵌套副本（不重建整棵树、不需要联网）。
- **内置 Node 24 运行时**：安装包自带 Node（满足 dsh 的运行要求），用户机器无需装 Node。
- **原生通知**：dsh 需要你问答（`pendingInteraction`：问题 / 批准 / 计划审阅）时，或某个会话结束（`running` 由真变假）时，弹出系统通知；窗口在前台时不打扰。
- **点击通知直达会话**：单击系统通知会把窗口带回前台并打开对应会话（单实例 + 本地桥实现）。
- **托盘常驻**：关窗只是隐藏，服务继续跑；托盘菜单"退出"才真正停止并退出。
- **壳内代理**：所有 dsh 出站流量（模型请求、web 搜索、npm 安装/更新、插件、子代理）都经壳内置的本地正向代理；默认直连，可在设置里勾选哪些主机走上游代理（含可选账号密码），保存即生效。**入口 = 托盘「代理设置…」**（打开独立设置窗口，不打断 dsh 页面）。
- **官方零改动**：通知插件通过 `dsh web --patch` 在运行时注入，更新 dsh 不会冲掉它。
- 桌面端数据自包含（`DSH_HOME` 默认在运行时目录内），与浏览器版各自独立，可随时切回共用。

## 架构

```
┌─ Tauri 2 壳 (Rust, WebView2) ─────────────────────────────┐
│ 本地启动页 → 监听 server-url 事件 → 跳转 http://127.0.0.1   │
│ server-manager.mjs（内置 Node 24 运行）                     │
│   校验/更新 @deepseek-ai/dsh（pnpm 装自 npm registry）       │
│   注入通知插件（--patch，copy 进运行时 node_modules）        │
│   拉起 dsh web --no-open（不开默认浏览器）                   │
│   解析 stdout 里的 http://127.0.0.1:<port> 上报给壳         │
│ 本地通知桥（127.0.0.1:<bridge>）                           │
│   /notify → tauri-plugin-notification 弹系统通知           │
│   /pending-open → 点通知后的"待打开会话"                    │
│   /log /alive → 决策日志 + 心跳（排查用）                   │
│ 自绘顶栏（decorations:false）：窗口三键 + 壳菜单栏           │
│   注入 shell-chrome.js（SHELL_MENUS 定义点，IPC/桥双通道）   │
│ 托盘：显示窗口 / 重启服务 / 打开数据目录 / 退出              │
│ single-instance：toast 点击/二次启动 → 聚焦已有窗口          │
└────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────┘
                         │ spawn
                 ┌───────▼────────┐        通知插件（仅 loopback 权限）
                 │  dsh web 服务   │ ◄──── 事件 → 桥 → 系统 toast
                 └────────────────┘        数据 <runtime>/dsh-home
```

## 目录

```
src/                      Tauri 前端加载页（纯静态，无打包器）
  index.html / app.js      启动页：等 dsh 就绪 → 跳转；安装进度 + 滚动日志
  settings.html / settings.js  独立代理设置窗口（顶栏菜单栏 / 托盘打开）
src-tauri/                Tauri 2 壳：
  src/lib.rs               窗口/托盘/单实例/通知桥/服务生命周期/代理桥/壳顶栏注入
  resources/ui/shell-chrome.js  壳顶栏（窗口三键 + 菜单栏；SHELL_MENUS 定义点，编译期内嵌）
  capabilities/            权限（launcher + remote-notifications）
  resources/patch/         --patch 注入文件（dsh-desktop.patch.yml）
  resources/manager/       同步后的 server-manager.mjs + proxy.mjs
  resources/node/          fetch-node.mjs 下载的 Node 24（不入库）
  resources/plugin/        @dsh-desktop 客户端插件（bundle 用）
  resources/preinstalled/  预装插件 bundle（dsh-kanban / model-reasoning / turn-navigator / smoothly-opencode-session）
  icons/                   应用图标全套（含 NSIS 安装器图标/向导横幅）
scripts/
  server-manager.mjs       更新 dsh（pnpm）+ 内置代理 + 拉起服务 + URL/日志上报（核心）
  proxy.mjs                壳内置正向代理（CONNECT/HTTP + 按主机路由 + Basic 认证）
  smoke-windows.mjs        发版门禁：空 runtime 冷安装 dsh → 断言报 URL
  fetch-node.mjs           下载/校验/解压 Node 24（幂等）
  sync-resources.mjs       把 scripts/plugins 同步进 src-tauri/resources
  make-icon-png.mjs        图标源生成工具（开发用）
  test-*.mjs               npm test 全量跑的行为/回归测试
plugins/dsh-client-notifications/
  client.js                浏览器半边：监听 pendingInteraction / running 沿，
                           经桥发通知、消费 /pending-open 打开会话
  index.js                 Node 半边：空实现（占位）
.dsh/skills/               排障技能（Windows 桌面壳安装/启动调试方法论）
.github/workflows/build.yml  windows-latest 出 NSIS；门禁：7z 断言 + runtime smoke；v* tag 发 Release
LICENSE                   MIT
```

## 构建（Windows）

在 Windows 上：

```bash
npm install
npm run bundle        # = tauri build --bundles nsis
```

产出于 `src-tauri/target/release/bundle/nsis/*.exe`。也可以直接推 GitHub 走
`.github/workflows/build.yml`（windows-latest 出 NSIS；ubuntu-latest 顺带出
AppImage/deb，方便 Linux 桌面验证）。

前置：Rust stable（MSVC）、Node 18+（本机工具链）。WebView2 一般已预装。
`tauri build` 前（`beforeBuildCommand`）会自动下载 Node 24 运行时并校验
SHA-256，再同步 manager/plugin/patch 等资源。

## 开发版（与正式版同机并存调试）

Windows 上已装正式版时，覆盖安装会动到工作数据。项目支持打一个**独立身份的开发版**，
与正式版互不干扰、可同时运行：

```bash
npm run bundle:dev        # = tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.dev.conf.json --bundles nsis
```

`src-tauri/tauri.dev.conf.json` 只覆盖两个顶层字段（深合并到 tauri.conf.json，其余
配置原样继承）：`productName: "DSH Smoothly Desktop Dev"`、`identifier: "dsh.smoothly.desktop.dev"`。
由此带来的隔离：

| 维度 | 正式版 | 开发版 |
|---|---|---|
| 安装目录 / 开始菜单 / 卸载项 | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\DSH Smoothly Desktop` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\DSH Smoothly Desktop Dev` |
| 应用数据（runtime、dsh 本体、`DSH_HOME`、proxy.json） | `%APPDATA%\dsh.smoothly.desktop` | `%APPDATA%\dsh.smoothly.desktop.dev` |
| 单实例互斥 / 任务栏 AUMID | `dsh.smoothly.desktop-sim` | `dsh.smoothly.desktop.dev-sim` |
|

# Smoothly Model Reasoning (Smoothly MR) [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-model-reasoning.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-model-reasoning) [![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-model-reasoning.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-model-reasoning) [![license MIT](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-model-reasoning.svg)](LICENSE) | Brand | | | --- | --- | | English brand | **Smoothly** | | 中文品牌 | **思磨力** | | English product name | **Smoothly Model Reasoning** — short: **Smoothly MR** | | 中文产品名 | **思磨力提供方参数** | Smoothly Model Reasoning (**Smoothly MR** / 思磨力提供方参数) is an **external** DeepSeek Harness web client plugin: a Settings page that manages the provider-route parameters the built-in **Models** page deliberately does not expose — retry & backoff policy, timeouts, transport, caching, thinking budgets, capacities, request image budgets — plus **per-model thinking levels (reasoning efforts)** for third-party (pi-ai) providers. It writes the exact `llm-pi-ai.providers..*` fields the adapter reads, so changes take effect with no other configuration. Why an external plugin: adding fields to the built-in `ui-settings-models` package would be overwritten by the next official release. This package ships as an installable **bundle** that never touches repository source, so official updates cannot clobber it. ## What it manages A new Settings section, **「思磨力提供方参数 / Smoothly MR」**, placed after the built-in Models page. Pick any provider route — every entry in the `llm-pi-ai` `providers` dict is editable here, catalog routes included — and manage it in five parameter groups: - **Per model** — for routes carrying an explicit `models` list, edit the SELECTED model's own declaration: input modalities (`text`/`image`, so a text-only model stays text-only beside its vision siblings), context and output caps (`contextWindow`, `maxTokens`), and thinking levels (`reasoningEfforts`: inherit / non-reasoning / a level set over `off minimal low medium high xhigh max`) with custom wire spelling per level. The picker fuses search into the dropdown itself — open it and type to narrow long model lists by name / id (display-only; stored order and write path untouched). **Apply to all models** copies only the CHECKED dimensions from the editor to every model on the route; this group also holds the route default thinking level (`providers..reasoning`) that unset models inherit. - **Retry & backoff**: `retryPolicy.mode` (`normal` bounded transient retries vs `always` unbounded retries), `maxRetries`, `retryableCodes` (the five stable preset codes plus custom entries), and the shared exponential backoff (`initialDelayMs`, `maxDelayMs`, `jitterRatio`). Unset values fall back to the adapter defaults (5 retries, 500 ms initial, 10 s ceiling, 10% jitter). - **Timeouts & transport**: `timeoutMs`, `websocketConnectTimeoutMs`, `streamIdleTimeoutMs` (default 300 000 ms), and `transport` (`auto/sse/websocket/websocket-cached`). - **Caching & thinking budgets**: `cacheRetention` (`none/short/long`) and `thinkingBudgets` token budgets per level (`minimal/low/medium/high`). - **Capacities & budgets**: `defaultContextWindow`, `defaultMaxTokens`, `defaultInput` modalities (`text/image`) — these three are FALLBACKS read only by models that declare nothing of their own (set the real values per model in the **Per model** tab) — plus the per-request image payload caps (`maxRequestImageBytes`, `requestImagePixelBudget`, `requestImageMaxBytes`). Every group's panel opens with a **scope badge**: 「按模型 / Per model」 writes into the selected model's own declaration, and a dimension you leave unset inherits the route fallback or catalog value; the four other groups are 「整条 路由 / Whole route」 — those fields exist ONLY at route level in the llm-pi-ai schema, so one shared value is the whole truth (the badge's hover tooltip says so; no duplicate text sits beside it). A field with an adapter default shows it as the placeholder while unset; clearing a field removes the override instead of writing an echo of the default. Local validation mirrors the host's own resolution rules, so most mistakes are caught before the write; anything the host still refuses surfaces verbatim from `settings.mutate`. The write path uses revision fencing, so a concurrent change is refused rather than silently overwritten. An **Apply to all models** action copies the checked dimensions of the current model's editor to every model on the route at once. ### Custom wire spelling (adapt to any upstream vocabulary) Each selected reasoning level has a **wire-spelling** field (defaults to the level name). Change it to remap what that level sends — e.g. `max → ultra` for a model that calls its top level Ultra, or `high → turbo`. `off` can either send nothing (default) or a custom value of its own. > ⚠️ DSH does **not** support inventing new level names. The pi-ai schema pins > `reasoningEfforts` keys to the seven canonical levels and resolution only reads > those keys, so a bare `ultra:` key is rejected at write time. "Ultra" is > expressed by remapping an existing level's wire spelling (`max: ultra`). ### Empty state With no third-party provider configured the page shows a friendly placeholder pointing at **Settings → Models → Add a custom provider**. Selecting a catalog route (no explicit `models` list) explains that its MODELS stay read-only here — catalog reasoning levels remain selectable in the composer — while the route's parameter groups above stay fully editable. Loading / unavailable states are hinted while the settings document loads. ## Install **Prerequisites:** a DeepSeek Harness install with the `dsh` CLI, plus [pnpm](https://pnpm.io) (the `dsh plugin` command runs pnpm under the hood). This is an installable **bundle** — it is loaded by `dsh`, not imported as a library. **Compatibility:** since v0.2.5 the page reads through the settings-forms service (`ctx.configForms`) and writes through the settings **Remote** namespace (`ctx.remote.settings`, the write path since v0.2.2); dsh builds older than 0.1.7 — which removed the predecessor `settingsScope` client seam — are not supported (v0.2.4 remains the release for dsh 0.1.2–0.1.6). The floor is also declared in `package.json` as an optional `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings` peer dependency (`>=0.1.7-rc.1`), making it machine-readable for the peer gate that ships from dsh 0.1.7-rc.1 on: an out-of-range bundle is refused with the exact `dsh plugin allow-version` remedy. Runtimes older than that gate evaluate no peers, so nothing refuses them: on 0.1.2–0.1.6 the page simply never loads, while the 0.1.7 alphas (seam present, gate absent) work as before. ### From npm (recommended) The package is published to npm as `dsh-model-reasoning`: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-model-reasoning ``` This installs the prebuilt bundle and appends it to the `web` profile. Then **restart `dsh web`** and open **Settings → 思磨力提供方参数 / Smoothly MR**. ### From git ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:karoc/dsh-model-reasoning# ``` A git install runs the package's `prepare` script to build the bundle. pnpm ≥ 10 requires allowlisting that build once — copy the exact package key pnpm prints into the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` under `allowBuilds`, then re-run `add` (see `docs/user/develop/basic/publish.md` in the DSH repo). ### Updating Bump to the newest release with pnpm update (or re-add to pick up a newer git ref): ```sh dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-model-reasoning # or, if the dependency spec is pinned: dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-model-reasoning ``` Then **restart `dsh web`** so the new client bundle loads. ### Removing ```sh dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-model-reasoning ``` This removes both the dependency and its bundle layer from the `web` profile. Restart `dsh web` for the section to disappear. ## Layout ``` cordis.patch.yml # bundle layer: mounts the row that the client-modules # service discovers (dsh.client manifest) package.json # dsh.bundle (patch) + dsh.client (web) + exports["./client"] tsdown.config.ts # self-contained build: node half + module-table client bundle src/index.ts # host apply (no-op) src/client/index.ts # client apply: configForms.get(llm-pi-ai) + register settings.section src/client/ProviderParamsSection.tsx # the settings page (route → group tabs → editors) src/client/params.ts # managed-field registry: domains, defaults, host-mirroring # validators, draft model, minimal-op diff engine src/client/styles.ts # design-token styles (--dsw-alias-*) + injection src/client/locales.ts # en/zh copy tests/params.test.ts # unit tests for the pure registry logic ``` ## Build & test ```sh npm install npm run bundle # emits lib/index.js + lib/client.js npm test # unit tests for params.ts (node:test runs TypeScript directly) pnpm release:check # release gate: docs/changelog/tag/tree/build/registry must all pass npm publish # runs the gate (prepack/prepublishOnly), then postpublish verifies the live release ``` The bundle leaves the platform packages (`react`, `@deepseek-ai/cordis`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-*`) external — they resolve at runtime from the loader's module table; everything else is inlined. ## Notes / limitations - Only routes carrying an explicit `models` list expose per-MODEL editors here (the installed catalog is not reachable from the client); every route's route-level parameter groups are always editable. Catalog-only per-model customization via `modelOverrides` is future work. - Credential management (`apiKeyEnv`), `displayName`, `baseURL`, protocol (`api`), and the models list structure stay on the built-in **Models** page; this plugin does not duplicate them. - Wire spellings default to the level name and are edited per selected level in the page; the same per-model field can be set directly in `settings.yaml` (e.g. `max: ultra`). - Legacy profile keys removed upstream (`provider`, `maxRetries`, `maxRetryDelayMs` at route level) are never written by this plugin. - **Section nav icon is shell-assigned, not plugin-assigned.** The built-in `ui-settings-general` `SettingsRoot.tsx` `navIcon(id)` maps known ids and falls back to a gear for every other id — including this section's `provider-params`. When DSH exposes a per-section icon, use `IconThinkOutlineRegular` from `dsh-client-ui-primitives` for this section. ## License [MIT](LICENSE) ## Contributing See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) (development + release checklist) and [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) for version history.
